国产电视总算熬出头了！有人拿 AI 当刀，把一开机满屏广告的安卓电视，硬是削成了 Apple TV 那副模样。

官网：https://t.co/heWMUyi4tc

这个更狠：Claude Code 顺着 Wi-Fi 直接摸进电视，广告、推荐流、遥测和多余的预装组件，一概自动停用。

Root 不用碰，刷机不用折腾，数据线也不用插；投屏、语音助手这些功能，留不留全按你的需要。

备份、恢复都齐活，只要设备带网络 ADB 功能，Android TV / Google TV 都能上手。

repos.description: Multi-modal exact geometric computation CAD/CAM kernel in Rust

tweet.text:
csgrs

Build CAD models in Rust, from curves to solids

csgrs is a CAD/CAM kernel for exact geometric computation. Its OpenSCAD vocabulary covers primitives, Boolean operations, transforms, extrusion, revolution, sweeps and lofts.

You can move between curve and solid representations and exchange geometry through CAD formats. Exact STEP exchange is supported within a declared mapping domain.

A modeling session selects a predicate policy and reports the weakest certainty across the whole chain.

线上开会一边听一边记，回头整理纪要才发现漏了好几条要跟进的事，谁负责哪件也想不起来了。

Call.md 是一款开源的会议录制工具，录屏的同时把我们的麦克风和对方的声音分开转写，谁说了什么一目了然。

开会过程中 AI 会根据对话给提示，比如接下来可以问什么。还会实时统计双方的说话占比和语速，一个人讲太久会轻轻提醒一下。

GitHub：https://t.co/W5fgGTje7b

会后自动出三份东西，一段概述、按话题分好的要点、具体的待办事项，能导出成 Markdown，也能自动推到 n8n、Zapier 里接着处理。

我觉得最有用的反而是会前准备，填一下会议描述，它会帮忙列好要问的问题和讨论清单。

设置和会议记录都存在本地，转写要用 VideoDB 的接口，免费账号送 20 美元额度。目前 macOS 有现成的安装包。

经常开线上会、会后还得写纪要的，装一个能省不少事。

repos.name: GeEom/greedytile
repos.description: Random greedy pixel pattern generation algorithm

tweet.text:
greedytile

Turn an existing image into new pixel patterns

Greedytile extracts 3×3 pixel tiles from a source image and arranges them into new patterns with a random greedy algorithm. It prioritizes positions with fewer valid tile choices.

Tile selection favors pixel balance and distance patterns found in the source. When no tile fits the rules, it removes pixels from a local area and continues.

It comes as a command line tool and a library, both written in safe Rust. The tool also supports rotation, mirroring, and animation.

最近无问芯穹和清华大学联合开源的系统级仿真平台：Uni3Sim，相当于给 AI 机房搭了个模拟实验室，硬件落地前先把整套服务模拟跑一遍。

芯片计算、存取数据、卡和卡之间传数据都会算进去，能看出哪里在排队卡脖子，最后算出回答快不快、一秒能接多少活。

做 AI 基础设施、芯片或者大模型部署的朋友，不妨先拿它在电脑上把方案跑一遍。

repos.name: SWivid/F5-TTS
repos.description: Official code for "F5-TTS: A Fairytaler that Fakes Fluent and Faithful Speech with Flow Matching"

tweet.text:
i used Claude Code to turn 18 open-source repos into a complete video clipping factory.

one source video can become 30 Shorts without manually editing every clip.

the workflow has everything: downloading, highlight detection, face tracking, subtitles, audio cleanup, dubbing, and final export.

here are the 18 repos that make it possible:

01. download & detect moments

1. yt-dlp → download videos from the web
    https://t.co/er3nVKxlUi
2. PySceneDetect → detect every scene cut
    https://t.co/YEeNN9Gi1l
3. WhisperX → generate word-level transcripts and identify speakers
    https://t.co/JJvEL9bFIr
4. AI Shorts Generator → find potential viral moments
    https://t.co/4P9HImqbR4
5. auto-editor → automatically remove dead air and silence
    https://t.co/3a0aJbye5B

02. tracking & visual editing

6. MediaPipe → track faces and automatically reframe footage
    https://t.co/t86i973mqJ
7. Ultralytics YOLO → detect and track people and objects
    https://t.co/EfynaZVO3x
8. SAM 2 → isolate and remove backgrounds around subjects
    https://t.co/wwOYAKZs0P

03. audio & voice

9. Demucs → separate vocals from background music
    https://t.co/izTSGbsopv
10. DeepFilterNet → clean up noisy audio
    https://t.co/ubzNDar1O9
11. F5-TTS → generate voiceovers and dubbed audio
    https://t.co/SHZSE7vVvr

04. captions & editing

12. Remotion → create animated captions and motion graphics with code
    https://t.co/WDhe2UHXTZ
13. MoviePy → batch-edit dozens of clips programmatically
    https://t.co/UxDTZfR01t
14. LosslessCut → trim footage without re-encoding
    https://t.co/uUyQkbDaoi
15. OpenCut → edit clips on a full video timeline
    https://t.co/y6AVRzU7yU

05. enhancement & export

16. Real-ESRGAN → upscale low-resolution footage
    https://t.co/UFsUMcAnnm
17. RIFE → generate smoother slow-motion footage
    https://t.co/7icFNNixyS
18. FFmpeg → render and export the finished videos
    https://t.co/gGht2NpzCu

the entire workflow:

VOD → download → detect highlights → remove dead air → track faces → generate captions → clean audio → dub → enhance → export.

the interesting part is that these aren’t 18 random tools.

they’re building blocks for one automated content production pipeline.

you can use the same setup for:
→ gaming clips and GTA 6 content.
→ podcasts and interviews.
→ MrBeast-style YouTube Shorts.
→ TikTok and Instagram Reels.
→ turning long videos into multiple short-form videos.

no need to build every feature from scratch. Claude Code can help connect these tools into one working studio.

bookmark this. the next viral clip you publish could come from a video you already have. 🔖 https://t.co/1905OqpH9x

FableCut

Edit video alongside an AI agent on the same browser timeline

FableCut is a video editor that runs entirely in the browser. Its timeline is a JSON document covering media, clips, tracks, effects, keyframes, and transitions.

Agents can edit through MCP or REST while the browser view updates live. A human and an agent can work on the same timeline at the same time.

repos.name: baidu/Unlimited-OCR
repos.description: Unlimited OCR Works: Welcome the Era of One-shot Long-horizon Parsing.

tweet.text:
China just open-sourced a 3B-parameter OCR model that can read entire 100-page PDFs in one pass.

it’s called Unlimited-OCR, and unlike traditional OCR tools that process documents page by page, it can preserve context across the entire document.

that means fewer broken connections, less lost context, and better understanding of long documents.

here’s what makes it interesting:

→ 32K context window: handles long-horizon document parsing in a single pass.

→ multilingual: works across multiple languages out of the box.

→ 93% on OmniDocBench v1.5: reportedly 6 points above the DeepSeek-OCR baseline.

→ long-document accuracy: edit distance stays below 0.11 even beyond 40 pages.

→ fully local: runs on your own hardware without sending documents to a cloud service.

→ flexible deployment: supports Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, and Docker.

the cost difference is worth paying attention to.

cloud OCR services like AWS Textract, Google Vision, and Azure Document Intelligence can cost around $1.50–$15 per 1,000 pages.

Unlimited-OCR lets you run document extraction locally without paying per page.

you can use it for:

→ extracting information from lengthy reports.

→ processing research papers and academic documents.

→ converting PDFs into structured, searchable data.

→ building private document-processing workflows.

it’s released under the MIT license, so you can use and modify it freely.

github: https://t.co/dvZolsvXha

if you work with PDFs, research papers, or document-heavy AI workflows, this is worth bookmarking.

save this, and follow for more useful AI tools.

repos.name: Renakoni/Voicebox
repos.description: 最好用的Android 离线多模型 TTS 与音色克隆（误），支持 GPU/NPU 加速 | The best Offline multi-model TTS & voice cloning on Android (jk) with GPU/NPU acceleration.

tweet.text:
想用自己的声音给视频配段旁白，或者做一段有声书，用电脑跑语音克隆光配环境就得折腾半天，没有独立显卡还跑不动。

Voicebox 把 GPT-SoVITS 这套语音克隆放到了安卓手机上，录大约 5 秒参考音频、填上对应的文字，就能用这个声音念出别的内容。

模型下载好之后全程离线跑，不联网也不靠云端。参考音频和生成的语言可以不一样，用一段日语录音也能让它说中文或英文。

GitHub：https://t.co/DdHydTHN3m

在骁龙 8 Gen 3 的手机上，一句 4 秒的话大约 2.6 秒就生成好了，长段落比正常播放还快一倍左右。

项目简介自称「最好用的安卓离线语音克隆（误）」，后面那个「误」挺可爱的。还内置了一个本地接口，能接有声书阅读器这类 App。

支持中日英三种语言，需要安卓 11 以上的手机，安装包 70 多 MB。

tweet.text:
Hermes 插件生态又燃爆了 🔥

WestWaters 的 Live Translate 同声传译、acruz6421-bot 的 Hermes 分身、tdotlab 的 Wake 夜间日记、abundantbeing 的 Aether 动态主题、RajaMDM 的省钱模型路由……全网玩家把 Hermes 玩成了下一代「随身同传 + 影分身 + 第二大脑 + 动态壁纸工坊 + 账单管家」:

1️⃣ WestWaters/hermes-live-translator（https://t.co/1aW3LoUUOZ）

Hermes 插件 + 桌面 App 的本地实时翻译：听懂约 100 种语言、能在 201 种语言和方言之间互译，5 秒声音就能在本地克隆说话人的嗓音，双向同时翻；能当麦克风接进 Zoom、Meet、Teams、Discord 和 OBS，对 Hermes 说一句“帮我和讲印地语的奶奶聊天”就开工，数据不出你的电脑。

“订阅的大模型出力气，Hermes 出记忆，合体成一个你”！

一条命令生成 Obsidian 第二大脑：所有 Agent 遵守同一套规则，先读再猜，学到东西就写回去；每天夜里再读一遍 Hermes、Claude Code 前一天的对话，写成一篇日记，附上原文引用的证据段落，全部进 git 存档，模型碰不到你的原文件。
“Agent 白天干活，晚上写日记，第二天接着记得”！

4️⃣ abundantbeing/aether（https://t.co/MkMees5zIm）

Hermes Desktop 的“活”主题：跟 Hermes 说一句“金色的黑洞”“雨里的霓虹城市”，它就配好整套配色，在聊天背后画出会动的场景，不满意一键撤销；18 个场景、10 种质感、调色编辑器和随机配色，鼠标划过画面还会跟着起涟漪。
“一句话，把聊天窗口换成你想要的世界”！

5️⃣ RajaMDM/hermes-budget-router（https://t.co/N7p0dC5BVQ）

开会话前先用最便宜的模型给任务分档：简单活走本地或免费模型，难活才上贵的；读取 Hermes 自己的数据库算本期花费，快超支就收紧，额度快过期就多用掉；Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、Grok、OpenRouter、本地模型都能接。
“好模型用在刀刃上，账单不再吓一跳”！

repos.name: boykopovar/AnyPS5
repos.description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows

tweet.text:
今天 GitHub 被「PS5 游戏移植神器 + 万物变 Agent 命令行 + 文件转 Markdown + 开源编程 Agent + 全平台代理客户端」联手屠榜了！

5 个星标暴增最狠的项目，专业拆解下！

1. boykopovar/AnyPS5

把 PS5 可执行文件自动移植到 Linux 和 Windows 的工具：自带重链接器把程序转成目标系统的原生格式，再配上 PS5 系统库的实现，不走模拟、不开额外运行时进程；着色器重编译器直接产出 SPIR-V，手柄、键鼠都能映射，还有网页版转换器，文件全程留在你自己设备上。

🔗 直达：https://t.co/WfVh561Mg8

不是模拟器，是直接“翻译”成原生程序，这思路够野。704 星一天，总星 6 万+，玩家和逆向圈一起沸腾！

🟢

2. HKUDS/CLI-Anything

港大 HKUDS 出品：一条命令让任何软件变成 Agent 能直接操作的命令行，给 Pi、OpenClaw、nanobot、Cursor、Claude Code 这类 Agent 用；配套 CLI-Hub，pip 装好后 cli-hub install 就能一键装社区做好的 CLI，Blender、FreeCAD、Zotero、Godot 等都已接入，输出结构化 JSON，Agent 不用再瞎点界面。

🔗 直达：https://t.co/MYHRKF5FyF

“今天的软件服务人类，明天的用户是 Agent。”687 星一天，总星 6.2 万+，Agent 时代的万能转接头！

🟢🟢

3. microsoft/markitdown

微软开源的轻量 Python 工具：把 PDF、PPT、Word、Excel、图片、音频、HTML、CSV/JSON/XML、ZIP、EPub 甚至 YouTube 链接统统转成 Markdown，专门喂给大模型和文本分析流水线用；Markdown 结构清晰又省 token，主流大模型天生就“说”这门语言。

🔗 直达：https://t.co/YXF5hHxQCI

资料喂给 AI 之前先过一遍 MarkItDown，效果和省钱一次到位。466 星一天，总星 19.7 万+，AI 知识库的标配入口！

🟢🟢🟢

4. anomalyco/opencode

开源的编程 Agent：终端界面 + 桌面 App（macOS、Windows、Linux 都有），curl、npm、brew 一行就装；内置 build 和 plan 两个 Agent，Tab 键一键切换，plan 模式默认只读、跑命令前先问你，摸陌生代码库特别安心，复杂搜索还有 general 子 Agent 帮忙。

🔗 直达：https://t.co/VILXKQQgKp

闭源编程助手再强，也不如一个自己能掌控的开源版本香。187 星一天，总星 22.8 万+，开源编程 Agent 的扛把子！

🟢🟢🟢🟢

5. chen08209/FlClash

基于 ClashMeta（mihomo 内核）的全平台代理客户端：Android、Windows、macOS、Linux 一个 App 全搞定，规则分流、代理组、延迟测试、TUN 模式样样齐；订阅链接一键导入，连接、DNS、日志实时可看，WebDAV 备份恢复，Material You 设计，开源无广告。

🔗 直达：https://t.co/roLMj0jNZK

好用、好看、还不塞广告，这才是工具该有的样子。180 星一天，总星 6.4 万+，全平台网络工具一步到位！

🟢🟢🟢🟢🟢

⚠️⚠️
总结：
今天的榜单一句话：AI 在往上卷，工具在往下扎根。移植游戏、软件 Agent 化、资料喂模型、开源写代码、全平台上网，全都有了开源最优解。谁先把这套组合拳装进自己的工作流，谁就先跑赢下一轮！

repos.name: truefoundry/trueforge
repos.description: The open-source agent harness - the runtime layer that turns an LLM into a working agent.

tweet.text:
Prompt, context, harness & loop engineering, clearly explained!

An agent is a while loop with four layers of engineering wrapped around it:

- Prompt engineering
- Context engineering
- Harness engineering
- Loop engineering

Each one wraps the last, and the model sits in the middle, so none of them compete with the others. Instead, they just zoom one level further out.

> Prompt engineering:

This defines the input the model sees on one call, often composed of a role, instructions, examples, and an output format.

The techniques here alter the internal computation and reasoning the model goes through due to the wording it sees:

- Chain-of-thought makes it work in steps before answering
- Few-shot examples define the format and the edge cases
- A JSON schema or XML tags make the output parseable by code
- Self-consistency samples a few chains and takes the majority

> Context engineering:

It's everything the model sees on a turn, not just the prompt. That includes the query, retrieved docs, memory, prior turns, and tool outputs from earlier steps.

The window is finite and fills up fast, so the engineering work is to rank inputs and cut everything that isn't pulling weight.

You do this by:

- Retrieving only the chunks relevant to the query, then reranking them
- Keeping key facts out of the middle, where accuracy drops
- Summarizing old turns, evict stale outputs, push big blobs to files

> Harness engineering:

It's the code around the model that defines the tools, parses the calls, retries on failure, and can route work to sub-agents so one handles retrieval and another handles code.

A verifier then grades the result by running tests, validating a schema, etc.

Prompt and context involve getting one call right. The harness involves everything that has to happen around that call for it to run in a real system.

> Loop engineering:

In the usual setup, you manage the outer loop, i.e, you write a prompt, read the turns the agent runs, write the next prompt, and repeat, while catching failures.

This layer hands that job to the agent itself. It kicks off on a schedule or an event, and runs many turns with no prompt in between.

A loop inherently doesn't know when it's finished. An agent can report that it's done and halt while the tests still fail. So the stop can't be the agent's word, but rather it has to be a real signal, like:

- A turn and token cap to stop stuck runs
- A no-progress detector to catch repeated calls
- A completion check to verify the goal with a separate model or a deterministic test

By this layer, you're operating on the whole run, so the engineering moves from writing each prompt to setting the goal and the stop conditions up front and letting it run.

A longer run also makes the cost of the layers underneath it grow.

When a tool returns a 50K-token response and nothing removes it, the model reads it again on every later call. Over a loop of twenty steps, one response turns into hundreds of thousands of tokens.

I wrote a full breakdown of where an agent's tokens actually go and how a harness keeps context flat, using TrueForge, an open-source harness that turns an LLM into a working agent.

GitHub repo: https://t.co/ZjePhhfKIh

(don't forget to star it ⭐ )

It covers offloading large tool outputs to files, subagents for context isolation, Code Mode for multi-tool joins, and compaction.

It also has a benchmark of three harnesses on the same 14 tasks, where TrueForge reached the same answers on about 40% of the tokens Claude Managed Agents used.

You can read my full article below.

repos.description: Render JSX, HTML, and CSS to images, SVG, PDFs, or a paint tree without a headless browser.

tweet.text:
takumi

Turn JSX, HTML and CSS into images and PDFs without launching a browser

Takumi is a Rust layout engine with text and inline layout ported from Chromium. One layout can feed an Open Graph image, animated GIF, invoice PDF or a paint tree for editable slides.

Stylesheets support complex selectors and media queries. Layout options include Flexbox, CSS Grid, tables and floats. Takumi supports a subset of browser CSS.

PDF text stays selectable and searchable, with font subsets embedded. Headlines can grow or shrink to fill their line box without a measuring loop.

https://t.co/CRcv9A8xZV

tweet.text:
兄弟们，今儿撞上个开源狠角色——UZI-Skill，专往股票底下刨的 AI 投研插件，我翻罢一回，人坐都坐不稳当。

最勾魂的地方，不在把几行代码扔给大模型让它瞎蒙；那种活计，随手揪个 AI 来都能天花乱坠扯上一通。它真正下本的，是把干货一样样备齐了：

1️⃣ 51 位投资大佬的分析框架
2️⃣ 22 维市场数据
3️⃣ 180 条量化规则
4️⃣ 17 种机构分析方法
说白了，跟把格雷厄姆、彼得·林奇、巴菲特、索罗斯、陈小群拉到一张桌上开投研会没两样，专挑一只票往骨子里拆，光脑补一下就来劲儿。

A股、港股、美股，三处都翻得动。贵州茅台、腾讯、苹果往里一填，它扭脸就从基本面、技术面、资金面、情绪面、风险点这几摊各甩一份报告，你也不用再东一榔头西一棒子地摸。

🔗 https://t.co/heQjSmQGsi

tweet.text:
this is f*cking brilliant...

YOU'RE STILL GUESSING HOW MUCH OF YOUR CLAUDE CODE LIMIT IS LEFT WHILE FREE TOOLS ON GITHUB SHOW IT, AND WHAT'S EATING IT, RIGHT IN YOUR TERMINAL.

One shows your limit. One shows your pace. One finds the waste. One keeps you going when you hit the wall.

Here are 13 GitHub projects to stop hitting your Claude Code limit:

SEE YOUR USAGE

01 / ccusage → Daily, weekly and session token reports from your local logs. One command: npx ccusage@latest
https://t.co/NlqHqHSX4F

02 / Claude Code Usage Monitor → Live terminal monitor with forecasts and warnings.
https://t.co/0rfHUd9B3j

03 / claude-usage → Local dashboard with charts and cost estimates, as a web app or a VS Code extension.
https://t.co/C7hITH2tzt

STATUS LINE

04 / claude-pace → 5h and 7d quota in your status line, red when you burn faster than the window allows.
https://t.co/XDPxNJMJCF

05 / Claude Status Bar → Reset countdowns plus a prompt-cache timer that tells you when the next turn pays full price.
https://t.co/WH7NS8a8wa

06 / ccstatusline → Custom status line with model, git branch and token usage.
https://t.co/0efTQoglhJ

ON YOUR DESK

07 / CCSeva → macOS menu bar app with alerts at 70% and 90% of your limit.
https://t.co/lBkzmzgyvG

08 / Claude Code Usage Monitor for Windows → Taskbar widget with usage and reset times.
https://t.co/O1UA1allZL

09 / Clawdmeter → Your limits on a small ESP32 screen next to your keyboard.
https://t.co/mhHh4yzyHe

CUT THE WASTE

10 / unclog → Shows the token cost of every agent, skill and command you installed, and the baseline before you type a word.
https://t.co/lK0mzyrrY0

11 / claude-crusts → Finds files read again and again, unused tool sched files, ranked by tokens saved.
https://t.co/F937CIzqE7

12 / claude-code-usage-analysis → Measures which habits throw your cache away, plus a prompt that checks your own logs.
https://t.co/jiAtQwRFW5

WHEN YOU HIT THE WALL

13 / Claude Code Local → Carries the same conversation on with a local .
https://t.co/ZVZw7mvXyd

Bookmark this. Which tips actually save tokens, tested on 945 runs, is in the article below https://t.co/WUk7rWCYuZ

repos.name: rtk-ai/rtk
repos.description: CLI proxy that reduces LLM token consumption by 60-90% on common dev commands. Single Rust binary, zero dependencies

tweet.text:
10 REPOS DE GITHUB QUE HACEN QUE TU AGENTE GASTE MENOS TOKENS 

Para Claude Code, Codex, Cursor y compañía.

1. caveman: tu agente deja de escribirte un párrafo para decir "listo". Responde corto y el código queda igual. 121.7K estrellas. Apache 2.0.
https://t.co/wZClMAJysF

2. rtk: filtra lo que escupe la terminal (tests, logs, git) antes de que lo lea el agente. Según su README, hasta un 90% menos de salida. 87.2K estrellas. Apache 2.0 y BUSL 1.1.
https://t.co/9SWLfcMKYz

3. ponytail: el agente se pregunta si ese código hace falta antes de escribirlo. En su prueba, un 45% menos de tokens. 195.2K estrellas. MIT.
https://t.co/HekQB3cbEY

4. headroom: comprime logs, JSON y archivos largos antes de mandarlos al modelo. Su README mide entre un 21% y un 57% menos de tokens de entrada. 80.2K estrellas. Apache 2.0.
https://t.co/I7jBiRNUQW

5. codegraph: le da al agente un mapa de tu código para que no abra archivo por archivo. En 7 repos, un 62% menos de tokens según el README. 78.2K estrellas. MIT.
https://t.co/77QF74KUAn

6. Serena: el agente lee la función que necesita, no el archivo entero. 31.5K estrellas. GPL 3.0.
https://t.co/vXCyfc4L9s

7. TokenEconomizer: el de Microsoft. Aprende de tus sesiones pasadas y corta lo que el agente repite. En SWE-Bench, entre un 18.4% y un 30.9% menos de coste. 7.8K estrellas. MIT.
https://t.co/AoqSlNIZ6q

8. TOON: pasa tus JSON a un formato que ocupa menos. En el ejemplo del README, de 117 a 66 tokens. 25.6K estrellas. MIT.
https://t.co/964RFAgwj0

9. MarkItDown: convierte PDF, Word o Excel a Markdown antes de dárselo al agente, en vez de que se trague el archivo entero. 197.1K estrellas. MIT.
https://t.co/Br17HXgqPZ

10. ccusage: te dice en qué día, modelo y sesión se te han ido los tokens y el dinero. 19.5K estrellas. MIT.
https://t.co/wcuPFgSz1a

Automatizaciones y agentes para tu negocio: 
https://t.co/pchlm7F7S5

repos.description: Roblox game boilerplate for AI agents: Rojo, Wally, typed Packet networking, ProfileStore data, strict Luau and an AGENTS.md

tweet.text:
F*ck do it ASAP... if you want Claude to build your ROBLOX game

the trick: one button in Roblox Studio + Claude Code → Claude builds, scripts and playtests inside your open place

no plugin to download, Studio is free. full setup:

step 0 → get Roblox Studio (not the Player) and Claude Code on a paid plan (Pro is $20 a month)

step 1 → in Studio: New Experience → Baseplate, then click MCP in the bottom right corner → turn on Enable Studio as MCP server

step 2 → Quick connect → Claude Code CLI → copy the whole command with the button on the right (the field cuts it off) and run it in your terminal

step 3 → test it: "Call the list_roblox_studios tool." It must answer with your place name. "List my open Roblox Studio windows" can pass with nothing connected

step 4 → one mechanic per prompt. Claude builds it, you playtest it, then the next one

the result: this plane game, town and code, built by Claude inside Studio. the rockets in this clip I asked for today: Claude wrote 3 new scripts, edited 8 and pushed them into my open place

one catch: Claude can't always see the screen during Play, so the last check is you playing it

Save it now. THIS IS  F*CKING WILD.

you're still writing every ROBLOX script and clicking through every playtest by hand while CLAUDE CODE CAN DO MOST OF IT inside Studio.

One tool plugs Claude into Studio. One teaches it Luau. One syncs the code. One checks it. One saves your players' data.

Here are 14 GitHub projects to build Roblox games with Claude Code:

START HERE

https://t.co/qJMq0twDaf

CLAUDE x STUDIO

https://t.co/uMBwPgppkK

SKILLS

03 / Awesome Gamedev Agent Skills → 79 game dev skills for 12 engines, Roblox included, with a router that picks the right ones.
https://t.co/z8Ww2hYnJp

04 / Roblox Dev Skill → 14 guides so Claude writes current Luau, every example tested in a real Studio place.
https://t.co/xbswi5w1nI

05 / roblox-brain → Skill sets for networking, security, saving data, NPCs, camera and UI.
https://t.co/BMxJJHgKKX

CODE OUTSIDE STUDIO

06 / Rojo → Syncs scripts from files into Studio, so Claude edits your game like any code project.
https://t.co/e3DV8TFAc2

07 / Rokit → Installs the right version of every tool in the project.
https://t.co/ReadtOLlGV

CHECKS

repos.name: backnotprop/plannotator
repos.description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.

tweet.text:
OpenAI just put Codex agents on every ChatGPT slowdown. In 3 months they ran 1,700 investigations and found 600+ root causes

Only 70 out of 100 held up in manual review. So a second Codex session tries to prove each diagnosis wrong, and an engineer still merges every fix

OpenAI calls it Performance Factory. An alert opens a task, an agent digs through metrics, traces, profiles and code, and a fresh session plays the skeptic

The fix comes back as a PR. After the deploy, another agent checks whether speed returned to baseline. If it didn't, the case goes back to investigation

Their own line: "Getting fixes right has been harder than finding the cause"

Agents are already good at finding. Fixing still needs a check that can say no and a human on the merge

You can build a small version of this on your own repo with tools trending on GitHub right now:

Jev 应用圈又燃爆了 🔥

gauravlahoti 的 Switchboard 双系统 IT 服务台、gogoymh 的 git 分支插话 Agent、wqx11235 的扫描版数学书公式复核、nihirdhamecha 的 Sift 盲审简历、Akkshar 的 jev-gate 命令风险闸门……全网玩家把 Jev 玩成了下一代「IT 前台 + 插话调度员 + 公式校对员 + 公平 HR + 终端保安」:

1️⃣ gauravlahoti/Switchboard（https://t.co/Len9r7wBQS）

快慢双系统 IT 服务台：Jev 当 System 1，一次调用查完注入攻击和越界请求，再一次调用答完 8 个意图问题，决定直接回、交给 Gemini 处理还是转给真人；Gemini 当 System 2，只在真正需要思考时出场，模型档位也由 Jev 挑。
“护栏每次都跑，贵模型只在值得时出场”！

2️⃣ gogoymh/git-ontology-agent（https://t.co/fICyi1JxD4）

Agent 干活时你随时插话：每个请求开一个 git 分支，由决策模型（可选 TypeSafe Jev）判断这句话是补充条件还是全新问题；补充就只重做受影响的步骤，无关问题另开分支先回答，最后合并回 main，每个结果都能追溯到哪句请求。
“中途加需求，不用推倒重来”！

3️⃣ wqx11235/pdf-math-formula-ocr（https://t.co/vYKrZ2YrRY）

把扫描版数学书变成带真 LaTeX 公式的 Markdown：先用 MiniCPM-OCR 整页解析，再把每个公式单独渲染、交给 Jev 打分，把可疑的挑给人看；作者用 4 本书、3,382 个公式块实测，人工要看的从 100% 降到 34.3%，还老实写了编译检查比 Jev 更稳。
“AI 先过一遍，人只看三分之一”！

4️⃣ nihirdhamecha/sift（https://t.co/O8D2uGxuAt）

用 Jev 给简历打匹配分并建议入围或暂不考虑：默认对 Jev 隐去姓名、邮箱、电话和个人链接，结果只显示编号，点「显示姓名」才揭晓；名字只存在浏览器标签页里，服务器不存、不记日志，可一键部署到 Vercel。
“先看能力，再看名字”！

5️⃣ Akkshar/jev-gate（https://t.co/Hq48rsjb0F）

Claude Code 的命令执行前闸门：只读命令直接放行，rm -rf / 这类灾难命令直接拒绝，force push、sudo 之类先问你，剩下的交给模型打破坏性分数，后端可选本地小分类器、Groq 或 Jev；你点头前先给目录拍快照，同意了也能撤回。
“Agent 敲命令之前，先过保安这一关”！

long-wind

A wuxia action game you can play in your browser with no installation

Play as a swordsman across three chapters: a steppe at golden hour, a bamboo forest in a night storm, and a canal town lit by lanterns. Townsfolk scatter when swords are drawn.

repos.name: LMCache/LMCache
repos.description: LMCache: Supercharge Your LLM with the Fastest KV Cache Layer

tweet.text:
RAG vs. CAG, clearly explained!

RAG is great, but it has a major problem:

every query hits the vector DB. even for static information that hasn't changed in months.

this is expensive, slow, and unnecessary.

Cache-Augmented Generation (CAG) fixes this by letting the model keep static information in its key-value (KV) memory, which is what the model builds internally for every token it reads.

in fact, you can combine RAG and CAG for the best of both worlds.

here's how it works:

RAG + CAG splits your knowledge into two layers.

↳ static data (policies, documentation) gets cached once in the model's KV memory

↳ dynamic data (recent updates, live documents) gets fetched via retrieval

you get faster inference, lower costs, and less repeated work.

the trick is being selective about what you cache.

only cache static, high-value knowledge that rarely changes. cache everything and you'll hit context limits. separating "cold" (cacheable) and "hot" (retrievable) data keeps this system reliable.

you can start today. OpenAI and Anthropic already support prompt caching in their APIs.

one thing to know before you scale it.

prompt caching matches on an exact prefix, byte for byte. your cached layer only gets reused when it sits at the very front of the context in the same order every time.

↳ reorder two cached policy documents and both turn into a miss

↳ cache document A alone and document B alone, then query both, and the second one misses because the model computed its cached state without ever seeing the first

in production this looks like a small fraction of your cached blocks serving almost all the hits. the rest just sits there.

the way out comes from how attention behaves. tokens attend mostly to their own local neighborhood, and only a few reach across document boundaries. CacheBlend recomputes those few and reuses everything else from the separately cached documents.

multi-document queries run two to four times faster, quality holds, and order stops mattering.

it ships in LMCache, which is fully open source.

repo: https://t.co/TXlaLLu04a

(don't forget to star 🌟)

below, i have quoted my article on KV cache management. it covers where prefix caching stops working and how a proper caching layer fixes it.

give it a read.

cheers! :) https://t.co/3DkJWEFHaJ

repos.name: nilbuild/stick-scene
repos.description: Skill to draw stick figure animated visuals

tweet.text:
做产品落地页时，想放一段动画讲清楚功能，找设计师太贵，自己又不会画，最后只能堆几张截图。

stick-scene 是一个给 Agent 用的 Skill，装上之后一句话就能让它照着项目，画出会动的火柴人小场景。

比如拉一下拉杆，数据库就升起来，转动手柄，YAML 进去 JSON 出来，每个场景都把一个功能演成一个小动作。

GitHub：https://t.co/QnXgW2FmYC

它会先读项目，给出两三个创意让我们挑，写完还会逐帧渲染，检查有没有重叠、被截断的地方，最后直接放进页面。

觉得不对直接说「气泡跑出边界了」「再慢一点」「换成品牌绿」就行。每个场景只是一个画布，平时轻轻呼吸、东张西望，滚到眼前才开始演。

这种火柴人风格挺讨巧，比正经的产品演示视频轻松，放在官网首页也不突兀。

英语学习的好东西其实不少，我挑出 6 个真值得存下的，学方法、背单词、练语感、抠发音，这几摊基本都有人管：

English-level-up-tips —— 一份挺齐全的英语自学指南，词汇、听力、口语、写作都有人领路；英语不知道从哪儿下手的，拿它开个头就行。
🔗：https://t.co/Poj6sSQ8AK

Everyone Can Use English —— 李笑来的《人人都能用英语》，它不盯着你背多少词，盯着的是英语怎么才算真「用起来」。
🔗：https://t.co/0OWEIHF9sT

Qwerty Learner —— 把背单词和打字拧成一股绳，手指在键盘上敲着，词也就进了脑子，程序员、键盘党用着最顺。
🔗：https://t.co/PrH72GfvMO

Earthworm —— 借游戏的手法学英语，连词成句一遍遍来过，语感跟肌肉记忆就这么磨出来了。

🔗：https://t.co/YBZWHR4w7q

Anki —— 开源的记忆利器，主动回忆配着间隔重复跟遗忘掰手腕，背单词只是它最拿不出手的活儿。
🔗：https://t.co/kje2CO5vgr

book-to-skill 这个开源项目有点嚼头。

它干的活儿不绕弯子：一本书进去，出来就成了 AI 能调用的 Skill。

PDF、EPUB、DOCX 这类资料丢进去，内容它自己拆：章节归章节、核心知识归核心知识，术语、方法论也一并理成结构化的 Skill。往后 AI 再碰上相关问题，几百页的书不必每回重塞一遍，对的知识它自己调出来使。

能这么折腾的不止书，论文、技术手册、公司内部文档，也是同样的路子。

从前那叫“让 AI 读书”。如今更像是：啃完一本，就给 AI 永久挂上一项技能。

repos.name: c410979729-bit/scope-recall-hermes
repos.description: Local long-term memory for Hermes, Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy and dsh agents: SQLite truth, source-backed recall and rebuildable vector companions.

tweet.text:
Hermes 插件生态又燃爆了 🔥

c410979729-bit 的 Scope Recall 跨 Agent 记忆库、Chrisyk 的 commons 共享技能库、tenuo-ai 的 Hermes Guests 访客授权、LangerSword 的 Klieg 动效工坊、haroon0x 的 hermes-dsh 遥控 DeepSeek Harness……全网玩家把 Hermes 玩成了下一代「全家共用记忆 + 技能中央厨房 + 访客门禁 + 动画工作室 + Agent 调度台」:

1️⃣ c410979729-bit/scope-recall-hermes（https://t.co/x05646gyd7）

给 Hermes、Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、WorkBuddy、DeepSeek Harness 一套本地记忆：SQLite 保存原始对话，模型提炼的事实和向量都能追溯、能重建；不配模型也能先用原文检索，Agent 之间还能交接任务。
“换哪个 Agent 干活，记忆都跟着你走”！

2️⃣ Chrisyk/hermes-commons（https://t.co/2stDXoxPNV）

多个 Hermes 档案共用一个活的技能库：一个 Agent 修好的坑，其他 Agent 下一轮就生效；作者自己 4 个档案查出 246 个技能有 53 个不同版本、42 个真冲突；先出合并方案你确认再改，改前全备份，每次修改都记进 git，单个技能可查日志、可撤销。
“一处修好，全队升级”！

3️⃣ tenuo-ai/hermes-guests（https://t.co/BB7EZQxifg）

把你的 Hermes 分享给访客、家人和同事：他们用自己的 Telegram 跟你的 Bot 聊，只能用你批准的工具，时间到了权限自动失效；每份权限都是只有你能签的限时凭证，模型没法自己扩权，想多要权限会先来问你。
“周末来客人？前门和空调借他用到周日 5 点”！

4️⃣ LangerSword/hermes-klieg（https://t.co/kJLDqoQXXq）

给 Hermes 一双做动效的手：动态文字、转场、字幕条、Logo 片头、循环动画，在本地直接渲染成 MP4/GIF，不需要任何 API Key；后台任务挂着跑，以磁盘上真实产出的文件为准验收，最后封存结果，事后能证明没被改过。
“Agent 不只会描述动画，现在能亲手做出来”！

5️⃣ haroon0x/hermes-dsh（https://t.co/AEO6AjO9m9）

在 Hermes 里直接驱动 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent：一次性任务丢出去就跑，长会话支持多轮对话、随时取消、审批和模型设置，还能并行派出多个 Agent，用的是 dsh 自己的工具、沙箱和会话状态。
“Hermes 当总指挥，DeepSeek 军团听调遣”！

🔥 不可思议，微调后的 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B，在 PCB 布局规划上竟然干过了 Opus 5.5

作者拿 245 个开源电路板，微调了 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B，再用 23 块没见过的板子盲测

首先说明一下
它不负责画线，只负责规划：哪些元件放一起、电源线多宽、地线怎么铺
具体摆放和走线交给自动布线工具，所有模型用的是同一套工具，比的只是规划能力

· 微调 Qwen：83% / 48%
· Gemini 4 Carbon：70% / 39%
· Claude Opus 5.5：65% / 30%
· GPT-6.1 Sol Pro：30% / 13%

微调前的 Qwen，23 块板子一块都跑不通
人类工程师的原版设计，零错误率也只有 30%

2、还更快：每块板 Qwen 平均 60 秒，Opus 5.5 要 118 秒

⚠️ 最后说明
· 其他模型没针对这个任务训练过，不算完全公平
· GPT 有 16 块板卡住或超时，成绩偏低
· 测试只有 23 块板，离直接打样还有距离

tweet.text:
🤖 解放双手！pywinauto 能让 Python 替你在 Windows 软件里点按钮、填表单、把数据读出来。

pywinauto 在 GitHub 上 6400 多 star，近八百个 fork，五百多个 issue 还开着，是真有一大批人拿它干活。今年 10 月刚发了 1.0 的测试版，离上一个正式版本隔了一年九个月。

最典型的场景：公司那套老旧的 Windows 客户端没有 API，每天要把一堆记录一条条点进去、再复制出来。以前只能人肉重复，或者写按屏幕坐标点击的脚本，窗口一挪位置就全乱。

有意思的是，README 里自称这是个业余项目，新功能都是下班时间写的，最早的版本出自 Mark Mc Mahon 之手。

🟢🟢🟢🟢

5. nginx/nginx

全球最流行的 Web 服务器官方开源仓库：高性能负载均衡、反向代理、API 网关、内容缓存一把抓，2 条款 BSD 类许可免费用；11 月 18 日刚同时发布 1.31.9 和 1.30.7 两个新版本。

🟢🟢🟢🟢🟢

⚠️⚠️
总结：
今天的榜单一句话：上层 AI 越来越卷，底层工具越来越硬。笔记、修 CI、做视频、跑推理、扛流量，全都有了开源最优解。谁先把这套组合拳装进自己的工作流，谁就先跑赢下一轮！

This is f*cking gold, you can build a full second brain for free with 10 GitHub repos, and most people still pay for apps that do half of it

One system that saves everything you find, connects every idea and answers any question about your own life and work

These 10 repos build it, in the order you'll use them, from saving to searching ↓

-> karakeep (by karakeep-app)
https://t.co/mol41jqOIk
save links, notes and images in one place, with AI tags added for you

-> firecrawl (by firecrawl)
https://t.co/4RCIij2ody
turns any website into clean markdown, so articles land in your vault ready to read

-> ArchiveBox (by ArchiveBox)
https://t.co/Db7CwNoGRT
keeps a permanent copy of every page you save, even when the original disappears

-> paperless-ngx (by paperless-ngx)
https://t.co/PfhkzzlX6e
scans your documents and makes every one of them searchable

-> zotero (by zotero)
https://t.co/sLI36uyTp0
collects your sources and papers and cites them with one click

-> logseq (by logseq)
https://t.co/2fH4iKiIbU
an open source outliner with backlinks, so every note links to the ones around it

-> foam (by foambubble)
https://t.co/6NKzgGAZrt
a linked note vault inside VS Code, plain markdown files you own

-> LightRAG (by HKUDS)
https://t.co/dYLCo0aYKL
a fast graph based search over your notes, so you ask in plain words and get the answer

-> graphrag (by microsoft)
https://t.co/Jmwe5u5FGF
turns your text into a knowledge graph, so you see how your ideas connect

-> cognee (by topoteretes)
https://t.co/sio7jIifi1
gives your AI agents a memory built from your own data

save it, connect it, search it
that's the whole second brain

tweet.text:
xiaozhi-esp32

Talk to your ESP32 and control physical devices through MCP

This C++ chatbot uses models such as Qwen and DeepSeek for voice interaction. Device-side MCP controls speakers, LEDs, servos, and GPIO. Cloud-side MCP adds smart-home control, PC desktop operation, knowledge search, and email.

It supports offline wake-up and customizable wake words. Supported hardware can handle realtime full-duplex voice interaction.

Beginners can flash prebuilt firmware without setting up a development environment. It connects to the official https://t.co/UEBt9SHYQD server by default.

repos.description: Photoreal Blender scenes from a one-paragraph brief, built by AI agents: image→3D props on fal, scripted layout, lighting, camera and grade.

tweet.text:
I remade one of my favorite shots from Blade Runner from scratch in blender with AI. Here's how. 

i used AnyScene to build the set and AnyMachine to hard-surface model the vehicles: 

- i started from one still and had the camera solved from the picture itself: horizon, vanishing point. i went with a 35mm lens sitting about half a metre off the ground.
- i had the street grey-boxed to that camera first, and didn't let anything else in until it lined up with the still.
- i wanted every vehicle (the hauler, the buses, the searchlight aircraft) built properly, so each one started as a design sheet and then got modelled part by part with anymachine.
- for the people, i generated images and turned them into 3d meshes.
- then i went through 24 passes: render, compare with the still, call out what's wrong, fix. i threw out the post-processing along the way. the final frame is straight out of cycles at 512 samples, and the grain is just render noise.

the tools didn't direct the shot, and that is the important part. working out where the camera sat. one hard searchlight against soft glows melting into the fog. snow dust kicked up in the foreground. all the little details matter, and none of them come from one prompt. it comes from hours of iteration and proper art direction and years of art experience. 

i know color theory really well because i've painted in acrylic and digital for years. i know composition really well because i've written, directed and shot animated films a lot. 

this all paired with my experience as an engineer make results like these possible really quickly. 

both repos are open if you want to build your own:
https://t.co/0rb1MC3hzo
https://t.co/omB0ehdlsD

tweet.text:
🪛 压图、剪视频、合并 PDF 再也不用到处找在线网站了，OmniTools 把这些小工具全装进了一个能自己部署的网页里。

OmniTools 在 GitHub 揽获 1 万多 star，HelloGitHub 也收录了它。

平时想把图片缩个尺寸、把一段视频裁短、把两份 PDF 合成一份，流程基本都是：搜个在线工具网站，忍着满屏广告上传文件，再祈祷它别把你的合同和证件照留在服务器上。

OmniTools 的思路正好反过来：文件全部在你自己的浏览器里处理，数据不离开设备。图片缩放和转换、视频裁剪和倒放、PDF 拆分和合并，再加上 JSON、CSV、XML 这些数据工具，常用的都在一个页面里。

想给团队一起用，就拿 Docker 自己部署一份，镜像才 28MB 左右，很轻。界面也有中文，只是翻译目前完成了七成左右。

收藏夹里那一堆格式转换网站，可以清一清了。

1. Scrapy
Classic Python crawling framework. Choose this when you need to crawl thousands of pages on a schedule.

https://t.co/dYU5UOfxJ9

Converts any website into clean, LLM-ready Markdown. Filters menus and footers, supports MCP, Apache 2.0.

https://t.co/NiBk4Rak8O

3. Playwright MCP
Microsoft's MCP server that allows LLM to run in-browser via structured accessibility snapshots, so you don't need screenshots or visual models. https://t.co/vbeNT60Cw5

4. Oxylabs Web API MCP
Connects Cloud Code, Codex, or Cloud Desktop to the Oxylabs Web API so your agent can pull live web data from within a chat. Use a hosted server or host it yourself. Requires an Oxylabs Web API key.

https://t.co/OIlRFypLDe

5. Browser Use
A Python library that allows the AI agent to run a browser to complete tasks. Bring your own LLM. MIT licensed.

https://t.co/kqvG8Svs9b

6. Stagehand
An SDK for the browser agent that includes three primitives: Act, Extract, and Observe. You write steps in plain English, and Extract returns schema-validated data. https://t.co/6Tq8Bc9ppR

7. ScrapeGraphAI
Specify what you want in a prompt and create an LLM scraping pipeline. Works with local models via Ollama.

https://t.co/mUoHg20frD

8. Trafilatura
Extracts main text, metadata, and comments from raw HTML. Outputs Markdown, JSON, CSV, or XML. Good for cleaning pages before RAG.

https://t.co/lzMUYlqA1M

9. MarkItDown
Microsoft's tool for converting PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, and more to Markdown for LLMs.

https://t.co/5Yvio0YkxI

repos.name: Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo
repos.description: Bring PS5 GTA6 to 120FPS with DLSS 5. An advanced Windows video player and capture enhancement tool featuring real-time preview for videos, images, and capture card sources. Combine AI-powered Super Resolution, DLSS5 image enhancement, and Frame Generation to deliver a next-generation visual experience.

tweet.text:
ok this is actually useful... you play GTA VI, an agent turns your session into a ready X clip in seconds

no editing by hand. you drop the recording in a folder and it does the rest

here's what it did with a 23 second drive, step by step:

step 1 → read the file: 1920x1080, 30 fps, 23.3 s, found 2 scene cuts

step 2 → measured motion for every second of footage and loudness for every second of audio

step 3 → scored all 13 possible 12 second windows and picked the best one, 1.0 to 13.0 s

step 4 → cut it to 9:16, 1080x1920, put a hook on the first 2.5 seconds, encoded in 12.8 s

step 5 → dropped it into a ready folder. nothing gets posted until I say yes

every number in the log on the video is real output from the run, not a fake terminal

the tools behind it → ffmpeg for scene detect, motion and the cut, ebur128 for loudness. all free

one thing it couldn't do yet: captions. whisper wasn't installed, so it skipped that step and said so in the log

full prompt in the comments, paste it into Grok Bot and point it at your recordings

bookmark this before your next session holy sh*t, this needs to be done ASAP... GTA VI on your PC is already possible

one open source app from GitHub + your RTX card and the game shows up on your monitor at up to 240 FPS

zero mods, zero cracks, nothing to pay for. here's the whole setup:

step 1 → make sure your rig fits: Windows 11, RTX 40 or 50 series, a 120 Hz+ monitor, PC and PS5 both on cable

step 2 → grab Veyra-NRVideo from GitHub: https://t.co/uX8Ii15rts, open Releases, take the NVIDIA build, unzip and run it. free and open source

step 3 → pair your PS5 through Remote Play: console IP, Account ID and the 8-digit code from the PS5 menu. run the first test with all effects off

step 4 → go to Professional → List and pick NVIDIA VFG. your GPU draws AI frames between the real ones, so 30 FPS from the console turns into 240 on screen. cap the output at your monitor's Hz

step 5 → want a sharper picture with less delay? run HDMI into a capture card instead of streaming, turn HDCP off, set 2160p at 60 Hz

what you get: the smoothest GTA VI you've seen, on a screen you already have. both pages below have every setting

one thing to know: the game still runs on a PS5, yours or a friend's, bookmark this before it gets buried

https://t.co/Feskmjti0M

https://t.co/fhuGp1CZ85

https://t.co/FZZS9jcqNe

18. Synfig → ساخت انیمیشن دوبعدی با سیستم Bone و بدون نیاز به انیمیشن‌سازی فریم‌به‌فریم.
https://t.co/ZQ5GvSkuga

https://t.co/DqarEZLJ4e

https://t.co/AP4XQOKx9C

Prompt → Animate → 3D → AI → Render

Switch between pixel art and ASCII while exploring a dungeon

Zorbash is a turn based dungeon crawler where the goal is to survive and keep resisting on a planet overrun with lava. It includes a bestiary of monsters and creatures, along with multiple weapons.

Preview 43+ CSS transitions, then copy them into your project

Each card shows a different interaction with a reusable CSS snippet. The playground lets you adjust timing, distance and easing before using a transition.

Snippets are self-contained, with scoped classes and support for reduced motion preferences.

A skill for Cursor, Claude Code and Codex brings the snippets into AI coding workflows.

It is generated from the showcase, so the examples stay in sync.

repos.name: smixs/agent-second-brain
repos.description: An always-on second brain you talk to. Voice notes in Telegram → typed, linked knowledge in your Obsidian vault. Runs 24/7 on the Claude subscription you already have.

tweet.text:
This is f*cking insane, the CEO of Y Combinator put his own second brain on GitHub for free and most people still don't know it exists

8 second brain repos most people haven't seen yet:

-> gbrain (by garrytan)
https://t.co/cncTyV6CRn
the YC CEO's own second brain, every fact is stored with its source and all your agents share one memory

-> llm wiki (by karpathy)
https://t.co/Z0iGVi6sI9
the idea file where this whole approach started

-> claude-mem (by thedotmack)
https://t.co/h2PzD4y2ey
remembers what Claude Code did in past sessions and brings it back in the next one

-> agent second brain (by smixs)
https://t.co/eNkyXXalyk
send a voice note in Telegram and it turns into a linked note in your Obsidian vault

-> supermemory (by supermemoryai)
https://t.co/12jPS8ZQ3a
a memory layer for your agents, so they remember you across every tool

-> basic memory (by basicmachines-co)
https://t.co/rRGN4RteKi
gives Claude a memory built from plain markdown files you can open and edit in Obsidian

-> qmd (by tobi)
https://t.co/cuL1B2pGwC
searches all your markdown notes locally, so your agent finds the right note in seconds

-> obsidian skills (by kepano)
https://t.co/lonWXdfFdE
teaches your agent to read and write Obsidian notes the right way

his second brain is one clone away
yours is still scattered across five apps

City4CFD

Watertight city geometry for microscale urban flow simulations

City4CFD builds terrain from point clouds and reconstructs buildings from 2D polygons and point clouds.

It adds surfaces such as green areas, water, and roads, then integrates buildings and surfaces into watertight geometry.

You can tune the geometry’s complexity and define the zone of influence and domain boundaries automatically or manually.

Export formats include OBJ, STL, and CityJSON.

tweet.text:
holy f*ck, a 16-year-old cs student in china reportedly figured out how to run 300 grok bots for less than $0.02 per bot per week.

the same swarm would reportedly cost $4,500 per week without his optimizations.

his secret wasn’t a cheaper model.

he removed the waste:

→ stopped pointless status checks.

→ stopped rereading full chat histories.

→ killed endless retry loops.

→ kept bots idle until real work arrived.

here are 20 github repos behind the strategy:

1. markitdown
→ converts PDFs, office files, and HTML into clean markdown.
https://t.co/My1sCXTwPQ

2. LLMLingua
→ compresses long prompts while preserving important facts and instructions.
https://t.co/U9XO65qXia

3. Firecrawl
→ extracts web pages into markdown or structured data.
https://t.co/4aVbyZpEei

4. RTK
→ compresses terminal output so repetitive logs don’t consume context.
https://t.co/vHFnuDXcrd

5. Chonkie
→ splits large documents into chunks for efficient retrieval.
https://t.co/fzd720eqQm

6. FlagEmbedding
→ reranks retrieved passages so relevant information reaches the model.
https://t.co/kteOtDPAT7

7. Mem0
→ retrieves useful memories across runs instead of replaying entire conversations.
https://t.co/cxB96lzKGW

8. Prefect
→ caches successful task results to avoid rerunning completed work.
https://t.co/vzzRs8t8eP

9. GPTCache
→ reuses cached answers for similar requests instead of generating again.
https://t.co/4mLNMKE7jJ

10. Graphiti
→ stores changing facts in a searchable knowledge graph.
https://t.co/bEVVM8BBXU

11. Portkey Gateway
→ provides shared API caching and controls for connected workflows.
https://t.co/8RKVlc5O27

12. Hishel
→ caches HTTP responses to avoid repeated downloads.
https://t.co/wKVnRmjF4p

13. Celery
→ runs background jobs through worker queues.
https://t.co/PZBsnx8qaK

14. Requests-Cache
→ stores fetched responses so scripts can reuse valid data.
https://t.co/adkLAmRBR4

15. APScheduler
→ schedules lightweight checks and batches routine work.
https://t.co/2pu2HmowsX

16. RouteLLM
→ sends simple requests to cheaper models and complex ones to stronger models.
https://t.co/9T3cK8XIIo

17. Phoenix
→ traces AI workflows and exposes repeated calls.
https://t.co/8AJZ8AQLK9

18. PyBreaker
→ stops repeated calls to services that keep failing.
https://t.co/2fC7BlGgQo

19. Semantic Router
→ routes requests to predefined workflows without using a large model for every decision.
https://t.co/AHRrKpK8g3

20. LiteLLM
→ tracks API spending and sets budgets to prevent runaway costs.
https://t.co/1dKnncvkgc

how to put these ideas together:

don’t install all 20 just because they’re listed.

start by finding where your agent wastes resources:

1. filter before reading
    → convert, chunk, and compress inputs before sending them to the model.
2. reuse before generating
    → cache research, API responses, and completed tasks.
3. check for changes
    → schedule lightweight checks instead of repeatedly asking agents to inspect everything.
4. route intelligently
    → use cheaper models for simple tasks and stronger models when needed.
5. stop failed loops
    → use retries, timeouts, and circuit breakers to prevent endless API calls.
6. measure everything
    → track API spending, tool usage, and completed work.

connect the tools through code, MCP, or the terminal. route API calls through the gateway whose controls you want to use.

the real lesson: optimizing AI agents isn’t just about choosing cheaper models. it’s about making sure they only spend money when there’s actual work to do.

7. Mem0
→ retrieves useful memories across runs instead of replaying entire conversations.
https://t.co/cxB96lzKGW

8. Prefect
→ caches successful task results to avoid rerunning completed work.
https://t.co/vzzRs8t8eP

9. GPTCache
→ reuses cached answers for similar requests instead of generating again.
https://t.co/4mLNMKE7jJ

10. Graphiti
→ stores changing facts in a searchable knowledge graph.
https://t.co/bEVVM8BBXU

11. Portkey Gateway
→ provides shared API caching and controls for connected workflows.
https://t.co/8RKVlc5O27

12. Hishel
→ caches HTTP responses to avoid repeated downloads.
https://t.co/wKVnRmjF4p

13. Celery
→ runs background jobs through worker queues.

14. Requests-Cache

15. APScheduler
→ schedules lightweight checks and batches routine work.

→ sends simple requests to cheaper models and complex ones to stronger models.

    → track API spending, tool usage, and completed work.

برای حل این مشکل، یک Skill مستقل با عنوان Independent Review ساخته شده که کمک می‌کنه قبل از جدی گرفتن هر ایراد، اهمیت واقعی اون مشخص بشه.

اما در دور دهم، با استفاده از روش جدید:

- ۱۱ مورد گزارش شد.

اگر با Claude Code یا ابزارهای AI برای توسعه نرم‌افزار کار می‌کنی، این Skill می‌تونه جلوی ساعت‌ها اصلاح غیرضروری رو بگیره.

repos.description: Heads-up no-limit Texas hold'em against TypeSafe Jev. The local engine deals and settles; Jev answers typed questions, and code composes the bet.

tweet.text:
Jev 应用圈又燃爆了 🔥

lawsirlawsir-png 的 Jev 德州扑克、MatthewRuizDiaz 的一句话语音控 Mac、kayyoo-naru 的审计级个人账本、jimbanks 的 Meta 广告库收藏夹、bebecap 的跨厂商模型调度……全网玩家把 Jev 玩成了下一代「牌桌对手 + 语音遥控器 + 私人审计师 + 广告情报员 + 模型调度台」:

1️⃣ lawsirlawsir-png/jev-holdem（https://t.co/9LPXuEAPor）

和 Jev 打一对一无限注德州：本地引擎负责发牌、比牌、算底池赔率和合法动作，Jev 只回答一组固定的类型化问题，比如牌力打分、听牌价值、牌面危险度、要不要诈唬，再由代码组合成跟注、加注或全下；接口挂了也会用本地规则继续打。
“AI 不聊天，照样坐上牌桌”！

2️⃣ MatthewRuizDiaz/voicecom-jev（https://t.co/UEpnxRuiGe）

按住一个键说一句话，Mac 一口气执行好几条命令：语音在本机转文字，拆成几步、会不会丢数据、你说的是哪个按钮，全交给 Jev 判断；把握 80% 以上直接跑，40%~80% 先问你，咳嗽和「嗯……」直接忽略；作者实测 1 组问题 0.10 秒、15 组 0.16 秒。
“一句话分屏开 App，键盘都不用碰”！

3️⃣ kayyoo-naru/jev-ledger（https://t.co/2se4ysQZwh）

把银行流水变成个人利润表、资产负债表和现金流，外加内控报告和每个数字的审计轨迹：Jev 只判断每笔交易归哪一行、是不是自己账户间转账，算数和核对全交给代码；金额越大要求的把握越高，1,000 以上一律交你复核。
“AI 负责判断，会计规则负责把关”！

4️⃣ jimbanks/ad-library-saver（https://t.co/Z8XiQYVw8e）

刷 Meta 广告库时自动把看到的广告存进扩展里的数据库，Jev 给每条打上格式、行动号召和漏斗阶段标签，一键导出 CSV；不填 key 也能存和导出，打标签才需要自己的 TypeSafe key。
“刷一遍对手广告，情报表自动出来”！

5️⃣ bebecap/frontier-orchestration（https://t.co/GZCGwAWEDS）

高风险任务的跨厂商调度技能：Jev 给每个任务挑 Claude、Codex 还是 Gemini，结果再交给另一家的模型复核；作者实测 Jev 选模型准确率 1.00、本地规则只有 0.60，每次决策约 0.2 秒，20 个任务里 12 个分给了更便宜的档位。
“谁来干、谁来审，交给 Jev 拍板”！

（以上均为社区作品，非 TypeSafe 官方出品）

1️⃣ lawsirlawsir-png/jev-holdem（https://t.co/9LPXuEAPor）

和 Jev 打一对一无限注德州：本地引擎负责发牌、比牌、算底池赔率和合法动作，Jev 只回答一组固定的类型化问题，比如牌力打分、听牌价值、牌面危险度、要不要诈唬，再由代码组合成跟注、加注或全下；接口挂了也会用本地规则继续打。
“AI 不聊天，照样坐上牌桌”！

2️⃣ MatthewRuizDiaz/voicecom-jev（https://t.co/UEpnxRuiGe）

按住一个键说一句话，Mac 一口气执行好几条命令：语音在本机转文字，拆成几步、会不会丢数据、你说的是哪个按钮，全交给 Jev 判断；把握 80% 以上直接跑，40%~80% 先问你，咳嗽和「嗯……」直接忽略；作者实测 1 组问题 0.10 秒、15 组 0.16 秒。
“一句话分屏开 App，键盘都不用碰”！

3️⃣ kayyoo-naru/jev-ledger（https://t.co/2se4ysQZwh）

把银行流水变成个人利润表、资产负债表和现金流，外加内控报告和每个数字的审计轨迹：Jev 只判断每笔交易归哪一行、是不是自己账户间转账，算数和核对全交给代码；金额越大要求的把握越高，1,000 以上一律交你复核。
“AI 负责判断，会计规则负责把关”！

4️⃣ jimbanks/ad-library-saver（https://t.co/Z8XiQYVw8e）

刷 Meta 广告库时自动把看到的广告存进扩展里的数据库，Jev 给每条打上格式、行动号召和漏斗阶段标签，一键导出 CSV；不填 key 也能存和导出，打标签才需要自己的 TypeSafe key。
“刷一遍对手广告，情报表自动出来”！

5️⃣ bebecap/frontier-orchestration（https://t.co/GZCGwAWEDS）

高风险任务的跨厂商调度技能：Jev 给每个任务挑 Claude、Codex 还是 Gemini，结果再交给另一家的模型复核；作者实测 Jev 选模型准确率 1.00、本地规则只有 0.60，每次决策约 0.2 秒，20 个任务里 12 个分给了更便宜的档位。
“谁来干、谁来审，交给 Jev 拍板”！

（以上均为社区作品，非 TypeSafe 官方出品）

Office 2003 那套菜单栏和工具栏，我到现在还记得「格式」菜单底下有哪些东西。

tweet.text:
想练又舍不得请私教的人，GitHub 上有个项目正对胃口：2.3万 Star，AI 教练也一并配齐了。

最让人痛快的是数据攥在自己手上，用不着月月给健身 App 交会员费。

tweet.text:
Pokedex

See how Android architecture guidance fits together in a Kotlin app

An Android reference project built around Google's architecture guidance, MVVM, and the Repository pattern. The UI sends user events to the data layer, which exposes data as streams.

Offline use comes first in the data layer, following a single source of truth. Room handles persistence, Hilt provides dependency injection, and Coroutines and Flow handle asynchronous work.

Modular builds can run in parallel to reduce build time.

repos.description: Claude Guardian is an all-in-one Claude account safety and risk prevention skill.Claude防封实战 It intelligently assesses your device, account history, network environment, and payment options, then provides personalized guidance for local, VPS, or virtual machine setups.

tweet.text:
Claude 动不动就 403、被封号，用久了心里难免发毛；GitHub 上这个开源 Skill，就是冲着这些烦心事来的

它叫 Claude-Guardian，眼下 1.3K Star 挂着，专门把账号侧和上网环境侧那些埋雷的地方翻出来过一遍。

实用功能摆在这儿：

1、检查代理出口、DNS 泄漏、IPv4/IPv6 等网络问题。
2、提供账号注册、订阅支付、使用习惯等风险建议。
3、支持 Mac、Windows、虚拟机和 VPS 多种部署路线。
4、遇到 403、429、529 报错，还能辅助诊断原因。

最省心的一手，是直接甩给 Codex，一步一步点着查，环境哪里不对，它替你指出来。

丑话也搁在这儿：没有哪件工具敢担保账号一定封不掉。

🔗：https://t.co/Lgup4A50c0

repos.description: NVIDIA Auto Ontology's semantic layer and a personal knowledge base as an MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients. No LLM API key needed.

tweet.text:
🗄️ 跟大家安利一个 Auto Ontology MCP，接上之后 Claude、ChatGPT 能先看懂你的数据库再替你查数，模型 API 密钥一个都不用配。

Auto Ontology MCP 把 NVIDIA Auto Ontology 的语义层搬进了任意 MCP 客户端，Apache-2.0 协议，11 月 6 日才建仓，已经有六十多个 fork。

让 AI 直接写 SQL 的老问题是：它不认识你的表，列名猜错、表连错、百分比和小数混着用，查出来的数看着像那么回事，其实是错的。

Auto Ontology MCP 先把库的结构、数据分布和键关系抽出来建成一份本体，AI 写好的 SQL 要先过一遍检查：有没有不存在的列、本体里没有的连接、一对多导致的重复计数，再试跑。连你的数据库全程只读，SQL 守卫、只读连接、事务回滚三层兜底，默认 30 秒超时、最多回 500 行。理解和写 SQL 这些活儿交给客户端里的模型，服务器只管确定性的部分，所以不用另配密钥。

它还顺手带了个个人知识库，可以导出成带双链和图谱的 Obsidian 库，对应 Karpathy 说的 LLM Wiki 模式。

要留意两点：数据源连接串连密码一起明文存在本机，MySQL 和 DuckDB 还没在真实服务器上测过。

让 AI 查数之前先把你的数据吃透，错的数比没有数更可怕。

GitHub：https://t.co/V0YpR8iZwL

repos.name: logitcai/tinybrain
repos.description: A Chinese-first small language model built from scratch: open 60B-token dataset, tokenizer, mHC + Engram + MoE model, pretraining through RL, all in PyTorch. 从零做中文小模型，数据和代码全部开源

tweet.text:
🌱 后生可畏，tinybrain 把一个中文小模型从数据集、分词器一路做到强化学习，代码和数据全部开源。

tinybrain 的作者在 GitHub 简介里写着自己是一名中学生，11 月 19 日刚在 ModelScope 放出 Small 和 Medium 两个对话研究权重。

学大模型的人大多卡在同一个地方：教程要么只讲原理，要么直接甩一个训好的权重，中间数据怎么攒、分词器怎么训、预训练和对齐怎么接起来，全是黑箱。

tinybrain 把这条链路整个摊开了：数据集来自 26 个公开来源，按 nano、mini、base、full 分四档，最大一档约 600 亿 token；分词器、模型结构、SFT、多老师蒸馏，到 GRPO 一类的强化学习，全在一个仓库里。按 README 的实测速度，一张 RTX 5070 Ti 16GB 预训练最小一档约 4 小时，mini 档约 20 小时，普通玩家也够得着。

别指望拿它当聊天助手，README 写得很实在：90 道开发题每题答两次，Small 可用回答 13/180，Medium 29/180，定位就是研究权重。

想看懂大模型是怎么从零长出来的，这个仓库比十篇科普都管用。

GitHub：https://t.co/hXJFLewKCx

repos.name: incoai/splash
repos.description: A local inference engine for Apple silicon, built around the model.

tweet.text:
用 Claude Code、Codex 写代码，API 账单越跑越吓人，想换本地模型，又嫌跑得太慢，Agent 等半天才吐出一句。

Splash 是一个给苹果芯片 Mac 做的开源本地推理引擎，把模型跑在自己电脑上，再一条命令把 Claude Code 或 Codex 接过去，不用再按量付 API 费用。

速度是它主打的，同样的 27B 模型、同样的量化权重，在 M5 Pro 上每秒能出 74 个 token，llama.cpp 只有 16 个，快了四倍多。

GitHub：https://t.co/x56qHpOHCS

背后的办法是先让一个小模型猜后面几个词，再由大模型一次核对，加上专门给苹果显卡写的计算代码，内存也是自动规划的。

支持 Qwen3.8-27B、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 这些模型，能看图、能调工具，自带聊天页面。芯片要 M3 或更新，24 GB 内存的 Mac 也能跑小一点的版本。

手上有台 M3 以上大内存 Mac 的，拿它跑 Claude Code 写写小项目挺划算，电费比 API 账单便宜多了。

tweet.text:

MerkyorLynn 的边做边压上下文、HugoLopes45 的 lmsk 密钥替身、ming-kang 的水水獭浏览器 Agent、hiennguyen9874 的 IPython 内核模式、heohlee 的 pi-yt 终端听歌……全网玩家把 Pi 玩成了下一代「上下文瘦身教练 + 密钥保镖 + 浏览器管家 + Python 实验室 + 写码 BGM 电台」:

“模型看到的全是替身，密钥一个不外泄”！

基于 Pi Durable 的浏览器 Agent 扩展，Chromium、Firefox 都能装：对话、工具调用和任务进度都会保存，浏览器重启后接着干；能读页面、点元素、管标签页，改页面前可以要你确认，每个对话还有独立文件区能跑 JavaScript。
“关掉浏览器，任务也不会断”！

4️⃣ hiennguyen9874/pi-ipython（https://t.co/VYvpu1Jpln）

让模型只用一个工具 ipython 干活：代码发进整场会话都在跑的 Python 内核，变量、函数、import 跨步保留，压缩对话后也还在；作者把安全写在最前面，内核不是沙盒，可以开「每段代码先给你审」。
“把 Pi 变成一个会自己写 Notebook 的 Agent”！

5️⃣ heohlee/pi-yt（https://t.co/uAXGycVmwi）

在 Pi 里放你自己的 YouTube 歌单：用浏览器里已登录的会话读推荐、历史、稍后观看、点赞和播放列表，yt-dlp 取流、mpv 后台播放，支持随机、队列、拖进度，状态栏一直显示正在播什么。
“写代码的 BGM，也交给 Agent 了”！

repos.name: canton-foundation/cips
repos.description: Canton CIPs

tweet.text:
https://t.co/bpTWCKzoU7

Canton NFT proposal (CIP-276) -

What it is

Canton's token rules were built for coins, where every unit is identical, like dollars. @fairmint wants a standard way to handle one-of-a-kind items, like a share certificate, a licence or a specific claim.

Think NFTs for serious finance, not pictures.

How it works -

They reuse the existing coin rules instead of building something new. 
Each item becomes its own "coin" with a supply of exactly one. 
That means wallets and apps that already handle Canton tokens can handle these without much extra work.

Items can also be locked to one owner forever ("soulbound"), like a diploma.

How a proposal becomes a rule
Someone writes it up and posts it publicly (Fairmint, in October).

People review it and point out problems. That's happening now.

A Super Validator, one of the big network operators, agrees to sponsor it. Five North stepped up on Nov 16.

The Super Validators vote on it. 
There's no date yet.
Apps start using it. Fairmint goes first with company share certificates.

The pushback -

Everyone agrees it's a good direction, but one reviewer raised some problems:
Every item gets its own line in the asset list, which gets messy at thousands of items.

A certificate for 500 shares shows up as "1" in standard apps, because the rules count certificates, not shares.

Locked items can't be swapped for cash in one step.
Items that change often are clunky to update.
The open question is whether Fairmint fixes these now or later.

What it means for CC holders -

Nothing directly. 
It doesn't change how CC is minted or burned. If lots of these items end up created and traded on the network, that's more activity, and network activity burns CC. 
That effect is small, indirect and long-term.

Worth knowing - 

The same few companies keep turning up together: Fairmint, Five North and Tradecraft. That's normal for a young network, but it's worth watching.

repos.name: cs329z/assignment1-harness
repos.description: CS 329Z Assignment 1: Building an Agent Harness (starter)

tweet.text:
看了不少 Agent 教程，也跟着敲完一个能调工具的小 Demo，真要自己从头搭一个，还是不清楚循环、工具、记忆该怎么拼到一起。

斯坦福今年秋季开了一门 Engineering AI Agents 课，课号 CS329Z，第一次作业的代码放出来了，题目就是从零搭一套 Agent Harness，也就是包在模型外面负责调工具、跑循环的那层程序。

作业拿一家公司的邮件存档当素材，先写邮件优先级分类、每日摘要、关键词检索和邮件问答，再把这些接成一个能调工具、跑命令、带记忆的 Agent。

GitHub：https://t.co/FcRtyhUAe9

测试分两种，一种不调模型，专查空回复、格式错乱、工具报错这些异常处理。另一种真调模型打分，光分类那题就要调 60 次模型，跑一分钟左右。

最后还有一轮模拟测试，几个预设角色轮流来跟我们的 Agent 对话，看它能不能把事办成。

每次调用模型都会记账，还能自己设预算上限，循环跑飞了会先停下。

我觉得这份作业比看一堆教程管用，测试把要求写得很死，哪里没做对一跑就知道。想把 Agent 底层弄明白的，可以照着做一遍。

tweet.text:
splat-repair

Paint away unwanted parts of a Gaussian splat scan and repair the surface

Brush over what should go to rebuild the geometry, colour and appearance from different viewpoints.

Fast Fill runs on the CPU, fitting the surrounding surface and copying nearby splats. Deep Fill uses LaMa to repair a rendered view and turn the result back into splats. It needs an NVIDIA GPU.

you're spending days modeling, cleaning and exporting 3d characters by hand while claude code can drive most of the open source tools that do it for you.

One tool models. One fixes the topology. One unwraps the UVs. One paints the textures. One shrinks it for the game.

CLAUDE x BLENDER

01 / Blender MCP → Lets Claude drive Blender and build or edit models from a prompt.

https://t.co/0oN0s6ZAPE

MODELING

05 / Tripo for Blender → Official add-on that generates a 3D model inside Blender.

RETOPO & CLEANUP

09 / PyMeshLab → Mesh cleanup and repair that Claude can script.

repos.name: we-promise/sure
repos.description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone)

tweet.text:
🧾 真香！Sure 这个个人理财 App 能整个装在你自己的服务器上，账本数据不用再交给别人保管。

Sure 上了 GitHub 热榜，现在 1.6 万 star、1400 多个 fork，一千多个 issue 还开着，最近一周连发了两个 alpha 版本。

它的来头有点意思：Maybe Finance 团队在 2021 到 2022 年的大部分时间里，花了将近 100 万美元做出一个完整的个人理财和财富管理应用，2023 年中停止开发后把代码开源了。Sure 就是社区接过来继续维护的分支，和 Maybe 一样走 AGPLv3。

用记账 App 最怕的就是哪天服务关了，几年的流水跟着没了，Maybe 自己就在 2023 年停了开发。Sure 用 Docker 自托管，数据留在你自己手里，浏览器、macOS 桌面版、手机 App 都能打开，还能通过 API 让 LLM agent 来读。不想自己折腾服务器的，Render 上有不带 AI、简单 AI、外接 AI 三种一键部署模板，PikaPods 和 Hostim 也能直接部署。

花了一百万美元做出来的理财 App，现在社区接着免费养。

GitHub：https://t.co/K0eZ21vTP1

repos.name: OpenDroneMap/ODM
repos.description: A command line toolkit to generate maps, point clouds, 3D models and DEMs from drone, balloon or kite images. 📷

tweet.text:
ODM

Turn drone imagery into maps, point clouds and 3D models

ODM is an open source command line toolkit that processes drone, balloon or kite images. It produces classified point clouds, textured 3D models, and maps and elevation models with geographic coordinates.

You can supply JPEG, TIFF and DNG images, or extract images automatically from video. SRT subtitle files containing GPS information are also supported.

The command line workflow suits scripts and integration with other software.

ODM runs on Windows, Mac and Linux.

Someone on reddit spent almost 3 years reverse-engineering Spotify's web player and turned it into a FREE, open-source API. 🎧

It's called SpotAPI, and it lets developers build Spotify-powered apps without needing an official Spotify API key.

You can use it to:

~ Search songs, artists and albums.
~ Fetch playlists and music metadata.
~ Access public Spotify data.
~ Control Spotify playback.
~ Create and manage playlists.
~ Access private features using authentication.

And some of its documented features don't even require Spotify Premium. 🤯

It's written in Python and released under GPL-3.0.

想找个 IPTV 播放器，Fred TV 这款开源的值得瞅瞅，它早先叫 Open TV。

跨平台、轻巧、搜索利索，这几样是它立身的本钱，日常要用的功能也一件没缺：

1️⃣ 支持导入 M3U、Xtream 播放源
2️⃣ 支持录制节目
3️⃣ 多源管理、收藏、自建频道
4️⃣ 支持电视遥控器操作，还能分享频道
项目由一个个人开发者独自撑着，免费且开源。听说作者一个人扛了两年，捐款弹窗那种东西愣是没往里加。

平常看 IPTV 的，上 GitHub 转一圈就是了；用着对脾气，顺手给作者点个 Star，也算捧了个人场。

🔗 https://t.co/awiETjGZKd

repos.name: komi-store/komi-store
repos.description: 🩵 A free, open-source app store for developers' releases on GitHub, Codeberg & Forgejo — browse, discover, and install apps with one click. Formerly GitHub Store.

tweet.text:
🏪 又发现一个装软件神器 Komi Store，GitHub 上开源作者发布的 App，在它里面点一下就能装好。

Komi Store 在 GitHub 上已经 2.1 万 star，上过 Trendshift 日榜，仓库去年 11 月才建，以前叫 GitHub Store。

平时在 GitHub 上看中一个开源小工具，流程是这样的：点进仓库，翻到 Releases，在一堆 apk、dmg、exe 里猜哪个才是自己系统的，装完以后出了新版本还得记着回来看。

Komi Store 把这件事做成了应用商店：GitHub、Codeberg 以及其他 Forgejo、Gitea 平台上的发布版本，都能在里面浏览、发现、一键安装，装过的应用统一管理，还带下载镜像，网络不好也能下。界面支持 14 种语言。

它自己也说得很清楚：只帮你找到和下载开发者发布的安装包，不审核、也不担保安全，装之前看清楚是谁发的。另外 macOS 版还没做公证，第一次打开系统会弹提示。

把 GitHub 当应用商店逛，这个思路早该有了。

GitHub：https://t.co/FaHsOE2UHZ

repos.name: apurvsinghgautam/robin
repos.description: AI-Powered Dark Web OSINT Tool

tweet.text:
Robin，这名字背后是个开源工具，拿 AI 给暗网情报调查打下手。

调查里那几步：搜、筛、整理报告，它一股脑穿成了一根线：

1️⃣ 用大模型优化搜索关键词
2️⃣ 自动筛选暗网搜索引擎返回的结果

repos.name: memorax-ai/memorax-code
repos.description: A memory plugin for AI coding that turns engineering experience, repository knowledge, and your way of working into memory that remains useful in future tasks.

tweet.text:
刚看到，昨天 AI 记忆赛道的热门榜单 AML 揭榜了，400 多个参评项目里，有个产品脱颖而出。

它叫 MemoraX，在文本、代码、多模态三个赛道上，拿下了闭源榜和商业产品榜的第一。

得分分别是 69.26、68.00 和 53.68，其中文本和代码两项的商业产品榜已经连续两期第一。

GitHub：https://t.co/yRkXMsOz1e

成绩挺亮眼的，不过我更想知道，这些记忆能力能不能解决我们平时用 AI 的麻烦。

最常碰到的就是 AI 健忘，新开一个会话、换一个 Agent，项目背景和之前定下的事又得从头交代一遍。

日常用 AI 干活的话，可以用 MemoraX Work，它会把项目背景、工作习惯、做过的决定和调试过程沉淀下来，下次接着用。

记忆不绑定某个模型或会话。在 Claude 里读过的会议纪要，换到 ChatGPT 也能接着用里面定下的结论。

它也不是什么都往里塞，每次只把跟当前任务相关的少量记忆带进上下文，不用反复贴完整的对话历史，Token 也跟着省下来。

自己做 Agent 或 AI 应用的团队，可以直接接 MemoraX API，传入文字、图片和文件，它会自动筛出值得留的信息，用的时候再按当前任务召回。

存下的记忆在控制台里能看、能改、能删。经常被 AI 健忘折磨，或者正想给自家 Agent 加上长期记忆的，可以试试。

tweet.text:
🚨 又挖到一个给运维值班准备的 AI 帮手 SreAgentHarness，线上出事让 agent 去排查，碰生产的操作都得先过审批。

SreAgentHarness 刚开源不到两周，桌面客户端默认本地模式，自带 SQLite，不用装 Docker、PostgreSQL 就能先跑起来。

半夜告警响了，值班的人一边翻日志一边查监控，想让 AI 帮忙又不敢，万一它顺手改了线上配置怎么办。SreAgentHarness 把这件事管得很死：工具、MCP、沙箱、模型调用都走同一套策略判定，真正动生产的操作要绑定意图、目标版本、资源锁和审批，生成的计划里只要带写操作就先给人审。

排查可以长时间跑，中途等待不占 worker、不烧 token，断了能从检查点接着跑，每一步都留审计记录。模型可以接 Claude、Gemini 或 OpenAI 兼容接口；一个人先在本地试，团队要用再切到 PostgreSQL 服务器模式，两边界面一致。

让 AI 帮你值夜班可以，但钥匙得一直在人手里。

repos.name: wzj52501/awesome-competitive-olympiad-algorithms
repos.description: Original algorithmic contest problems and lecture notes — NOIP to NOI & ACM-ICPC level

tweet.text:
🥇 北大图灵班出身的博士刚开源了一份算法竞赛宝藏 awesome-competitive-olympiad-algorithms，从 NOIP 到 NOI、ACM-ICPC 难度的原创题和讲义全在里面。

作者 Zijian Wang 的 GitHub 主页写着：北大图灵班本科、北大前沿计算研究中心博士，2020 年 World Finalist，现在在小马智行。

学竞赛最缺的往往不是题，是出题人的视角：这道题为什么这么设计、正解是怎么想到的。awesome-competitive-olympiad-algorithms 收的是作者自己给 NOI、北京省队选拔和模拟赛出的原创题，每道题配齐三样：题面、C++ 标准解答、带正确性和复杂度分析的题解。

另外还有一批讲义幻灯片，按难度排好了顺序，题目目录也做了无剧透版本。官方测试数据单独打包，Google Drive 和 GitHub Release 都能下，自己写完可以直接对拍。讲义和题解全是中文；代码 MIT，题面和讲义是 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，不能商用。

跟着出题人的思路刷题，和闷头刷题完全是两种体验。

GitHub：https://t.co/SODO1KYeko

repos.description: Stremio - Freedom to Stream

tweet.text:
发现 Stremio 这个开源播放器，我装好一打开，整个人当场怔住，愣了好一阵子才回过神来。

说穿了它无非就是个播放器，但那界面做得，比正牌货还像正牌货。真正戳中心坎的是这三点：

1️⃣ 挂上 Torrentio 插件，指尖轻点一下，全网片源它自动替你过了一遍，720p 搁这儿只能排末位，4K HDR 连字幕都替你配得齐齐整整

claude-photo-sorter 不用 API 密钥，直接用你已经订阅的 Claude 套餐跑，原图留在本机，交给 Claude 看的只是小预览图。

手机导出来一个几千张的文件夹，自拍、美食、旅行、截图、录屏全混在一起，连拍还一堆差不多的。以前要么一张张拖，要么干脆不管。现在指着文件夹跑一下，它先给每个文件做预览和指纹，再在后台同时开四个 Claude 看图打标签，各归各位，也能自定义文件夹。

重复的副本、连拍、存了好几遍的截图会被收进 _Review 文件夹，附一张清单告诉你留了哪一份；截图还额外做像素比对，不会把长得像的 App 界面误判成重复。全程有本地仪表盘实时看，文档说 1000 张大约 4 分钟，原件一个字节都不动，只生成分好类的副本。

整理相册这种谁都不想干的活，交给 Claude 最合适。

tweet.text:
someone turned 18 open-source GitHub repos into an AI content department that plans, publishes, tracks performance, edits videos, and remembers what worked.

it’s powered by 6 AI agents and one Chief of Staff.

the entire workflow runs in a loop:

create → publish → measure → improve.

the system can handle publishing workflows, browser automation, analytics, video editing, and memory overnight.

but there’s one important rule: every post stays in drafts until you approve and publish it.

here are the 18 open-source repos behind the setup:

PUBLISH THE WEEK

1. n8n : automate workflows and move finished drafts across platforms.

https://t.co/jcKfcDpA8r

2. Ghost : publish blog posts and manage paid newsletters.

https://t.co/jicKFvUA2N

3. Huginn : create agents that monitor the web and act on information.

https://t.co/LyoyAiiao7

4. Listmonk : self-hosted newsletter and mailing list management.

https://t.co/EAg6zNlHAD

5. Mixpost : schedule and manage social media posts from your own server.

https://t.co/6hcru0hajh

ACT WHERE THERE IS NO API

6. Browser Use : lets AI agents navigate websites and interact with browsers.

https://t.co/o4ex0VKc81

7. Playwright MCP : gives AI agents browser automation through Microsoft’s MCP server.

https://t.co/xEQsda1CgD

8. Composio : connects agents to external apps and tools.

https://t.co/IdYyyoETsX

9. Stagehand : browser automation using natural-language instructions.

https://t.co/FTv1sXsyyl

MEASURE WHAT LANDED

10. Metabase : build dashboards and explore your analytics without writing SQL.

https://t.co/6rEISxpOhR

11. Umami : lightweight, privacy-focused website analytics.

https://t.co/1RkDrsUe7c

12. Langfuse : monitor AI agent traces, performance, and evaluations.

https://t.co/RCUai1ub3W

13. Plausible : track website traffic and understand where visitors come from.

https://t.co/X74n7Tkk8g

EDIT AND DESIGN

14. whisper.cpp : transcribe audio locally and generate text for video captions.

https://t.co/X6oToEa18n

15. Satori : turn HTML and CSS into images for social graphics and covers.

https://t.co/zXDxAlbVlE

16. auto-editor : automatically cut silence and dead space from videos.

https://t.co/3a0aJbye5B

REMEMBER WHAT WORKED

17. Dify : build and manage AI applications and agent workflows.

https://t.co/Aw8DZG6QHv

18. Mem0 : give your agents persistent memory so they can retain useful context and learn from previous work.

https://t.co/cxB96lzKGW

the bigger idea is that you don’t need to manually manage every part of your content operation.

your agents can research, prepare drafts, schedule workflows, monitor performance, edit clips, and feed useful insights back into the next content cycle.

you still make the final publishing decision.

repos.name: aoci-spec/aoci-code
repos.description: A persistent, Git-versioned map of your whole codebase and database schema that coding agents read before they touch anything. Local-first MCP server + CLI in Go: a governed repository index of code knowledge that gives Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and opencode long-term context, memory, and code intelligence.

tweet.text:
🗂️ AI 编程 agent 的代码地图神器 AOCI-CODE，让 Claude Code、Codex 动手之前，先把你整个代码库和数据库表结构读明白。

AOCI-CODE 上了 Trendshift 日榜，GitHub 2500 多 star，11 月 3 号发 0.1.0，两周后已经迭代到 0.2.0-rc2。

每次开新会话，agent 都得把仓库重新翻一遍：这个模块干嘛的、那张表谁在写。翻完 token 烧掉一大截，改的时候还是可能碰到不该碰的地方。

AOCI-CODE 的做法是让 agent 给每个文件写一条索引：职责、强关联、对外接口，以及光看代码推不出来的约束，存成纯文本跟着项目一起进 Git。下次 agent 通过它的 MCP 服务器先查索引再动手，代码改了，索引也跟着版本走。

数据库那边只读表结构、不碰业务数据，支持 PostgreSQL 和 MySQL；整个工具本地优先，不上传数据。注意它用的是 FSL-1.1-MIT 这种 Fair Source 源码可用许可，不是传统意义上的开源。首次建索引大约每 20 万行一小时，适合 50 万行以内的项目。

让 agent 带着地图进代码库，比让它每次重新探路靠谱多了。

GitHub：https://t.co/av5h47Od8i

repos.description: Vibe AStock：A 股短线复盘与跟踪工作台 · 盯盘异动、情绪复盘（连板天梯、题材轮动、明日验证）、AI 复盘与周报、交易日志、盘前提醒，182 个数据端点。支持 Claude Code、Codex、WorkBuddy 订阅或任意模型 API。 | A short-term trading review and tracking workbench for China A-shares.

tweet.text:
刷手机那阵子撞见一个开源项目，Vibe AStock，A 股复盘这一摊，靠它我省了好多工夫。

复盘这事儿以前最磨人：收盘先翻涨停池，接着查龙虎榜、看板块资金，最后再手写一遍复盘；耗人的从来不是分析，全耗在满世界找数据上。

它底下用的是 OpenAI Codex Harness，盯盘、复盘、看个股、记交易，统统收进一个本地网页。

挑几样最趁手的讲讲：

1️⃣ 昨日梯队：头一天的涨停样本定住不动，谁晋级、谁断板、谁回落，扫一眼便知，行情缺着的票也不剔

2️⃣ 盘中异动：凭行情快照梳理急拉急跌、封板开板。走的是快照轮询，不靠逐笔成交，想一个不漏就别指望

3️⃣ AI复盘：情绪、资金、题材、龙虎榜、龙头跟踪，五块分开摆，每块都能点“查看依据”去核对

4️⃣ 多空辩论：行情、估值、财报、研报搁一处，正反说法都陈列出来，不替你选赢家，也不点买卖

5️⃣ 交易日志：持仓以日志为准，买了哪只、为何买、后来走势怎样，跟研究记录并排放着

6️⃣ 回测：历史规则填进去，AI 归置条件，你点头了再交程序算数

最教我安心的是这点：行情、统计一律程序算，AI 只管把材料讲明白，绝不冲着股票代码信口开河。

Codex、Claude 订了哪个都行，DeepSeek 之类的 API 也能挂上。Mac、Windows、Linux 通跑，前提是 Python 3.10+ 与 Node.js 22+。
🔗 https://t.co/j2IA2QTVkz

tweet.text:
Pi 扩展圈又燃爆了 🔥

johnlindquist 的高亮药丸、timqian 的 hushface 本地全家桶、pratikgajjar 的 MCP 事件唤醒、yiyabo 的零配置调试器、offline-ant 的 Phimacs……全网玩家把 Pi 玩成了下一代「排版设计师 + 断网程序员 + 随叫随到的值班员 + 断点侦探 + Emacs 指挥部」:

1️⃣ johnlindquist/pi-emphasis（https://t.co/v29IsPnzKW）

让 Pi 的回复一眼能扫完：把 [[Done]]、[[Failed]]、[[Needs you]] 变成带图标的彩色药丸，标题和开头标签自动配图标，粗体、箭头、树状线也上色；只改显示，存档、复制和导出的还是原始 Markdown，不调模型、零成本。
“成功、失败、等你拍板，颜色一眼分清”！

2️⃣ timqian/hushface（https://t.co/Upn8kIjt6y）

一行命令在自己的 Mac 上跑本地编程 Agent：Pi + Qwen3.8-27B + 专门为 Pi 调过的 LoRA；73 MB 安装包里自带 Node、Pi 和 llama.cpp，不用 Homebrew、不用 npm；首次运行下载约 22 GB 模型，之后完全离线，hushface stop 一键释放内存。
“拔掉网线，Agent 照样写代码”！

3️⃣ pratikgajjar/pi-mcp-events（https://t.co/LnnjCv8otE）

MCP 服务器发来一个事件，你的 Pi 会话就自己醒来处理：直接用 Pi 自带的 mcp.json，不用适配器、不用 fork；对 Agent 说一句「订阅某个服务器的新消息事件」就行，事件内容只当数据、绝不当成你的指令。
“不用一直盯着，事件来了 Pi 自己上岗”！

4️⃣ yiyabo/pi-debugger（https://t.co/rgV12E5SOf）

给 Pi 装上真调试器：JS/TS、Python、Go、Rust、C/C++、Swift、Zig、.NET、Ruby 自动找调试适配器；一次 debug_probe 调用就能下条件断点、抓局部变量和调用栈，还能按 PID 挂到正在跑的进程上，前后端同时调。
“别再满屏 print，让 Agent 直接下断点”！

5️⃣ offline-ant/phimacs（https://t.co/cSDYjanFSB）

作者在 Emacs 50 岁时回归，把 Herdr 里常用的功能重做成 Emacs 版 Pi 工作台：每个项目一个空间，侧栏显示谁在等你；Agent 由后台服务跑，关掉 Emacs、断了 SSH 也照常干活，还能派 worker 并行修测试，实验性地用手机浏览器查看同一个会话；作者坦白代码全由 AI 写成。
“编辑器关了，Agent 还在加班”！

1️⃣ johnlindquist/pi-emphasis（https://t.co/v29IsPnzKW）

让 Pi 的回复一眼能扫完：把 [[Done]]、[[Failed]]、[[Needs you]] 变成带图标的彩色药丸，标题和开头标签自动配图标，粗体、箭头、树状线也上色；只改显示，存档、复制和导出的还是原始 Markdown，不调模型、零成本。
“成功、失败、等你拍板，颜色一眼分清”！

2️⃣ timqian/hushface（https://t.co/Upn8kIjt6y）

一行命令在自己的 Mac 上跑本地编程 Agent：Pi + Qwen3.8-27B + 专门为 Pi 调过的 LoRA；73 MB 安装包里自带 Node、Pi 和 llama.cpp，不用 Homebrew、不用 npm；首次运行下载约 22 GB 模型，之后完全离线，hushface stop 一键释放内存。
“拔掉网线，Agent 照样写代码”！

3️⃣ pratikgajjar/pi-mcp-events（https://t.co/LnnjCv8otE）

MCP 服务器发来一个事件，你的 Pi 会话就自己醒来处理：直接用 Pi 自带的 mcp.json，不用适配器、不用 fork；对 Agent 说一句「订阅某个服务器的新消息事件」就行，事件内容只当数据、绝不当成你的指令。
“不用一直盯着，事件来了 Pi 自己上岗”！

4️⃣ yiyabo/pi-debugger（https://t.co/rgV12E5SOf）

给 Pi 装上真调试器：JS/TS、Python、Go、Rust、C/C++、Swift、Zig、.NET、Ruby 自动找调试适配器；一次 debug_probe 调用就能下条件断点、抓局部变量和调用栈，还能按 PID 挂到正在跑的进程上，前后端同时调。
“别再满屏 print，让 Agent 直接下断点”！

5️⃣ offline-ant/phimacs（https://t.co/cSDYjanFSB）

作者在 Emacs 50 岁时回归，把 Herdr 里常用的功能重做成 Emacs 版 Pi 工作台：每个项目一个空间，侧栏显示谁在等你；Agent 由后台服务跑，关掉 Emacs、断了 SSH 也照常干活，还能派 worker 并行修测试，实验性地用手机浏览器查看同一个会话；作者坦白代码全由 AI 写成。
“编辑器关了，Agent 还在加班”！

tweet.text:
Live2D-LLM-Chat

Talk to a Live2D character through a local model service

Speak or type to a character that replies aloud with lip sync. The transparent avatar also follows your gaze, blinks and breathes. Conversations are saved and recover after a restart.

repos.name: PapilotAI/papilot
repos.description: Next-Generation AI LaTeX Editor: annotate the PDF, review typeset diffs, and live-sync with Overleaf. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and more.

tweet.text:
用 LaTeX 写论文，导师在 PDF 上圈了一句话要改，回头还得在源码里翻半天，才找到它在哪个文件哪一行。

Papilot 这个开源编辑器把这一步省了，在 PDF 上选中一句话，或框住一个公式、一张图，写下想怎么改，交给 AI 去动源码。

每处改动都会排版成改前改后两版摆在 PDF 上，点了接受才真正写进论文，不满意可以拒掉，或者留条评论让它再改。

GitHub：https://t.co/cO5Vw1Ukvb

合作者还在用 Overleaf 也不影响，这边接受的改动大约一秒就同步过去，对方改的也会带着名字回到本地。

AI 用自己已有的 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 登录就行。还带了学位论文、期刊、海报、简历这些模板，能对上 400 多个会议要求的格式。

我觉得直接在 PDF 上圈着改这个交互最对路，赶论文改稿那几天能少切很多次窗口，写毕业论文的同学可以试试。

repos.name: arman-bd/guppylm
repos.description: A ~9M parameter LLM that talks like a small fish.

tweet.text:
在不少人眼里，想训一个语言模型，先得有博士文凭，再配上一摞 GPU 才算够格；这套看法其实早该翻篇了。

偏有人只花五分钟、开一张 Colab 笔记本，就从零跑出了一个九百万参数的模型，名字叫 GuppyLM。

设定有意思：一条叫 Guppy 的鱼，开口全是小写短句，聊来聊去无非是水、食物、光线，还有鱼缸里的日子。你问它人生的意义是什么，它答“食物”，答案永远都是食物。这反应着实可爱。

自己训模型，从来就不是什么玄学。

1️⃣ 用不着博士学位
2️⃣ 用不着一堆 GPU
3️⃣ 一张 Colab 笔记本，跑五分钟，数据、分词器、模型结构、训练推理，整套流程由你自己搭

跑完之后你就明白了，大模型是怎么把文字一步步变成权重、再吐出回答的，那层黑箱的感觉自然就淡了。

🔗 https://t.co/j5l4CNpQoT

repos.name: antoniaci/blackbird
repos.description: An OSINT tool to search for accounts by username and email in social networks.

tweet.text:
五个开源工具，一概免费，查人、查公司、查设备，能想到的场景基本都兜住了。

先把话撂在前头，这不是教你扒谁，是让你先拿它照照自己。连自己漏了多少都没数，还谈什么防。

五个工具各管一摊，别混着使，地址和用途我一个个摆清楚：

查人的时候，最让人恼火的真的是搜不出内容吗？实际情况是，你铺开一堆浏览器窗口，一路翻下去满眼都是推广链接，有价值的信息半点没摸着。

我无意间发现一个 OSINT 资源导航仓库，标星 2.83 万，提交次数 1459 次：

姓名、ID、邮箱、手机号、社交账号、公开记录，统统按照工具入口做好了归类，用不着自己四处乱撞。

不过老实讲，我浏览完毕之后完全没有动过拿它去扒别人的念头——千万别乱来，免得给自己惹上麻烦。

真正需要排查的对象是你自己：
1️⃣ 邮箱是否存在泄露
2️⃣ 旧账号还在哪些平台挂着没注销
3️⃣ 手机号关联过哪些对外公开的页面

我把自己查了一遍才发觉，这些年一直处于信息裸露状态却毫无察觉。

请牢记这句话，OSINT 最保险的用法，就是先把自己从网络上彻底清查一遍。

repos.name: joonspk-research/generative_agents
repos.description: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior

tweet.text:
this Claude Code + GTA 6 business idea could make $30K licensing AI NPCs to 100 FiveM servers.

most RP servers have NPCs that follow scripts and repeat the same dialogue.

but imagine NPCs that remember players, talk to each other, make plans, and react to what happens in the city.

you can build a system like this using Claude Code and 3 open-source projects.

here’s how the setup works:

three NPCs run on AI, each with its own memory and access to a private communication channel the player never sees.

* the tipster: gathers information and shares secrets.
* the bartender: listens to conversations and works the room.
* the enforcer: watches from the shadows and waits for instructions.

they can exchange information behind the scenes, so their behaviour feels connected instead of scripted.

3 open-source repos make this possible:

1. Generative Agents

gives NPCs memory, reflection, and planning capabilities.

GitHub: https://t.co/KsM3KZYLGr

2. Mem0

adds long-term memory so NPCs can remember players, past interactions, money, and previous events.

GitHub: https://t.co/cxB96lzKGW

Jev 应用圈又燃爆了 🔥

Dicklesworthstone 的技能排序器、UditAkhourii 的 Quicksilver 省钱分拣、keltokhy 的语义版 grep、danvega 的 Spring AI 客诉分诊、phoem 的 Claude 选模路由……全网玩家把 Jev 玩成了下一代「技能调度员 + Token 省钱机 + 语义搜索刀 + 客服分诊台 + 模型调度员」:

1️⃣ Dicklesworthstone/skillranker（https://t.co/LIMUTgOrLk）

Rust 写的命令行工具：读取 Agent 当前会话的上下文，让 Jev 对比所有可用技能，估计下一步该用哪个；默认走 TypeSafe 官方接口，也支持 Cloudflare 上托管的 Jev，输出 JSON、钩子或终端界面，需要自己的 API Key（社区项目，非官方）。
“技能装了一大堆，下一步用哪个 Jev 说了算”！

2️⃣ UditAkhourii/quicksilver（https://t.co/rm1TEM0KXM）

Claude Code 技能：把「这 187 个文件哪些管登录」「这 3,000 行日志哪些是真报错」这类筛选判断交给 Jev，约一秒返回是否、标签或分数，Claude 只拿到一份短名单；README 示例里从约 2.6 万 Token 降到约 2,400。
“别再花钱让 Claude 扫读了”！

grep，但匹配条件是一句大白话：每一行变成一个问 Jev 的是否问题，约 200 毫秒一次，边读边判、按原顺序输出，tail -f 实时日志也能用；README 实测 994 条 HN 标题用了 4.6 秒、0.012 美元。
“用一句话，就能从日志里抓人”！

4️⃣ danvega/jev-feedback-triage（https://t.co/nW9I8bl103）

用 Spring AI 2.1 新增的 Decision API 加 Jev 做客户反馈分诊：一条消息进来，判断急不急、交给哪个团队、客户情绪如何；不是让聊天模型写一段话再去解析，而是列出选项让模型挑一个，并给出有多确定。
“Java 团队也能直接用上判断模型”！

5️⃣ phoem/jev-router（https://t.co/aqp7i9JP67）

Claude Code 的 mod：每条提示先问 Jev 这题有多难，再决定这一轮用哪个 Claude 模型；默认关闭，在会话里打开后，提示框上方会显示它开着没有、选了哪个模型（依赖 Claude Code 的早期功能，接口可能会变）。
“简单题不用最贵的模型”！

Rust 写的命令行工具：读取 Agent 当前会话的上下文，让 Jev 对比所有可用技能，估计下一步该用哪个；默认走 TypeSafe 官方接口，也支持 Cloudflare 上托管的 Jev，输出 JSON、钩子或终端界面，需要自己的 API Key（社区项目，非官方）。
“技能装了一大堆，下一步用哪个 Jev 说了算”！

2️⃣ UditAkhourii/quicksilver（https://t.co/rm1TEM0KXM）

Claude Code 技能：把「这 187 个文件哪些管登录」「这 3,000 行日志哪些是真报错」这类筛选判断交给 Jev，约一秒返回是否、标签或分数，Claude 只拿到一份短名单；README 示例里从约 2.6 万 Token 降到约 2,400。
“别再花钱让 Claude 扫读了”！

3️⃣ keltokhy/jgrep（https://t.co/QGnxOJu0br）

grep，但匹配条件是一句大白话：每一行变成一个问 Jev 的是否问题，约 200 毫秒一次，边读边判、按原顺序输出，tail -f 实时日志也能用；README 实测 994 条 HN 标题用了 4.6 秒、0.012 美元。
“用一句话，就能从日志里抓人”！

4️⃣ danvega/jev-feedback-triage（https://t.co/nW9I8bl103）

用 Spring AI 2.1 新增的 Decision API 加 Jev 做客户反馈分诊：一条消息进来，判断急不急、交给哪个团队、客户情绪如何；不是让聊天模型写一段话再去解析，而是列出选项让模型挑一个，并给出有多确定。
“Java 团队也能直接用上判断模型”！

5️⃣ phoem/jev-router（https://t.co/aqp7i9JP67）

Claude Code 的 mod：每条提示先问 Jev 这题有多难，再决定这一轮用哪个 Claude 模型；默认关闭，在会话里打开后，提示框上方会显示它开着没有、选了哪个模型（依赖 Claude Code 的早期功能，接口可能会变）。
“简单题不用最贵的模型”！

tweet.text:
让 AI 帮忙看只股票，它张口就报个价格，一查是好几个月前的，财报数字也对不上。

同花顺团队开源了一套 A 股金融数据服务：Financial-API，主要面向 AI Agent 和量化研究，行情、财报、估值、指数板块、公募基金都能查。

接入方式给得很全，Claude Desktop、Cursor 这类客户端按 7 个数据域配上 MCP 就能在对话里直接查，也有命令行工具和 Python 可用。

GitHub：https://t.co/BTV0GtuDJH

装好命令行工具会顺带把配套 Skill 装进已有的 Agent，说一句「查询贵州茅台的最新行情，并分析近一年的涨跌幅」就能跑。

涨跌停、炸板、连板、龙虎榜这些特色数据也有，还能把历史行情存进本地数据库，长期做研究不用反复拉。

README 里写明了查不到的数据不会拿模拟数据凑数，这点我挺看重，用 AI 复盘 A 股最怕它一本正经地编。

tweet.text:
资深安卓投屏工具 scrcpy 总算迈入 5.0 版本了。

此番最核心的改进在于：硬件解码支持终于落地。

过去投屏主要依赖 CPU 完成解码，如今 Windows、macOS、Linux 均能直接调用 GPU，按照官方实测数据，CPU 占用最高可下降约 10 倍，解码速度更快、功耗更低，即便长时间投屏也轻松不少。

scrcpy 依旧保持免费开源、没有广告、无需账号，甚至连网络都不必连接。

tweet.text:
FractalAndroid

Contribute idle Android compute while keeping raw data on your device

FractalAndroid runs federated training on Android devices for the Fractal distributed network. Raw images and local sensor data stay on the device; parameter checkpoints go to the server.

Chip temperature, battery level, charging status and RAM pressure determine when to compute. Computation pauses above 40°C.

Validated checkpoints earn liquid MBs that can be redeemed for Wi-Fi access or shared bandwidth pools.

repos.name: kirklin/skyward
repos.description: An Android recovery written in Rust from scratch: decryption, installs and OTA updates, backup, WLAN, MTP, adb and fastbootd. Runs the phone's own drivers and services from its stock firmware.

tweet.text:
🪂 兄弟们，小米刷机党有新选择了：Skyward 是专给小米和 REDMI 做的第三方 Recovery，双系统切换、数据解密、备份恢复、在线更新都在一个界面里。

Skyward 已经在小米 17 Ultra 和小米 13 Ultra 真机上测过，另有 19 款机型在构建中、还没上真机试，fork 数已经 180 多个。

以前玩双系统、刷包，得在电脑上敲 fastboot、到处找对应机型的 Recovery，切个槽位都提心吊胆，怕中途断电出问题。

Skyward 从零用 Rust 写成，切换双系统时每一步先记到 /metadata，就算中途断电，下次进 Skyward 也会把切换补完。备份、文件管理、终端、连电脑都在里面，还能连 Wi-Fi 自己升级到最新版，界面有简繁中文和深浅两套主题。

两个边界要说清楚：用它得先解锁 bootloader；而且在 Recovery 状态下它的 adb 是免授权的 root shell，谁拿到手机和数据线都能访问存储，手机别随便离身。

刷机这件事，终于有个顺手的工具箱了。

GitHub：https://t.co/1XHs1p6Ywd

tweet.text:
🪜 兄弟们，Outcome School 创始人 Amit Shekhar 刚开源了一份 Forward Deployed Engineer 路线图，想转去做 AI 落地岗位的，照着 15 步往下学就行。

forward-deployed-engineer-roadmap 仓库 10 月底才建，fork 已经 60 多个；Amit Shekhar 的 GitHub 主页写着 IIT 出身，在 Outcome School 教 AI、机器学习和软件工程。

按路线图的说法，AI 工程师负责做产品，FDE 负责直接对着客户，把一个演示版推进成能在客户那边真正跑起来的生产系统。这类岗位要的东西很杂，自己东拼西凑很容易学偏。

路线图从 LLM、RAG、MCP、Agent 这几个基本概念讲起，一路走到客户数据上的 RAG、Agent 工具集成、评估与可观测性、延迟和成本优化、微调，最后用一个实时语音 Agent 把前面的东西串成完整案例。每个主题都配了博客，部分还有视频。

最后一步专门讲 FDE 面试一般考什么：借助 AI agent 写代码、AI 系统设计、客户场景题。

想从写 Demo 走到交付生产，这份路线图值得收藏试试。

repos.description: 给普通成年人的运动营养健康指南，涵盖抗阻训练、半马和全马、日常饮食与训练健康。

tweet.text:
练完力量回家该吃什么，跑半马要带几个能量胶，网上一搜各说各的，有的还是卖补剂的在讲。

「运动营养健康指南」是 GitHub 上公开维护的一份中文问答，写给刚开始运动、平时练力量或准备跑半马全马的普通人，目前有 465 条。

运动 190 条、营养 142 条、健康 133 条，每条先写怎么做、要花什么，再写预期收益、适用范围和原始出处。

GitHub：https://t.co/sMuufXkcVy

打开网页就能搜，直接输一句「跑步时膝盖疼怎么办」也能找到，还能按章节和证据等级筛。

每条结论都标了 A、B、C 三档，A 是多项试验或系统综述支持的，C 是专业共识和指南建议，哪条说得硬、哪条只是经验，一眼能分开。

还专门有一篇补剂和装备的省钱清单，我觉得这篇最实用，刚开始练就想买一堆蛋白粉的，可以先看看再下单。

GitHub is becoming the internet's biggest collection of free AI employees.

Agents that research, code, browse, organize, and execute tasks.

1. BrowserOS

Give Claude Code or Codex a browser for real work. Agents use your logged-in accounts, work in separate tabs, and save sessions you can replay.

Give it a question and let an agent search, summarize findings, and write a research report. Supports different model providers, search tools, and MCP servers.

An agent with persistent memory across sessions. It can remember project context, reuse skills, and connect through your terminal, browser, Slack, or Telegram.

https://t.co/cOqVpqQiSX

Hand a coding task to a lightweight agent that works through the command line. Its simple design makes it easier to inspect and customize.

https://t.co/Pi5ylA8Uli

A desktop-agent project for automating computer tasks. Useful for exploring workflows that require interacting with application interfaces.

https://t.co/PQU1NM7DwF

An open-source desktop workspace that connects AI agents to work apps through Composio. Includes persistent sessions and support for custom skills.

https://t.co/b4dlnd5S4T

Give your agents a self-hostable browser sandbox. A foundation for building tools that navigate websites and automate browser workflows.

https://t.co/rwmI5mxjdr

https://t.co/vcmACvBaX2

https://t.co/EkZpA7l88M

repos.name: microsoft/BitNet
repos.description: Official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs

tweet.text:
微软这次真有点东西！

不用花大价钱买显卡，普通电脑也有机会运行 AI 大模型了。

微软开源了一个叫 BitNet 的项目。

官方测试数据挺惊人：

• 运行速度最高提升 6.17 倍
• 耗电量最多降低 82.2%
• 部分 AI 模型不用专业显卡，靠电脑处理器就能运行
• 免费开源，人人都能获取
