repos.name: akitaonrails/ai-memory
repos.description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors

tweet.text:
claude can now fix its own memory while you’re asleep.

anthropic calls it “dreaming.”

claude code keeps notes about you, your projects, and your preferences. but when those notes become outdated or incorrect, they can keep influencing future sessions.

dreaming fixes that.

at 3am, claude reviews the day’s conversations, checks its existing memories, corrects outdated facts, and records every change with a supporting quote.

one reported test went from 41 correct facts out of 57 to 57 out of 57.

someone has now ported this workflow to claude code.

the setup takes just 3 things:

* 1 setting to enable memory updates
* 1 prompt to configure the dreaming process
* 1 cron job to run it overnight

there’s another useful feature: ai-memory.

it lets you switch between agents without losing your working context.

start a task in claude code, stop midway, open Codex in the same folder, and continue where you left off.

no rebuilding the context from scratch.

this is the kind of memory system that makes AI agents more useful across sessions.

repo in the reply.

save this if you want your AI agents to remember what matters and clean up what doesn’t.

repos.name: aicodewith-team/pi-superagent
repos.description: Proactive GitHub coding agent for pi — port of DeepSeek's dsh-superagent-prototype as a pi extension

tweet.text:
Pi 扩展圈又燃爆了 🔥

aicodewith-team 移植的 DeepSeek 主动型超级 Agent、ghoseb 的 Percy 自助瘦身、efolchmontiel 的本地语音对话、ivaltryek 的密钥打码器、G36maid 的「不开心指数」……全网玩家把 Pi 玩成了下一代「会自己接活的同事 + 上下文瘦身师 + 语音搭档 + 保密专员 + 坏习惯纠察员」:

1️⃣ aicodewith-team/pi-superagent（https://t.co/d0VMjSCkVR）

把 DeepSeek 开源的主动型编程 Agent 原型移植成 Pi 扩展（社区非官方移植）：盯着仓库 issue 和 PR 里 @它 的留言，按白名单和规则接活，新开 worktree 和分支跑一个全新的 Pi 会话，改完自动推分支、开 PR、回帖附链接，卡住就只问你一个问题。
“少占你的注意力，多给你结果”！

2️⃣ ghoseb/pi-percy（https://t.co/8Y3RFO2NqV）

让 Agent 在上下文塞满之前自己瘦身：把旧的工具输出换成短指针、旧的对话段换成短笔记，原文都还留在会话里，需要时用 recall 搜回来再读；不用第二个模型，没有额外花费，压缩前还会先检查一遍。
“长会话不再越聊越笨”！

3️⃣ efolchmontiel/gentle-voice（https://t.co/8XiPQIdCHP）

和 Pi 直接说话的 Pi 包：麦克风输入、语音转文字、文字转语音，音频处理留在本地，回复用的就是当前 Pi 会话里的模型；一行 pi install npm:gentle-voice 装好，目前只测过 Linux。
“动嘴写代码，Agent 开口回你”！

4️⃣ ivaltryek/cfgredact-cli（https://t.co/9Iu6I6dDVP）

在模型读到工具输出之前把密钥打码：Go 写的命令行负责遮住 Key 和 Token，Pi 扩展每次工具结果都过一遍，出错就直接隐藏输出；还会拦住想用打过码的内容覆盖真实密钥的写入。
“密钥一个字都不让模型看见”！

5️⃣ G36maid/pi-unhappy-index（https://t.co/gx8ltAm8q8）

极简 Pi 扩展，专盯两个坏习惯：模型用 cat 读文件、用 python 脚本改文件时，提醒它回去用专门的 read 和 edit 工具；每抓到一次，「不开心指数」就加一。
“Agent 一偷懒，指数就涨”！

repos.name: billpwchan/zhiyin
repos.description: A weekly radio built from your YouTube Music, NetEase Cloud Music or QQ Music likes: Claude picks new songs and says why. Paste a playlist link for a no-login roast of your taste. English, 简体中文, 繁體中文.

tweet.text:
音乐 App 的每日推荐听久了，来来回回总是那几首热歌，理由也就一句「因为听过某某」。

「知音」是一个开源的 AI 私人电台，从我们点过红心的几百首歌出发，每周排出 8 个左右的电台，每首新歌都附一句推荐理由。

背后先给每类歌捞大约 600 首候选，去掉听过的，再交给 Claude 像编辑一样挑，打分不到 0.7 的不放，没把握就宁可少放几首。

GitHub：https://t.co/0CDTaSQX0R

我觉得最好玩的是口味卡片，贴一个网易云「我喜欢的音乐」或 QQ 音乐主页链接，无需账号，十秒左右出一张卡。

Claude 会给我们的口味起个名字，再锐评一句。完整版还会把点过红心的歌按年份一圈圈画成唱片，能回放口味这些年怎么变的。

想跟朋友比比谁的歌单更有品位，先贴个链接玩一下就知道了。

repos.name: zephyr4123/snug
repos.description: 让远程 Mac 在任意设备上获得原生级体验。支持 UU远程、CrossDesk 与向日葵（官方适配版）的显示与触控增强：手机、平板、电脑各有专属屏幕，画面铺满、字号随屏，原生触屏手势，App 资源库。Make your remote Mac native on any device: display and touch enhancements for UU Remote, CrossDesk and Sunlogin (official port), with a dedicated screen for every phone, tablet and computer, native touch gestures and an App Library.

tweet.text:
🛋️ 躺着用手机写代码的外挂来了，Snug 让你用 UU远程 连 Mac 时，手机上直接出现一块按手机比例适配的竖屏专属屏幕。

Snug 上了 Trendshift 日榜，仓库 11 月 13 号才建，安装包已签名并通过 Apple 公证，国内 CDN 和 GitHub 两个渠道都能下。

以前用手机远程 Mac，看到的是一整块横屏桌面缩成小条，字小到要放大才看得清，手指一划还被当成鼠标拖拽。

装上 Snug 后，UU远程 的屏幕列表里会多出一块「Snug 手机屏」，比例和你的手机一致、2 倍高清，选中的窗口独占整屏。Ghostty、iTerm2、VS Code、Cursor 这些 App 字号自动放大，单指滑动是带惯性的滚动，长按拖动是选字，长按松开是右键菜单。

内置 800 款手机机型，找不到也能自己填分辨率。提醒一句，它依赖 macOS 未公开接口，目前只做竖屏，也不是网易官方软件。

人离开书桌，活儿也能接着干。

GitHub：https://t.co/hRAQOh1Qk9

1）LocalSend｜跨设备传文件

3）Upscayl｜图片高清修复

5）思源笔记｜知识管理

6）Jellyfin｜私人影音库

repos.name: interfere-inc/landmines
repos.description: Oxlint rules that keep AI-written code honest: real implementations, real signals, no flake masking.

tweet.text:
💣 离谱，AI 写代码为了让 CI 变绿会偷偷耍小聪明，landmines 就是专门在 lint 阶段把这些取巧写法拦下来的规则集。

landmines 上了 Trendshift 日榜，是 Interfere 团队在自家生产环境里用着的一套 Oxlint 规则，MIT 协议。

用过 coding agent 的人多半碰到过：测试跑不过，它就把依赖 mock 掉；请求偶尔超时，它就塞一个固定 sleep；不稳定的测试加个重试糊过去。CI 是绿了，代码其实什么都没验证。

landmines 把这些路一条条堵死：测试里禁止替换依赖行为，只允许观察用的 spy；MSW 遇到没处理的请求必须报错；固定等待、掩盖 flaky 的写法都会被拦。

关键是每条报错都会顺带说明该改成什么，agent 在同一轮 lint 里就能自己修好，不用你再来回解释。

AI 想走捷径都难。

GitHub：https://t.co/xnvRvzQmVH

tweet.text:
AI 漫剧这一行，剧本跟分镜早就不必从零起步了。

GitHub 上那个开源项目 AI 漫剧 Skills，作者一口气备下了 21 套题材模板。

玄幻修仙、穿越重生、宫斗宅斗、都市逆袭、悬疑刑侦、总裁甜宠，热门短剧那点路数基本都给兜住了。

有意思的地方在于，只要往里丢一句故事创意，AI 便顺着流程一路推下去：

故事企划 → 人物设定 → 分集剧本 → 分镜提示词 → 视频生成提示词 → 发布文案。

repos.name: monitor-probe/monitor
repos.description: 用 Rust 写的轻量级服务器探针 (Rust + axum + SQLite)

tweet.text:
这里想向大家介绍一个用 Rust 编写的开源监控探针，名字叫 monitor。

它的 hub 空载时仅占 6.8 MiB 内存，agent 更是只有 1.8 MiB；即便 200 个节点同时在线，总占用也不过 10.8 MiB，CPU 消耗只相当于单核的 2%。

它的设计思路相当激进：agent 既不开放端口，也不接收执行类指令，所以就算控制面板被攻破，攻击者也无法借此控制机器

公开页面上的 IP 与主机名在服务端就被过滤掉，根本不会输出；agent 全程不落盘写文件，要卸载只需执行一条命令。

功能上它也做了大幅精简，不提供 web terminal，也不支持远程 SSH。此外它附带主题商店，状态页的皮肤可以随意更换。

项目地址：https://t.co/F9xk73NOCf
主题商店：https://t.co/jEtCQjKJla

← خروجی گرفتن از فایل زیرنویس و ویدئوی نهایی

طبق مستندات فعلی SmartSub:

تولید زیرنویس فارسی: با موتورهایی مثل Whisper امکان‌پذیره.

ترجمه به فارسی: از طریق سرویس‌های ترجمه و مدل‌های LLM قابل انجامه.

تبدیل متن فارسی به صدا (TTS): پشتیبانی مستقیم و قطعی از صدای فارسی در موتورهای Local معرفی‌شده تأیید نشده.

رابط کاربری فارسی: فعلاً زبان‌های چینی، انگلیسی و ژاپنی معرفی شده‌اند و فارسی در فهرست نیست. 

نتیجه: برای ساخت و ترجمه زیرنویس فارسی گزینه قابل استفاده‌ایه؛ اما برای دوبله فارسی و Voice Cloning فارسی نباید بدون آزمایش روی پشتیبانی اون حساب کنی.

repos.name: Glen-Web-App/best-agent-memory-mcp
repos.description: Best Agent Memory MCP servers, ranked and compared: long-term memory for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any MCP client. Glen, Mem0, Supermemory, Zep, Hindsight, Basic Memory, claude-mem, Graphiti, Cognee, the official memory server and more, with storage, capture model, team sharing, license and live stars.

tweet.text:
💾 给 AI agent 挑记忆插件的看这里，Best Agent Memory MCP 把 25 个记忆 MCP 服务器按存在哪、怎么记、能不能团队共享、要花多少钱排成了一张表。

Best Agent Memory MCP 这个月刚更新过，托管服务和能自己部署的开源服务器都收了。

想让 Claude Code 记住上周定好的项目约定，第一步就卡在选型：Mem0、Zep、Supermemory、claude-mem 各说各好，有的只能托管、有的能自建，价格页还得一家家翻。

这份清单把这些摆到了一起：Supermemory 的 Pro 是 19 美元一个月，Zep 的 Flex 计划 125 美元一个月，Basic Memory 用 Markdown 加本地 SQLite 存、走 AGPL 协议，Hindsight 是 MIT 协议、跑在 Postgres 加 pgvector 上。还专门列了弃用区，mem0 的旧 MCP 已归档，Graphiti 的 MCP 自己都说别上生产，这些坑提前就能绕开。

有一点要知道：清单由 Glen 团队维护，Glen 排第一是他们自己定的，其余按公开标准排序，这在清单里也写明了。

选记忆方案前花五分钟看一眼，能少踩好几个坑。

repos.name: vitali87/code-graph-rag
repos.description: The ultimate RAG for your monorepo. Query, understand, and edit multi-language codebases with the power of AI and knowledge graphs

tweet.text:
维护那种大型代码库的时候，最让人脑壳疼的，往往压根不是敲代码本身，而是得把那堆代码之间的千丝万缕给捋清楚：这个函数到底被谁调用了、各个模块之间是怎么勾连的、一旦改动了某处，又会牵连到哪些地方。

GitHub 上有个叫 Code-Graph-RAG 的项目，就掏出了一种全新的思路：把代码的结构跟调用关系，统统转换成知识图谱，塞进图数据库里，然后就能靠着自然语言，把整个项目盘问个底朝天。

它一口气支持 Python、TypeScript、Rust、Go、Java、C/C++ 等十几种语言，哪怕是混着好几种语言的项目，也能放在一块儿统一分析。

除了能用自然语言跟它一问一答，它还支持这些能耐：
分析函数的调用跟模块的依赖关系
揪出那些死代码
按结构模式去搜索和替换
甩给你代码优化方面的建议
动手改之前，先把变更的内容给你预览一遍
另外，它还能当成 MCP Server 来使，直接接进 Claude Code、Codex 这些 AI 编程工具里头。
碰上复杂的项目，要是想让 AI 不光是傻看文件，还能真正搞懂代码之间的关系，这个工具真值得你好好关注一下。

tweet.text:
Jev 应用圈又燃爆了 🔥

tamaratran 的 Bash 输出修剪器、parth-kp 的毫秒级邮件分拣、diegoag64 的 Jev 流量检查器、brainstormity 的推特情绪决策终端、fatwang2 的 Jev 自审项目目录……全网玩家把 Jev 玩成了下一代「上下文清洁工 + 邮箱分拣员 + 调试显微镜 + 行情参谋 + 开源图书管理员」:

“日志再长，也不让它撑爆上下文”！

“Jev 到底怎么判的，一眼看穿”！

“上千条推文，浓缩成一张决策卡”！

repos.name: botiverse/oar
repos.description: oar (Open Agent Runtime): programming interface for all agent harnesses

tweet.text:
前 Kimi 大佬 @xiaoxxchan  参与的开源项目 OAR
已经被 DeepSeek Harness 用上了  

一句话：它让你的产品用同一套代码，统一调度各种 Coding Agent 

 我再详细说一下，它解决了什么问题  

假设你想做一个自己的 AI 编程工具，让用户自己随便选：用 Claude Code、Codex，还是 DSH、甚至是 Pi 等等, 这听起来很简单，接进来不就行了？ 

但是真动手的时候就会发现，每家的接口都不台一样： 
怎么启动不一样
参数怎么传不一样
对话怎么保存不一样
干活过程怎么汇报也不一样 

接两三个还行，接十几个，光对接Agent的代码可能就比你自己的业务代码还多

OAR 干的事，就像一个万能转接头
各国插座形状都不同，但是有了转接头，你的电器只认一种插头就够了 

OAR 也一样：Claude Code、Codex、DSH、Pi 各家的差异，它在底下帮你抹平，你只写一套代码，想换哪个 Agent 改个名字就行  

它自己不做 Agent，只负责把各家 Agent 接到同一个口子上这就是所谓的「适配层」

开源项目地址：https://t.co/0jlt4jfpTp 怎么让 Muse 查东西更快更全？我给它接了一个外部的检索能力🔥

我平时很多事都是丢给 Muse 去做的，但让它去查平台里的内容一直不太顺：它得开着浏览器一页页翻，慢，有些数字翻了也拿不到。

这两天给 Muse 接上了 @Glasserai，拿一个自己真要用的问题实测了一遍，说几个真实感受：

1、接入｜一句话装好 在 Muse 里发一句官网给的 set up 指令，它自己去读说明、装好，然后给我一个登录链接和授权码，我在浏览器里点批准，它回来告诉我可用余额，就能用了。

2、接之前｜能查，但慢，字段不全 我写公众号，动笔前想知道同一个选题最近一周别人写了什么、阅读怎么样。先让 Muse 只靠自己去查最近一周公众号里关于"AI Agent"的 10 篇文章，它开着浏览器一篇篇翻，等了快 20 分钟，标题、公众号、日期、链接都有，阅读数一栏是"无"。

3、报价｜跑之前先算账 同一个问题换成用 Glasser 查。Muse 先列出要调的接口，微信搜索 $0.01 一次，文章阅读数 $0.01 一篇，按最大调用量算上限 $0.22，我确认了才开始。

4、结果｜1 分多钟出表 搜索一次返回 342 篇，取了前 10 篇，标题、公众号、发布日期、阅读数、原文链接整理成一张表，每一行都标了来源，可以点进去核对。

5、花费｜每一笔都对得上 实际花了 $0.11，1 次搜索加 10 次阅读数查询，一共 11 笔，每笔 $0.01，余额从 $12.98496 变成 $12.87496。

同一个问题，等的时间从二十分钟变成一分多钟，原来拿不到的阅读数也有了。

数据来自 TikHub，按次付费，不用订阅，每一笔扣费都有记录。

想试的可以用这个链接注册，送 1 美元额度，拿自己的问题跑一次：https://t.co/OUbY0oLa28

tweet.text:
holy f*ck, this is how you stop a Grok bot swarm from burning money

a swarm wastes money on 3 things: pointless status checks, rereading the full chat history and retry loops that never end

the goal is simple: your bots stay idle until there is real work

here are 20 free github repos that cut all three, in the order to use them:

1markitdown > turn pdfs, office files and web pages into clean markdown first, so the bot reads content and not layout https://t.co/KE8fMnKQBN

2docling > convert complex documents into structured text before the model ever sees them https://t.co/pCTIRloYon

3llmlingua > compress long inputs and keep the facts, so you pay for substance and not filler https://t.co/9cjgtQFyu9

4rtk > shrink noisy command output before it enters the conversation, so logs stop swallowing your context https://t.co/jqmzsgEbhq

5chonkie > split long documents into chunks so retrieval pulls the right passage and not the whole file https://t.co/FYjuQ8myhg

6chroma > an open source embedding database, search for the passage that matches the task https://t.co/fFTO30d3MJ

7mem0 > keep the facts that matter between runs, so each task starts with selected memory and not the whole conversation https://t.co/32DwRS4r6c

8qdrant > a vector search engine that returns only the pieces your bot needs https://t.co/q2CD59lfXj

9graphiti > store changing facts in a searchable graph and pull relevant context, instead of replaying the full history https://t.co/R1Lo3jpeqO

10gptcache > serve a saved answer to a similar request instead of generating it again https://t.co/Dwgh9Dt2YV

11helicone > an open source gateway and observability layer for model calls, with caching and cost tracking https://t.co/DsKn65D905

12routellm > send simple requests to a cheaper model and keep the strong one for work that needs it https://t.co/Q3DV4enTKe

13ollama > run a small local model for the cheap jobs, so the paid one only sees real work https://t.co/Y3s3KHV9JI

14litellm > one gateway for every model call, with spend tracking and budgets before a runaway bot eats the allowance https://t.co/5Ixq49nMzz

15apscheduler > run cheap checks on a schedule in python and wake the bot only when something changed https://t.co/pGzaEsPUy1

16tenacity > retry with limits and backoff, so a failed call stops after a few tries instead of looping forever https://t.co/APdcnmyz3l

17langfuse > open source tracing and cost tracking for every model call https://t.co/zIhWkuxVtn

18agentops > replay what each bot did in a session and see where the cost actually goes https://t.co/jrhA419Za9

19tokencost > calculate the token and dollar cost of a call before you send it https://t.co/T1PkVVcSZf

20promptfoo > test prompts and compare models on your own cases before you keep a cheaper setup https://t.co/Cil8UVQGKQ

start with the biggest leak: oversized inputs, repeated research, empty checks or failed calls that keep restarting

cut before you read > reuse before you generate > poll less > stop failed loops

then measure finished work against total spend, including the tools running around your bot

repos.name: ClickHouse/loom
repos.description: Shared long-term memory, document search and a code index for AI agents, linked to your code. Memories point at the files and symbols they're about and surface when an agent edits them. MCP server, Claude Code and Codex plugins, SDKs. Self-hosted on ClickHouse.

tweet.text:
your AI coding agent keeps making the same mistakes because it forgets what it learned in previous sessions.

these 7 GitHub projects are designed to fix that.

they help Claude Code remember project knowledge, reuse past solutions, detect outdated dependencies, find known bugs, and stop wasting tokens repeating work.

here’s what each one does:

1. TokenEconomizer : make your agent learn from experience

Microsoft Research’s plugin learns useful facts from completed coding sessions and brings them into future sessions. it also reduces unused tools and intervenes when the agent gets stuck.

https://t.co/I9vVQssYQh

2. Loom : shared memory between agents

ClickHouse’s self-hosted MCP server gives agents shared long-term memory, document search, and code intelligence, so one agent’s discoveries can help the next.

repos.name: chuanqisun/spaceship
repos.description: Steer ideas like a space pilot!

tweet.text:
holy sh*t, an MIT Media Lab researcher built an interface where you can steer an AI’s writing in real time instead of waiting for it to finish a response. 

this is seriously one of the coolest AI projects i’ve seen.

it’s called Spaceship IDE, built by Chuanqi Sun.

instead of treating AI like a chatbot where you type a prompt and accept whatever comes back, Spaceship explores a different way to collaborate with an LLM while it’s generating text.

here’s what makes it interesting:

→ focus monitor: visualize what the model is paying attention to.

→ attention lock: highlight specific phrases and influence what the model focuses on next.

→ future vector steering: adjust different dimensions of the task independently to influence the direction of the incoming text.

→ real-time regeneration: explore alternative continuations by scrubbing through possible directions.

imagine using this for long-form writing.

you’re working on an article, story, or essay. instead of repeatedly prompting the AI to rewrite paragraphs, you can interact with its direction as the text develops.

you and the model become collaborators. you’re not just giving instructions; you’re actively shaping the writing process.

and that’s what makes this project so interesting to me.

it also opens up a bigger question: what happens when AI becomes fast enough to respond to our decisions as quickly as we make them?

it’s an experimental prototype. you can explore the simulator, or connect your own Cerebras and Gemini API keys for live generation.

open source under the MIT license.

check comments for access link, save it and experiment with the demo.

repos.name: svayatta/agent-custody
repos.description: Proof of what your AI agents did. Give your agents real power, without losing control of them.

tweet.text:
Your agent called the tool. Can you prove what happened?

agent-custody is an authorization and audit toolkit for builders whose AI agents call tools, APIs, or other agents.

It helps you control tool access and review agent actions by checking calls against policy and creating signed receipts for allowed and denied calls.

Key features:

• Policy gateway – checks calls to MCP tools, REST APIs, and other agents using Cedar or Rego before forwarding them.
• Signed grants – a person authorizes an agent’s tools and sets how long that permission lasts.
• Verifiable receipts – records decisions in a Merkle transparency log; reviewers can verify receipts offline with public keys.
• Claude Code hook – starts in observe mode so you can review what the starter deny list would block before enforcing it.
• Traceable memory – links agent beliefs to the receipts that produced them, so incorrect beliefs can be traced and retracted.

Coverage matters: the gateway only covers calls routed through it. The coding hook isn’t a sandbox.

It’s open-source (Apache 2.0 license).

tweet.text:
🪐 收藏级！Awesome AI for Astronomy 把天文学里用 AI 的论文、模型、数据集和基准，整理成了一张能随手筛选的地图。

作者 Xin-Yu Xiao 的 GitHub 主页写着中国科学院大学，仓库带 Zenodo DOI，网页版能按年份、发表类型、有没有公开代码，筛 429 篇论文和 66 个软件包。

想入门天文 AI，最头疼的是论文散在 arXiv 各处，哪篇正式发表了、哪篇有代码，都得一篇篇点进去看。

Awesome AI for Astronomy 把天体物理、宇宙学、日球物理、行星科学分好节，每节按时间从新到旧排，同行评审过的用粗体标出，还用 DOI 或官方仓库核对过。从 AstroCLIP、AION-1 这类基础模型，到 AstroSage 这样的天文大模型，再到 AstroMLab 1 这种 4425 道选择题的基准，都能顺着找到。

另外还有一个每日栏目 AstroAI Today，用 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 筛 arXiv 新论文、写一句话摘要，这部分没经过人工审核，看的时候留个心眼。

天文加 AI 这个坑，从这一份开始挖就够了。

repos.name: knot07/AegisOps
repos.description: 御枢 · AegisOps — AI 安全运营工作台：告警研判、应急响应、漏洞整改，连接 Atlas、模型、工具与工作流。

tweet.text:
Security alerts, investigations, and vulnerability tracking don’t need separate tabs.

AegisOps is an AI-assisted security operations workbench for teams handling alert triage, incident response, and vulnerability remediation.

It helps you keep investigations and follow-up work together by connecting models, tools, and repeatable workflows in one interface, with human confirmation before alerts become incidents or vulnerability records.

Key features:

• Three workspaces – switch between alert triage, incident response, and vulnerability operations
• Atlas chat – select models, agents, skills, and workflows through a conversational interface
• Read-only host collection – gather investigation data from authorized Linux hosts over SSH and Windows hosts over WinRM
• Evidence and reports – keep collection results and file summaries together, then export Markdown reports separating facts from inferences
• Remediation tracking – record vulnerabilities, link affected assets, and track fixes through administrator retesting and archiving

You’ll need to configure your own models and connections; device workflows may need API and field-mapping adjustments. This isn’t autonomous incident response.

It’s open-source (Apache-2.0 license).

repos.name: ruvnet/sublinear-time-solver
repos.description: Rust + WASM sublinear-time solver for asymmetric diagonally dominant systems. Exposes Neumann series, push, and hybrid random-walk algorithms with npm/npx CLI and Flow-Nexus HTTP streaming for swarm cost propagation and verification.

tweet.text:
Need one value from a large system? You may not need the whole solution.

Sublinear Time Solver is a toolkit for builders working with sparse linear systems and graph ranking in JavaScript, Rust, or MCP clients.

It helps you answer targeted numerical questions by estimating individual solution entries or exploring a graph’s local neighborhood instead of computing every value.

Key features:

• Single-entry estimates – use random walks to estimate one solution value, with a standard error
• Local graph ranking – forward and backward push support personalized PageRank around selected nodes
• Sparse linear solves – choose iterative methods and inspect residuals to check solution accuracy
• Embeddable core – add solvers and PageRank to JavaScript apps with zero runtime dependencies
• CLI + MCP access – solve systems, inspect matrices, and rank graph nodes from a terminal or agent client

Local methods depend on the problem and accuracy required. Full-vector solves are not sublinear, and matrix setup or validation still has a cost.

It’s open-source (MIT license).

1️⃣ dimitritholen/pi-promptimize（https://t.co/oDOEbgIzLa）

在 Pi 里按 /promptimize 弹出窗口：随手写个粗糙提示词、选大中小三档长度，它就还你一份优化好的提示词；提示词缺关键信息时，还会先简短追问几句。
“乱写一句，交出一份专业需求”！

2️⃣ psychobarge/pi-spec-mode（https://t.co/8G2feUWgCn）

给 Pi 加一个规格模式：在 Pi 里起草、校验并持续维护项目的规格文档，先把要做什么写清楚再动手。
“先写清楚，再让 Agent 开工”！

3️⃣ taherchhabra/pi-managed-agents-api（https://t.co/y8nWpbT5Yw）

基于 Pi coding agent SDK 的自托管「托管 Agent」API + 浏览器控制台：定义 Agent、给它工作区、丢任务，它在 Docker 里跑代码或操作 Linux 桌面，保存会话、记录进度、产出可下载的文件。
“OpenAI 和 Claude 的托管 Agent，自己也能搭一套”！

4️⃣ MadeBy561/pi-tsp（https://t.co/RieZlqDnmW）

让 Pi 在 Tern 里原生渲染：Markdown 就是排好版的 Markdown，工具调用是卡片、差异是真 diff、子代理是能点开的行，还有模型和推理强度选择器；Pi 本体一行不改，离开 Tern 照常跑原版。
“终端里的文字墙，变成了真界面”！

5️⃣ marcioazam/ny-pi（https://t.co/S5b6ICcyKx）

Pi 的一整套外挂：包装器、扩展、钩子、技能、子代理和安装器，用同一个模型、同一批任务跟 Claude Code 和原版 Pi 正面对比；作者老实写明：比 Claude Code 便宜、比原版 Pi 解出更多题，但还没证明比 Claude Code 更强。
“敢把输的地方也写出来，才是真跑分”！

repos.name: hazel-js/hazeljs
repos.description: HazelJS Agent OS — durable TypeScript agents (DNA, Skillgate, Gatekeeper, crash-safe HITL) in your Node backend

tweet.text:
Build TypeScript agents without wiring every approval and recovery step yourself.

HazelJS is a TypeScript framework for building and running AI agents inside a Node.js backend.

It helps you move beyond a tool-calling demo by bringing agent execution, tool permissions, and human approvals into the same backend as your APIs. You can start locally with its CLI; Kubernetes is optional.

Key features:

• Agents in code – define agents and callable tools with @Agent and @Tool decorators
• OpenAPI to skills – turn selected API endpoints into agent tools with Skillgate
• Tool authorization – Gatekeeper checks tool calls with a default-deny policy
• Human approvals and recovery – durable runs support crash-safe approval steps and survive process restarts
• Local CLI workflow – scaffold an agent, apply its configuration, and inspect, resume, or approve runs from the terminal

It’s open-source (Apache 2.0 license).

repos.name: huggingface/pybot
repos.description: PyBot: a chatbot written in pure Python by a swarm of agents. No weights, no training, just rules.

tweet.text:
🐍 疯狂，Hugging Face 让一千多个 agent 合力手写出一个聊天机器人 PyBot，不要权重、不用训练，装好 Python 就能聊。

PyBot 是 Hugging Face 官方仓库刚放出来的实验，已经上了 Trendshift 日榜。

做法很离谱：超过 1000 个 agent 组成集群，前后写了、评了 5000 多个版本，最后堆出约 64 万行全是 if-else、正则和查找表的 Python 代码，外加 agent 自己写的约 55 万行测试。

结果也不是玩具。在 SmolTalkBench 上让 LLM 当评委，PyBot 的胜率从 0% 爬到了 26%，文档说这和 SmolLM-360M-Instruct 差不多。

想自己试试也简单，Python 3.8 以上就行，不装依赖、不下模型；打开详细模式，还能看到每句回复是哪个模块给的、花了多久。

一个权重都没有的聊天机器人，正好照出 agent 能把体力活堆到什么程度。

GitHub：https://t.co/9rjDm1BRtk

repos.name: SECHAK-AG/capptivo
repos.description: Give your demos the spotlight they deserve ( Mac/Windows/Linux ).

tweet.text:
录产品演示视频，鼠标在大屏幕上点来点去，看的人根本找不到点了哪儿，后期一段段手动加放大又特别费时间。

Capptivo 这款录屏工具开源了，对标的是 Screen Studio 这类付费软件，Windows、macOS、Linux 都有安装包。

录完打开，它会按鼠标点击的位置自动建议放大片段，镜头还能跟着光标平移，演示视频一下就有了运镜感。

GitHub：https://t.co/77EZNpPZMr

录制时可以直接在屏幕上画箭头、圈重点，再叠一个摄像头画中画，背景、圆角、阴影和光标样式都能调。

字幕用本地语音识别生成，不走云端。导出支持 MP4、WebM 和 GIF，帧率有 24、30、60 三档。

我觉得调好的样式能存成预设这点挺实用，每次录完套一下就是统一的风格，经常录教程的省不少事。

tweet.text:
Hermes 插件生态又燃爆了 🔥

Adolanium 的 Borealis 极光桌面、Cloeille 移植的 pstack 工程纪律包、Keys-Wasserman 的本地电影工作室、TacoTakumi 的全双工语音遥控、PlayForm 的 Aphrodite 输出压缩器……全网玩家把 Hermes 玩成了下一代「会呼吸的桌面 + 资深工程师外挂 + 私人片场 + 语音驾驶舱 + 上下文省钱机」:

1️⃣ Adolanium/hermes-borealis（https://t.co/LxpVQmUO3p）

Hermes Desktop 的动态点阵主题：夜里极光在三重山脊后升起、湖面倒影、月相跟今晚真实一致，白天变成粉青双色版画；在「Capabilities → Plugins」里从 Git 一键安装，不用开终端。
“写代码的窗口，也能看极光”！

2️⃣ Cloeille/pstack（https://t.co/MAPP3MJsTd）

把 poteto 的 pstack 工程纪律包移植成 Hermes 插件：一个总调度技能按任务分发到调查、修 Bug、做功能、性能、重构、长时间自主运行等打法，配套探索、设计、评审、委派、验证技能。
“给 Agent 装上资深工程师的肌肉记忆”！

3️⃣ Keys-Wasserman/hermes-imagination-studio（https://t.co/oytq66OZmv）

让 Hermes 指挥一整个本地生成工作室：图片、带声音的视频片段、配音、歌曲、音效、MV，在终端、桌面或 Telegram 里一句话下单，文件直接回到聊天；需要另装 Imagination Studio，不上云、不用积分。
“一句话开机，片场就在你电脑里”！

4️⃣ TacoTakumi/hermes-voice-unleashed（https://t.co/Qni9qWJcf2）

Hermes 的全双工语音界面：手机、平板、旧笔记本打开一个网页就能对它说话，它边写边念，你插话就能打断；页面实时显示每个工具调用和推理，审批也能直接说「允许」「拒绝」。
“动嘴就能开车，Agent 不再是哑巴”！

5️⃣ PlayForm/Aphrodite-Hermes（https://t.co/jAJaxwy46R）

工具输出压缩插件：在结果进模型之前拦下来，换成紧凑的结构化预览，Agent 看到的是十几个 Token 的摘要而不是几百个 Token 的原文，真需要时再按需取回全文；压缩逻辑全在 Rust 动态库里跑。
“上下文寸土寸金，先看目录再翻书”！

repos.name: vibeeval/vibecosystem
repos.description: Profile-based coding runtime for Claude Code and Codex. Lean core; opt-in quality, context, memory, orchestration and dashboard.

tweet.text:
Add agents and skills to Claude Code—without installing the whole catalog.

vibecosystem is a profile-based coding runtime that packages agents, skills, and hooks for Claude Code, with a separate adapter for Codex.

It helps you start with a focused coding setup by installing selected tools for investigation, implementation, review, and verification, then letting you opt into extra capabilities.

Key features:

• Core profile – start with selected components rather than the complete catalog
• Optional capability profiles – add quality checks, code context, memory, orchestration, or a local dashboard when needed
• Dry-run installation – preview the core installation before applying it
• Configuration diagnostics – inspect your installed setup with vibeco effective-config, doctor, and stats
• Codex adapter – install selected skills and an optional bounded worker through a separate installer

It’s open-source (MIT license).

tweet.text:
💰 Higgsfield 的开源版来了：Freefield 把 120 个出图、出视频、做特效和音频的创作应用搬到了 ComfyUI 上，模型全是开源权重，省下 Higgsfield 的会员费。

Freefield 仓库 10 月 20 号才建，一个月拿下 1.5K star，fork 也有将近 300 个。

以前这类一键出片的创作应用，基本都锁在付费平台里。Freefield 的每个应用就是 apps/ 下的一个文件夹，一份清单加一份 ComfyUI 工作流，不走任何 API 和合作方节点，模型从 Hugging Face 下载，许可证都写在清单里。

跑在哪也随你：Modal、RunPod、https://t.co/M8DX3gRDwL 上租卡，或者直接用自己的显卡。项目实验室在 Modal 上跑过 48 轮测试，733 个用例里 710 个跑通，120 个应用里 119 个已经标成可用。

也要说清楚：省下的是订阅费，GPU 还是得自己出；README 里 RunPod 和 https://t.co/M8DX3gRDwL 的链接是推荐链接，项目会从中拿到一点额度。

想把 AI 创作工具握在自己手里，Freefield 值得收藏试试。

repos.name: eisber/lox-cli
repos.description: AI agent tooling for Loxone Miniserver — natural language → config-as-code → deploy

tweet.text:
Test your Loxone automations before they touch your home.

lox-cli is a command-line toolkit for builders using AI agents to configure a Loxone Miniserver.

It helps you turn natural-language requests into testable home-automation logic by giving shell-capable agents commands to add blocks, wire connections, and run offline simulations before deployment.

Key features:

• Config-as-code – add logic blocks, set parameters, and wire sensors to actuators through CLI commands instead of manually placing every connection.
• Offline simulator – test signal behavior and multi-step scenarios, including timer delays, without connecting to hardware.
• Room templates – create bedroom configurations with lighting, blinds, and thermostat blocks rather than assembling each from scratch.
• Agent-friendly output – JSON output and skill references help tools such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI work with the configuration.
• GitOps history – download configurations, inspect diffs, and track changes with semantic commit messages.

It’s open-source (AGPL-3.0 license). A commercial license is also available.

repos.name: haziqahmedqasmi/PeakCut
repos.description: AI clipping for long videos and live streams. Self-hosted, bring your own AI key.

tweet.text:
一场两小时的直播回放，想剪几条高光发短视频，光是从头看一遍找片段，就得搭进去一个晚上。

PeakCut 是一个开源的 AI 切片工具，贴一个 YouTube 或 Twitch 链接，或者直接上传视频，它会自己挑出值得剪的片段。

先把语音转成文字，再让 AI 判断哪几段能留住陌生人，裁成 9:16 竖屏，配上逐字字幕和开头抓人的一句钩子。

GitHub：https://t.co/jjSuMIRolU

还能边录直播边切，按音量、聊天区的热闹程度和讲话内容抓高光，不用等直播结束再回头找。

AI 可以接 Gemini、OpenAI、Claude，也能用 Ollama 跑本地模型，一小时的视频大约只发 4 次请求。语音转文字在自己电脑上跑，音频不出本机。

第一次启动会自己下载 480 MB 左右的语音模型。我觉得贴心的是不填密钥也能用，这时按音量大小挑片段，先拿来试试水挺合适。

Astra created all the 3D models and generated visuals and Fable 5.2 for writing logic

repos.name: lexmount/moli
repos.description: Best headless browser for AI agents. Lite, Fast, High-Compatibility. Built in Rust

tweet.text:
竟有人拿 Rust 从零起步，亲手撸出一个浏览器，专门伺候 AI Agent 干活！

这个开源项目就叫 Moli。

早先让 Claude Code、Codex 去摆弄网页，隔三差五就得把 Chrome 拽起来，内存吞得吓人，响应还拖沓。

Moli 的打法相当狠：网页反正没人看，那索性连渲染都免了！

网页抓取、JavaScript 执行、自动化操作通通拿下，Playwright、CDP、WebDriver 也一并兼容。

项目自带的测试里，Moli 的内存占用比 Chrome 明显低出一截，AI 爬虫、Agent 自动化、批量网页处理拿它来使格外趁手。

🔗： ⁠https://t.co/PvyV6W9Y8t

Cada vez que le pides a un agente de IA que lea una web abre un Chrome entero.

Es como alquilar un camión para llevar una carta.

Cloudflare acaba de liberar el navegador open source hecho solo para agentes.

Sin Chromium. Ni un proceso de Chrome ni un contenedor detrás.

Está escrito en Rust, compilado a WebAssembly y corre dentro de Cloudflare Workers. Lee el HTML, aplica el CSS, ejecuta el JavaScript de la página y te devuelve el resultado.

Habla el protocolo de Chrome DevTools, así que Puppeteer, Playwright o cualquier agente con MCP funciona sin cambiar nada.

6 de agosto: lo presentan en su Agents Week, gratis en beta dentro de Browser Run.
Septiembre: añaden soporte WebMCP y mejor compatibilidad.
13 de noviembre: liberan el código con licencia Apache 2.0.

Celso Martinho, de Cloudflare, bromeó con que quien creó Workers en 2017 no pensaba en meter un navegador entero ahí dentro.

Cloudflare dice que gasta entre 3 y 7 veces menos CPU y memoria que Chromium.

Arranca por petición y se destruye al terminar. No guarda estado. Nace, hace su tarea y muere.

Con agentes abriendo decenas de páginas a la vez se nota muchísimo la diferencia de gasto

Aunque tiene algunas desventajas: 

No es pixel perfect. Según quien lo ha probado, va como el doble de lento que Chrome y no pasa CAPTCHAs.

Para webs pesadas o con anti-bots, Chromium sigue mandando.

Y si quieres alojarlo tú, según su README necesitas plan de pago de Workers y ponerle Cloudflare Access delante porque no trae autenticación propia.

Cosillas que puedes montar con él:

1. Briefing diario: un agente en Claude Code lee 20 webs de tu nicho cada mañana y te deja un resumen.

2. Vigilante de competencia: un Worker con cron que guarda el HTML de sus páginas de precios y te avisa cuando cambian.

3. Capturas y PDFs en lote: le pasas una lista de URLs y te devuelve screenshots sin abrir un solo navegador.

4. Datos para tus directorios: renderiza páginas con JavaScript y extrae el contenido limpio para alimentar un directorio o un RAG.

5. Agentes en paralelo: cada agente con su propio navegador sin que se te funda la RAM.

Cómo probarlo en 2 minutos:

✅ Entra al playground, sin registro
✅ Pega cualquier URL y ábrela en DevTools
✅ O desde tu terminal: brew install cloudflare/cloudflare/kitesurf

Los agentes ya no necesitan un Chrome entero para leer una web de texto.

tweet.text:
Your agents need shared files—not another folder stuck on your laptop.

puppyone Cloud is the cloud infrastructure behind puppyone, hosting projects as Git repositories for teams and agents.

It helps you keep project files available after you close your laptop by moving a folder into a cloud project, with access through the web app, Git, MCP, CLI, or REST API.

Key features:

• Standard Git support – clone, fetch, and push with your existing Git client.
• Shared version history – Git pushes, web edits, and API writes use one engine, so changes can be reviewed and rolled back.
• Revocable agent connections – pause or revoke individual MCP, Git, or CLI credentials, currently scoped to one project.
• Team access controls – organizations, project roles, invitations, and audit logs support collaboration.
• Local Docker setup – run the API, web app, and data services yourself to explore projects and file history.

The Docker stack is for local use; MCP, imports, and agent runs need additional services.

It’s open-source (Apache 2.0 license).

Checks robots.txt, sitemaps, canonicals, hreflang, structured data, Core Web Vitals and AI crawlers — then fixes them.

tweet.text:
Your site builds. Can search crawlers actually read it?

SEO Prompt Master is a technical SEO and AI-search audit toolkit for developers, combining a CLI, coding-agent skill, prompt library, and cited knowledge base.

It helps you find crawl and indexing problems by checking live server responses, then guiding your agent through prioritized fixes and verification—not just reviewing source code.

Key features:

• Live-site auditor – checks robots.txt, sitemaps, canonicals, hreflang, and soft 404s
• Coding-agent setup – installs audit instructions for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and Copilot
• Task-specific prompts – 47 prompts across 8 categories, including structured data and traffic-drop diagnosis
• Crawler access checks – shows which search-engine and AI crawlers your robots.txt allows or blocks
• Traceable reports – SEO and GEO scores with category breakdowns and findings linked to the knowledge base

The scores measure technical readiness, not ranking potential. Content quality, backlinks, and real field Core Web Vitals remain outside the auditor’s scope.

It’s open-source (MIT license).

repos.name: alookai/alook
repos.description: Multi-Agent Collaboration for Team and Friends

tweet.text:
Anthropic just released a 5-part architecture that shows how to build AI agents that handle inbox events, scheduled tasks, persistent memory, approvals, and follow-ups.

and the best part? the architecture is simpler than you think.

an always-on agent doesn’t run 24/7. it sleeps, wakes up when something happens, does its job, saves its progress, and goes back to sleep.

Anthropic breaks the architecture into 5 building blocks:

1. event inbox

every trigger goes into a durable queue.

emails, messages, webhooks, and other events land here. the agent picks them up, processes them, and can retry if something fails.

2. timers

this lets the agent handle scheduled tasks.

think daily reports, reminders, follow-ups, and recurring checks. when the timer fires, it creates an event that wakes the agent.

3. memory

the agent needs to know what happened before.

store its instructions, user preferences, previous messages, and task progress. load the essentials when it wakes up, then save new information before sleeping.

4. permissions

don’t give an agent unlimited access.

keep credentials outside the agent, control which tools it can use, and require human approval for sensitive actions.

5. outbox

this is how the agent communicates what it has done.

it can send a result, report that nothing needs attention, or request approval before continuing.

the complete loop looks like this:

event arrives → agent wakes up → loads memory → performs the task → saves progress → sends an update → goes back to sleep.

want to build something similar?

check out Alook, an open-source project for connecting people and coding agents through persistent rooms and inboxes.

it supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and Pi.

github: https://t.co/IIabgBcLlA

quick setup:

npx @alook/app onboard

then open http://localhost:15210

check the comments for Anthropic's full guide 

the big shift is this: stop building agents that only respond when you talk to them. build agents that can receive events, remember their work, and continue when something needs attention.

bookmark this if you’re planning to build your own always-on agent.

tweet.text:
Can your LLM spot the connection—and ignore the decoys?

Extended Connections is an LLM benchmark built around NYT Connections word puzzles, for builders evaluating verbal associative reasoning.

It helps you compare models on word grouping and resistance to misleading clues by publishing results on puzzles with added trick words—not just the original game.

Key features:

• 940-puzzle benchmark – compare published model results across the full extended puzzle set
• Extra decoy words – up to four added words per puzzle, checked not to fit any of its categories
• Completion-weighted scoring – quadratic scoring rewards four correct groups more heavily than partial solutions
• Newest-100 view – inspect recent-puzzle results separately, with a caveat that puzzle difficulty also changes
• Cost/performance charts – compare scores against estimated per-puzzle costs based on recorded token usage and listed prices

This is a focused reasoning test, not a measure of coding ability or general intelligence. It is not affiliated with The New York Times.

Free public GitHub repo.

Obsidian’s official agent skills, Karpathy’s LLM Wiki pattern, and a self-hosted AI second brain are all free on GitHub.

yet people still start their second brain with an empty folder.

here are 7 repos with 175K+ combined GitHub stars to help you build an AI-powered knowledge system.

01. Obsidian Skills : 52.7K ⭐

official skills from the Obsidian team. teach AI agents to work with Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas, and the Obsidian CLI.

https://t.co/NnHE8Ne7q6

02. LLM Wiki : Karpathy’s knowledge-base pattern

Andrej Karpathy’s idea for building a persistent wiki that AI can maintain. turn raw documents into connected Markdown knowledge instead of repeatedly asking AI to rediscover information.

https://t.co/bYBIi676D5

03. Khoj : 38.1K ⭐

a self-hostable AI second brain that answers questions from your documents and the web, with custom agents, automations, and deep research.

https://t.co/ygOOsXdmkk

04. Claudian : 16K ⭐

an Obsidian plugin that brings Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents directly into your vault. your vault becomes their working directory.

https://t.co/d3D94N60yp

05. Obsidian Copilot : 8K ⭐

run agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode inside Obsidian. let them inspect notes, create files, and handle multi-step knowledge work.

https://t.co/TBxiRQfin9

06. Kepano’s Obsidian Vault : 6K ⭐

the Obsidian CEO’s personal vault template. copy its folder structure, templates, and organization instead of building everything from scratch.

https://t.co/utx0BWaKgq

07. Basic Memory : 4K ⭐

a local-first Markdown memory system that lets AI read, write, and search your knowledge across conversations. works with Claude Code and other MCP-compatible clients.

https://t.co/oXJy8bExaK

HOW TO BUILD YOUR SECOND BRAIN

you don’t need all 7 tools running at once.

start with this workflow:

step 1: download Kepano’s vault template and open it in Obsidian.

step 2: install Obsidian Skills so your AI agent understands Obsidian’s Markdown, Bases, Canvas, and CLI.

step 3: install Claude Code and open your vault as its working directory.

step 4: give Claude Karpathy’s LLM Wiki gist and ask it to adapt the knowledge-base pattern to your vault.

step 5: use Basic Memory if you want persistent Markdown memory accessible across AI conversations.

step 6: add Claudian or Obsidian Copilot to bring your coding agents directly into your vault.

THE MEMORY WORKFLOW

→ raw: collect articles, documents, links, research, and ideas.

→ process: let your AI agent summarize and extract useful information.

→ connect: create related notes, backlinks, and knowledge pages.

→ index: maintain a clear map of everything inside your vault.

→ update: feed new information into the existing knowledge base instead of starting over.

the goal is simple:

stop making AI rediscover the same information every time you start a conversation.

build a knowledge base that gets more useful as you use it.

bookmark this and build your second brain tonight. 🔖

repos.name: afjcjsbx/picoclaw
repos.description: Ultra-lightweight, open-source, self-hosted personal AI assistant in Go for RISC-V, SBCs, and embedded systems. Active PicoClaw fork with WebUI, MCP, memory, multi-agent workflows, plugins, and chat apps.

tweet.text:
Put that spare Raspberry Pi to work as an AI assistant.

PicoClaw is a self-hosted personal AI assistant written in Go for builders running agents on small Linux boards and other hardware.

It helps you set up a tool-using assistant by combining a compiled agent runtime, browser-based configuration, and connections to hosted or local model servers.

Key features:

• Single-binary agent – precompiled builds for ARM, RISC-V, x86-64, and other architectures
• Browser-based setup – configure your model provider, connect a chat channel, and start the gateway from the Web UI
• Hosted + local models – connect providers such as Anthropic and OpenAI, or model servers running Ollama and vLLM
• MCP + plugins – extend the assistant with external tools and installable packages of skills and MCP servers
• Chat + scheduled tasks – use Telegram, Discord, or Slack, with reminders and recurring tasks through cron

It’s open-source (MIT license).

Link in the reply 👇

tweet.text:
یک ابزار کاربردی برای مدیریت متمرکز Skills پیدا کردم که می‌تونه مدیریت Skills، MCP و فایل‌های قوانین رو بین چندین AI Agent خیلی راحت‌تر کنه.

وقتی هم‌زمان از چند Agent استفاده می‌کنی و تعداد Skills نصب‌شده زیاد می‌شه، پیدا کردن اینکه چه Skillهایی داری، هرکدوم کجا نصب شدن و آیا محتوای نسخه‌های مختلفشون تغییر کرده یا نه، واقعاً دردسرسازه.

SkillBuddy این کار رو به‌صورت خودکار انجام می‌ده:

🔹 تمام Skills موجود روی سیستم رو اسکن می‌کنه و محل نصب و Agent مربوط به هرکدوم رو نشون می‌ده.

🔹 می‌تونی یک Skill رو روی چند Agent مختلف نصب کنی.

🔹 اگر نسخه‌های مختلف یک Skill با هم تفاوت داشته باشن، ابتدا می‌تونی تغییراتشون رو مقایسه کنی و بعد تصمیم بگیری کدوم نسخه با بقیه Sync بشه.

🔹 فایل‌های قوانین مثل "AGENTS.md" و "CLAUDE.md" رو هم بررسی می‌کنه تا مشخص بشه هر ابزار AI از چه قوانینی استفاده می‌کنه، ترتیب اجرای این قوانین چطوره و آیا فایل تکراری، ارجاع خراب یا محتوای ناسازگار وجود داره یا نه.

چند ویژگی مهم دیگه:

- پشتیبانی از Windows، macOS و Linux
- متن‌باز (Open Source)
- بدون نیاز به ساخت حساب کاربری
- آماده استفاده بلافاصله بعد از اجرا

اگر با چندین Agent کار می‌کنی، این ابزار می‌تونه مدیریت و یکپارچه‌سازی محیط کاری‌ات رو خیلی ساده‌تر کنه.

repos.name: xai-org/xai-cookbook
repos.description: A collection of pragmatic, real-world examples guiding you from basic to advanced use of xAI's Grok APIs.

tweet.text:
This is f*cking insane, the SpaceX team open sourced Grok’s own coding agent, and these 8 free repos show you how to build your own Grok bot on top of it

Do this in order and your own Grok bot will be taking shape before this list ends.

> Install Grok Build with the official installer from https://t.co/AmmdZEG2Sj: curl -fsSL https://t.co/ungmdbK0FQ | bash, then run grok. First launch opens your browser to log in.

> Want your own bot on the API? Run pip install xai-sdk, set XAI_API_KEY, and copy the first chat example from the xai cookbook.

> Open grok prompts and copy how the system prompts are built into your own system message.

> Give it tools one at a time. Add an MCP server with grok mcp add name -- command and check it with grok mcp list. Build your own with the MCP python sdk, then add browser use for websites and mem0 for memory. Test after each.

> Add plugins last, from the plugin marketplace, and read the code first. Third party plugins can run code on your machine.

That is the whole path. These are the 8 repos behind it:

-> grok build (by xai-org) https://t.co/j1LaUB4VGA
Grok’s own coding agent, open source, read the code and bend it to your bot with skills, plugins, hooks, MCP and subagents

-> python sdk (by modelcontextprotocol) https://t.co/FhwVURj1KN
the official MCP SDK, give your agent hands to reach any tool you build

-> xai cookbook (by xai-org) https://t.co/OFY62GpTlV
working examples for the Grok API, copy one and your bot talks

-> browser use (by browser-use) https://t.co/dce8aEwkkB
your agent opens websites, clicks and types like a person

-> grok prompts (by xai-org) https://t.co/uleBDV9RAq
the real prompts behind Grok and the grok bot on X, steal how they steer it

-> mem0 (by mem0ai) https://t.co/HA4gqn8wZW
memory so your agent stops forgetting you between sessions

-> xai sdk python (by xai-org) https://t.co/xe6jQkK2Xp
the official Python SDK, the shortest path from API key to a working bot

-> plugin marketplace (by xai-org) https://t.co/5zgeB6M2Xz
the official plugin catalog, add skills, subagents and hooks from one place

SpaceX already built the blueprint
the only thing missing is your bot

repos.name: wuyoscar/jev-skill
repos.description: An awesome collection of Jev use cases, workflows, and agent skills.

tweet.text:
Jev 应用生态又燃爆了 🔥

wuyoscar 的 Jev 技能大全、Datawhale 的中文入门教程、Sutro 的「人工标注 + GEPA」对齐工具、y0usaf 的 Pi 守门员、AkashPriyadarshii 的数据集筛子……全网玩家把 Jev 玩成了下一代「场景百科 + 新手村 + 函数调教台 + 编程安全闸 + 数据清洗机」:

1️⃣ wuyoscar/jev-skill（https://t.co/3YnRpzpeWC）

社区整理的 Jev 用例、工作流和编程 Agent 技能合集：71 个项目和资源、5 个技能、108 个场景，还有 14 组真实输入输出示例；一句话把安装提示交给你的 Agent 就能装（非官方）。
“Jev 负责判断，你的 Agent 负责动手”！

2️⃣ datawhalechina/jev-cookbook（https://t.co/iyc4QZ6EfO）

Datawhale 出的中文 Jev 入门教程：Jupyter Notebook 手把手讲 Choice、Score、Noul 三种问题原语，18 篇实战配方覆盖重排序、语义搜索、函数调用、引用核查、防护栏，还有语音智能家居和 12 个可运行的小项目；不配 API 密钥也能用离线示例学完。
“中文圈最友好的 Jev 新手村”！

3️⃣ sutro-sh/jev-align（https://t.co/8qHWhKLzeV）

Sutro 的实验性命令行工具：用 TypeSafe 等家的判断模型做「AI 函数」，自动找出模型拿不准的样本请你标注，再用 GEPA 把函数调得更准，上线后还能继续从真实数据里学习。
“你标几条，它就越判越准”！

4️⃣ y0usaf/pi-jev（https://t.co/b0Wpq6ffYT）

把 Jev 接进 Pi 编程 Agent 当判断层：bash、写文件、改文件之前先让 Jev 把一道关，命令输出也让它读一遍判断，再给模型一个 jev_ask 工具随时提问；pi install 一行装上（非官方）。
“Agent 每次动手前，都有个毫秒级守门员”！

5️⃣ AkashPriyadarshii/jev-curate（https://t.co/b191JkrHdv）

用 Jev 给训练数据过筛子：Rust + Python 写的数据集筛选流水线，流式读取 Parquet 和 JSONL，按规则给每一行打分、过滤，专门对付合成数据和预训练语料；作者标明目前是 Beta 版（非官方）。
“喂给模型之前，先让 Jev 把把关”！

tweet.text:
If I had to rebuild Anthropic's 1,000 agent setup with zero budget, I'd start with these 6 free GitHub repos...

369K stars between them, and the whole harness costs $0 to install

Here's what each one does once Fable 5.2 is in the chair:

1/ claude-code is the runtime. Opus 5.5 drives, and Fable 5.2 only steps in as advisor or orchestrator

2/ awesome-claude-code-subagents gives you 161+ ready subagents, so the advisor and the verifier are already written

3/ claude-code-hooks-mastery adds the gates. One hook routes every prompt, another blocks "done" until the checks pass

4/ ruflo runs the orchestrator and splits one big job into briefs for 5 to 8 builders at a time

5/ wshobson/agents brings 202 agents for reviews and evals, so nothing grades its own work

6/ awesome-claude-code is the library you grow. Every hard win becomes a skill the cheaper models can reuse

Same model that formalized Fermat in 30 hours. Your setup is one paste away ↓ full harness guide for Claude Fable 5.2 + jev engineering

one evening with this and Claude does the work of a small dev team

tweet.text:
🍃 清爽！Yab 这个 Mac 小浏览器又轻又快，离不开的 Chrome 扩展照样能装。

Yab 刚上了 Trendshift 日榜，Mac 和 iPhone 都有，两边可以开端到端加密同步。

在 Mac 上选浏览器经常两头为难：Safari 轻快但扩展少，Chrome 生态全但总觉得重。Yab 的做法是默认 WebKit，在 Apple 芯片上可以按标签页或按站点切到 Chromium，Chrome 扩展、DevTools 和网上应用店都能用。

广告拦截在请求发出之前就生效，⇧⌘H 能把网页上任何碍眼的元素永久藏掉；上次的标签页秒恢复，不点开就不占资源。

也接了 AI 代理：每个代理在自己的标签页里干活，碰不到隐私标签页，发送、付款、删除之前都会先问你。

想换个浏览器又舍不得 Chrome 扩展的，可以试试 Yab。

GitHub：https://t.co/RpQ9txCMNc

repos.name: RAIT-09/obsidian-agent-client
repos.description: Bring AI agents into Obsidian via Agent Client Protocol (ACP), such as Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI.

tweet.text:
build an Obsidian second brain that Claude Code can actually use, update, and learn from with these 7 free GitHub projects.

notes, links, agents, diagrams, and automated memory, all working together.

here are the 7 repos you need:

01. Obsidian Skills : official Obsidian skills

from the Obsidian team. gives AI agents the ability to work with the CLI, Markdown, Bases, and Canvas.

https://t.co/NnHE8Ne7q6

02. Claude Obsidian : an automatically organized second brain

drop in a source, let Claude read it, connect related information, and organize everything inside your vault.

https://t.co/kLgWHzEZco

03. Claudian : Claude Code inside Obsidian

brings Claude Code directly into your vault so you can work with your notes and projects without switching applications.

https://t.co/d3D94N60yp

04. Obsidian Copilot : run AI agents in your vault

connect agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode directly to your Obsidian workspace.

https://t.co/TBxiRQfin9

05. Smart Connections : automatically connect your notes

surfaces related notes and ideas while you work, helping you discover connections you might have missed.

https://t.co/JlGdYeNurZ

06. Visual Skills : turn notes into diagrams

transform plain text into visual diagrams using Obsidian Canvas, Excalidraw, and Mermaid.

https://t.co/7LkZjHKwhS

07. Obsidian Agent Client : connect multiple coding agents

connect Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI through the Agent Client Protocol.

https://t.co/eSqeHm9IkQ

PRACTICAL SETUP: build your AI second brain

you don’t need all 7 tools running at once. start with this workflow:

step 1: download Obsidian and create a new vault for your knowledge, projects, and research.

step 2: install Obsidian Skills so Claude Code understands how to work with your vault.

step 3: connect Claude Code using Claudian. open your vault as its working directory.

step 4: add Claude Obsidian to help process incoming information and organize your notes.

step 5: install Smart Connections to discover relationships between existing notes.

step 6: add Visual Skills when you want to turn written ideas into Canvas, Excalidraw, or Mermaid diagrams.

step 7: experiment with Obsidian Copilot or Agent Client if you want to connect additional AI coding agents.

start with a small test: add 5 research notes, ask Claude to summarize them, connect related ideas, and create a visual map of what you’ve learned.

the workflow is simple:

→ write: capture your ideas and information.

→ link: connect related notes automatically.

→ think: use AI agents to explore and organize your knowledge.

→ draw: turn complex ideas into visual diagrams.

→ remember: build a vault that keeps your knowledge accessible.

your Obsidian vault doesn’t have to be a folder full of forgotten notes.

turn it into a workspace where your ideas connect and your AI agents can actually use what you’ve learned.

bookmark this and start building your second brain. 🔖 Everything Grok bot. full breakdown https://t.co/ZtrH2Vm5nY

tweet.text:
Pi 插件生态又燃爆了 🔥

agegr 的浏览器版 Pi、rcarmo 的自托管 AI 工作台、robzolkos 的一键懒人全家桶、michaelmjhhhh 的实时状态侧栏、AgwaB 的多步骤工作流编排……全网玩家把 Pi 玩成了下一代「网页驾驶舱 + 私人工作站 + 懒人套餐 + 仪表盘 + 流水线工厂」:

1️⃣ agegr/pi-web（https://t.co/c983tvNz2d）

Pi 的本地浏览器界面：和 Pi 共用配置和会话文件，按项目浏览、恢复、分支对话，看上下文用量和花费，还能看文件、Git diff、切换 worktree，在网页里管模型、插件包和技能；npx 一行就能跑，支持简体和繁体中文界面。
“终端党也终于有了好看的驾驶舱”！

2️⃣ rcarmo/piclaw（https://t.co/ylq0YXnLpI）

基于 Pi 的自托管 AI 工作台：默认单用户，在同一个浏览器里和 Agent 对话、改文件、跑命令、看结果，桌面和手机布局都有，推荐用 Docker 跑在容器或独立机器里限制权限。
“把 Pi 装进自己的服务器，随时随地开工”！

3️⃣ robzolkos/LazyPi（https://t.co/3PgOCSPOwR）

Pi 本身极简，LazyPi 偏要「全都要」：一行 npx 帮你装好 Pi，再一键装上 Agent 工具、记忆、规划、终端 diff 审阅、Claude Code 提供方、长任务终端浮层、用量统计和主题；重复运行会自动跳过已装的包。
“懒人福音，一条命令配齐满血 Pi”！

4️⃣ michaelmjhhhh/pi-atelier（https://t.co/HgMs3umQ9W）

给 Pi 加一条响应式状态栏和实时活动侧栏：模型、上下文、Git 状态、用量、工具调用一直挂在眼前；pi install 一行装好，/atelier 或 F6 打开控制中心。
“Agent 在干嘛、花了多少，抬眼就知道”！

5️⃣ AgwaB/pi-workflow（https://t.co/3W5EqHRQIy）

让 Pi 跑有名字、可重复的多步骤工作流：调研、代码审查、规格一致性检查、影响评估和团队固定流程；基于 Pi 子 Agent，在各步骤之间传结果，全程留记录，可以查看、停下或续跑。
“一个人的 Pi，跑出了一个团队的流程”！

You need these 10 GitHub repos to get more out of the one you already use.

repos.name: Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory
repos.description: Durable, file-based long-term memory for AI agents. Five-package plugin family: SDK, CLI, MCP server, Hermes adapter, and a LangGraph BaseStore. No vector database, no embeddings.

tweet.text:
Hermes 插件生态又燃爆了 🔥

Sibyl Labs 的零向量长期记忆、moonlight-lupin 的分门别类技能库、Adolanium 的额度倒计时面板、AtlasOmnia 的实战技能大礼包、Peteryhs 的实时天空皮肤……全网玩家把 Hermes 玩成了下一代「记忆宫殿 + 技能军火库 + 额度管家 + 生活工具箱 + 桌面美学大师」:

1️⃣ Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory（https://t.co/Phh99ontnd）

本地优先的 Agent 长期记忆：SQLite 存储、五层分级结构、全文检索，不用向量数据库也不用嵌入模型，自带 Hermes Agent 适配包，在 LongMemEval 公开评测里拿到 95.6%。
“不靠向量，也能记住你说过的每件事”！

2️⃣ moonlight-lupin/agent-skills（https://t.co/M7ZdwBD35S）

专为 Hermes Agent 写的技能合集，按领域分好类：https://t.co/sCmU1AI8VD 生图生视频、深度研究、人物背景调查、新闻定时摘要、NotebookLM 式资料库问答、多模型盲测对比……每个技能独立成文件夹，想装哪个装哪个。
“一个仓库，就是一整支专家团”！

3️⃣ Adolanium/hermes-resetwatch（https://t.co/29bNpa1nfH）

Hermes Desktop 插件：把 Nous、Claude、Codex、Cursor 等已登录账号的剩余额度做成实时进度条，再告诉你每个额度什么时候恢复；只用本机已有的登录，不爬供应商网站，5 分钟自动刷新。
“额度还剩多少、几点回血，一眼看穿”！

4️⃣ AtlasOmnia/hermes-custom-pack（https://t.co/UHeDdRArEY）

一套在真实 Hermes 环境里反复用过、改过的实战包：苹果提醒事项、应用安全审查、Obsidian 每日总结、新闻摘要脚本、旅行规划、Discord 接入、网页 QA 等技能和插件，每个都能单独安装，附带验证步骤。
“别人踩过的坑，直接变成你的技能”！

5️⃣ Peteryhs/zephyr（https://t.co/ADE53Lbe5v）

给 Hermes 桌面版换上更好看的界面：按你所在城市算日出日落、按实时天气变化的动态天空背景，面板跟着光线变色，还有浮动侧边栏、宽标签页和可以钉住的数据卡片；下载一个插件文件放进目录、重启就生效。
“连 Agent 的窗外，都有了真实的天空”！

repos.name: om-ai-lab/VLX-Seek
repos.description: VLX-Seek is an efficient VLM that grounds fine-grained visual targets with high precision in wild environments.

tweet.text:
重庆鹅公岩大桥堵成停车场，想从这么多车里找出那 5 辆公交车，有多难？

重庆鹅公岩大桥堵成停车场。

不提前把目标类别写死，只用一句话，能不能从 233 辆车里只找出那 5 辆公交车？
我拿 VLX-Seek 试了一下，答案是：可以。

VLX-Seek 是 OmAI做的、面向 Physical AI 的视觉定位模型。

它不是只告诉你“画面里有什么”，而是能根据自然语言描述，直接把你要找的那一个，或者那一批目标，从画面里框出来。

如果目标不存在，还可以明确返回 None，而不是硬给一个框。

这次我测试的是一段重庆鹅公岩大桥的航拍视频。

演示里使用的是 VLX-Seek 1.5-3B。
我一句一句地问，画面里的高亮目标也跟着一层一层变：
🚌 公交车：5 辆
🚕 黄色出租车：23 辆
⚪ 白色轿车：112 辆
⚫ 黑色轿车：81 辆
🎨 其他颜色轿车：11 辆
🚚 货车：1 辆

同一帧画面，换一句描述，框出来的就是另一批目标。
这也是我觉得它最有意思的地方：不是把类别写死后做固定检测，而是真正“听懂你在找什么”。

它的实现方式也比较特别：
不是逐个往外生成一长串坐标，而是先生成候选区域，并给这些区域加上可引用的编号，再根据文字描述选择对应目标。

所以当目标很多时，表达方式会更高效。
当然，也说两句实话。

整张图直接丢进去时，远处的小车会有漏检，所以我是切块放大后再问的；

灰色、银色车辆有时也会被归进黑色。

它不是零失误，但“听懂一句话，只框你要的那一批”，这件事它确实做到了。

视频里的框是按秒做识别，中间再用光流跟踪目标。

对于无人机、摄像头、机器人这类需要“看懂并定位”的场景，这种能力很有价值。

补充说明一下：
本次演示使用的是 VLX-Seek 1.5-3B
目前官方已经公开开源的是 VLX-Seek 1.5-10B，权重、推理代码和技术说明都已放出。

在线体验： https://t.co/EY4uLhzihW
开源仓库： https://t.co/PB6zKFdNA5
官方账号 @OmAI_lab
想给摄像头、机器人、无人机加一双“听得懂话”的眼睛，可以看看这个。

repos.name: swamp-club/swamp
repos.description: Stinemates, Watson, Adam, Mahir, Paul

tweet.text:
Skills 2.0 is here!

(8x fewer tokens and 2x faster)

We package repeated workflows as skills all the time, but the agent still re-reads the skill and decides every step on every run, which costs tokens and time.

Devs just open-sourced Swamp, where your coding agent turns a repeated skill into a workflow that it builds once and runs again and again.

You describe the task once, and the agent breaks it into reusable behaviors connected in a workflow.

Every behavior has typed inputs and outputs, and plain code decides which step runs next. Swamp then gives you:

- model calls only on steps that need judgment
- secrets pulled from vaults and redacted from output
- versioned data from every run that you can query later
- a full record of what happened on each run

Here's the repo: https://t.co/GtaNpqAngp

(don't forget to star it ⭐ )

Swamp plugs into the coding agent you already use, like:

- Claude Code
- Codex
- Cursor
- OpenCode
- And 5 more agent harnesses

In Swamp, the model is a step in the workflow, not the thing deciding what happens next.

The model steps still reason like any LLM call.

However, in this case, code owns the loop, so the agent doesn't spend tokens rediscovering the same process every time.

Here's an official result, where they turned a code-review skill into a Swamp workflow:

- Skill in Codex: about 4.6M tokens, 23 agents, 12.8 minutes
- Swamp workflow: about 506K tokens, 3 agents, 6.6 minutes

That is ~8x fewer tokens in about half the time, and most of the savings came from replacing the coordinator agent with plain code.

You can keep using skills while you prototype. Once a task starts repeating, ask your agent to turn it into a Swamp workflow.

This helps answer practical questions such as:

- Which steps actually need a model?
- What exactly happened on last week's run?
- Can a cheaper model handle the one step that needs judgment?

Once it's built, you can run the workflow from your agent, the CLI, a schedule, or an API, with every run recorded.

So you are no longer paying a model to figure out the same workflow on every run.

Instead, you spend tokens only on the steps where the model's judgment adds something.

The animation below shows how Swamp differs from Skills, and I worked with the team to put this together.

If you want to understand the coordination layer that Swamp replaces with code, I wrote a full breakdown of how Claude Code splits work across subagents and agent teams.

It covers when a single subagent is enough, when you need a team of agents that coordinate with each other, and what that coordination costs in context and tokens.

Read it below.

repos.name: a2ui-project/a2ui
repos.description: Open-source generative UI framework: agents stream layout data, and apps render it with native components in React, Angular, Lit, Flutter, SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose.

tweet.text:
🧠 做 agent 应用的必备轮子 A2UI，让 AI 直接给用户生成能点能用的界面，而不是只回一段文字。

A2UI 上了 GitHub 热榜，已经 1.7 万 star、一千四百多个 fork，11 月 10 日前后刚把 Python SDK 和 CLI 一起发了新版。

以前做 agent 产品，想让 AI 返回一个表单或一张图表，要么让模型直接吐前端代码，安全和样式都管不住；要么自己写一堆解析逻辑兜底。

A2UI 换了个思路：界面用数据描述，不用代码。agent 只能从你预先定义好的组件目录里挑控件来拼，能做什么由 schema 卡死，再通过流式协议低延迟推到前端渲染。

前端这边 React、Angular、Lit、Flutter、SwiftUI 都有渲染器，agent 这边有 Python、TypeScript、Dart 的 SDK，还有接 MCP 的组件目录包。

以后 agent 回你的，可能不再是一段话，而是一个能直接点的界面。

GitHub：https://t.co/cerMPJjEXu

repos.name: codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x
repos.description: Master programming by recreating your favorite technologies from scratch.

tweet.text:
stop jumping between random coding tutorials. these 10 free resources give you a clear path from learning programming to building AI agents.

STEP 1: know what to learn

Developer Roadmap (372K stars)

interactive roadmaps for different developer roles. know what skills to learn, what comes next, and where to focus.

https://t.co/ZzxYyIRXpt

STEP 2: learn by building

Project Based Learning (290K stars)

a massive collection of tutorials where you learn programming by building real applications, organized by language.

https://t.co/tgnIfNi0Sm

Build Your Own X (562K stars)

learn how the technology works under the hood by recreating Git, Redis, databases, game engines, and more from scratch.

https://t.co/vq1IRtMx6E

STEP 3: understand AI

Generative AI for Beginners (123K stars)

Microsoft’s 21-lesson course covering everything from your first prompt to building generative AI applications.

https://t.co/D8WVT3fKqB

Neural Networks: Zero to Hero (25K stars)

Andrej Karpathy’s course with 8 lectures that take you from the basics to building a GPT model.

https://t.co/FeWEJxkp5C

LLMs from Scratch (107K stars)

learn how large language models work by building a ChatGPT-like model in PyTorch, step by step.

https://t.co/X7s0yUWkDI

STEP 4: build AI agents

AI Agents for Beginners (80K stars)

Microsoft’s practical course covering agent fundamentals, tools, RAG, planning, multi-agent systems, and more.

https://t.co/yxyCfXDhvY

MCP for Beginners (17.6K stars)

learn how to connect AI models to external tools and data using the Model Context Protocol, with examples in 6 programming languages.

https://t.co/1X25qoZmZT

Anthropic Academy

free courses and tutorials straight from Anthropic, covering Claude, Claude Code, prompting, and building with the Claude platform.

https://t.co/PqHKa4GdfY

STEP 5: think like a senior engineer

System Design Primer (377K stars)

learn how large-scale systems are designed, including databases, caching, load balancing, scalability, and common engineering trade-offs.

https://t.co/M70z65c6DR

you don’t need to study everything at once.

follow the order, build projects as you learn, and gradually move from writing code to understanding how entire systems work.

one step at a time beats 40 open tabs.

save this roadmap so you know exactly where to start. 🔖

repos.description: Free, local tool to track AI coding token usage and cost across 37 tools and agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini and more), by model, project, and task. npx codeburn

tweet.text:
Karpathy calls context engineering "the delicate art and science of filling the context window."

your agent fills it with 40 lines of git status.

that's why you hit your Claude limit by lunch. not too much work. too much junk going in.

10 repos that cut what your agent reads and writes, 665,427 GitHub stars between them:

git status: 40 lines → a 3-line summary → RTK
https://t.co/ONWju12ooC

a 10,144-token log dump → 1,260 tokens, same FATAL line found → Headroom
https://t.co/Iw4vFi3mSN

tool output stays in a sandbox, the agent takes only what it asks for → Context Mode
https://t.co/GooL5WxJgo

your whole project as a graph the agent queries instead of grepping → Graphify
https://t.co/gfBsKU43MR

edits by symbol, not by whole file → Serena
https://t.co/QUjU9tLEAW

reviews a change from a code graph instead of re-reading the repo → code-review-graph
https://t.co/h12ir2ATwb

asked for a date picker: 335 lines without it, 10 with it → Ponytail
https://t.co/Bpu4gyaCel

finds the file your agent re-reads every turn and the MCP server you never call → CodeBurn
https://t.co/b5MgyxzBbB

context and rate limit always on screen, with the reset time → Claude HUD
https://t.co/dErjcflaey

where your tokens went, per 5-hour window → ccusage
https://t.co/3OIKSqBZVc

(the numbers are each repo's own README. measure on your own work.)

which one would have saved your limit today? 👇 996,807 GitHub stars across 10 Claude skills.

What each one does, the install line, and when to reach for it. Every repo was updated this month.

Bookmark it. https://t.co/uHZcfBNS3a

repos.name: liuhaisi2026212-maker/taishang-laojun
repos.description: 太上老君·AI炼丹炉：抖音/小红书短视频创作 Skill。不知道拍啥、不会写稿，丢给你的 AI：找对标拆爆款、选题、系列策划、口播稿、标题、复盘、去AI味。Claude Code / Codex 等 npx 一行安装，豆包等聊天智能体用 Bot 版。

tweet.text:
⚗️ 有点东西，太上老君·AI炼丹炉 能把抖音、小红书的短视频口播稿交给 AI 来写，不知道拍啥，它也能先帮你出选题。

太上老君·AI炼丹炉 是一个装进 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 就能用的技能，基于抖音创作者“柳爷不迷糊”的创作思路，豆包这类聊天智能体也有对应的 Bot 版。

做短视频最卡的通常是动笔：对着空白文档憋半天，写出来像说明书，发出去没人看完。

它把流程拆成七个模块：选材、看火、丹方、开炉、回炉、收丹、成丹，从找对标、拆爆款、做系列策划，到出口播稿、起标题、看后台数据复盘哪一段掉人，都有对应的一步。最新的 0.8.0 还加了“爆了一条之后，下一条怎么接”。

项目自己也说得实在：不承诺播放、涨粉或收入，经验来自对自己作品的口述复盘，不等于验证过的因果。

想做号又总卡在“拍什么、怎么说”，可以拿它先练起来。

GitHub：https://t.co/1SdxRcoSD7

tweet.text:
this is insane 🤯

a 20-year-old Stanford student made a 90-second animated film that hit 14 million views using AI and 9 open-source tools.

he built the entire thing alone in his dorm with Claude Fable 5.2.

the characters, animation, choreography, soundtrack, sound effects, and editing. all handled through one connected pipeline.

now three major motion studios reportedly pay him to make films like it.

here are the 9 tools behind his workflow:

1. the illustrator → Illustrator MCP Server

lets Claude control Adobe Illustrator through chat, create artwork, and work with vector designs using dozens of tools.

https://t.co/BBgHJORsYl

2. the character rigger → Rigby2D

adds bones and skeletal structures to 2D characters so their arms, legs, and heads can move naturally.

https://t.co/6SglWkTMBf

3. the animator → AnimatedDrawings

Meta’s research project that turns static character drawings into animated figures that can walk, wave, and jump.

https://t.co/BhekMLecSA

4. the choreographer → OpenPose

extracts body, hand, face, and foot movements from real videos so animated characters can follow human motion.

https://t.co/zl5TiCsKgX

5. the background generator → Wan2.2

Alibaba’s open video generation model for creating cinematic scenes and moving backgrounds.

https://t.co/qMwrSAdBf2

6. the motion designer → Anime.js

creates animated titles, logos, transitions, and visual effects that sync with the video.

https://t.co/s9YGJvxwsF

7. the composer → AudioCraft

Meta’s audio generation library, including MusicGen for creating music from text descriptions.

https://t.co/3RmMZNZe2M

8. the foley artist → MMAudio

generates synchronized sound effects from video and text prompts, adding audio that matches what’s happening on screen.

https://t.co/xqisiz5j9X

9. the editor → Pireel

an open-source alternative to CapCut that AI agents can control through MCP, including its editing timeline.

https://t.co/P6t7oV6Dz9

now here’s the part that makes this even more interesting.

according to the breakdown, a traditional studio could charge around $3,600 and take a week to produce 90 seconds of animation.

his reported cost? one weekend and a $100 plan.

he also turned down a reported $65,000 annual offer and now sells films to studios for $1,100 each.

the bigger lesson isn’t that AI has replaced animation studios.

it’s that one person can now connect specialized tools and produce work that previously required an entire team.

9 repos. one creator. an entirely different production workflow.

watch the full breakdown and see the pipeline in action. 🔖 Claude Fable 5.2 is the most insane AI model in history...

99% of people will never touch it or burn money on it: "Too expensive", "Not for me"

Use it right, and it becomes your second BRAIN, for a fraction of the price

In this article, I show you how: https://t.co/5IFdgKfq4V

repos.name: middletoo/US_Stock_Crash_Monitor
repos.description: US stock market crash index/美股崩盘指数

tweet.text:
居然有人在 GitHub 上整出了一个美股崩盘风险监测仪。

这个名为 US Stock Crash Monitor 的开源项目，可不仅仅满足于盯着涨跌看，它把巴菲特指标、席勒市盈率（CAPE）、美债收益率曲线、200 日均线乖离，还有恐慌与贪婪指数等一众风险信号统统揉作一团，最后给你抛出一个 Crash Risk Score（崩盘风险分数）。

眼下它主要盯着 VOO 和 QQQ 这俩看，相当于直接给你的美股仓位安上了一块“风险仪表盘”。

当然，它肯定给不了“哪天铁定会崩盘”这种神级答案。这类指标其实更适合拿来瞅瞅估值、情绪和宏观风险有没有在同时升温，而不是让你拿去掐算具体的顶部。

repos.name: hefengxian/my-ielts
repos.description: 雅思词汇真经、雅思语法、听力 179、阅读 538  同义替换等。Everything during preparing for my IELTS exam.

tweet.text:
备考雅思，词汇书一本、语法视频一套、听力考点词又是另一份资料，手机电脑里存得到处都是，复习时来回翻。

my-ielts 是一个开源的雅思备考网站，作者把自己备考时用过的词汇、语法、听力、阅读、写作资料整理到了一起，打开网页就能用。

词汇这块最完整，收了《雅思词汇真经》的核心词和原书音频，按逻辑词群排好，还带练习模式和打字练习。

GitHub：https://t.co/T2055aps4m

听力有 179 个考点词，阅读有 538 组考点词同义替换，语法是新东方的视频、讲义和思维导图。

写作从《顾家北手把手教你雅思写作》的 100 句翻译练习起步，打基础挺合适。

挑的都是考生里最出名的那几本，省得自己一份份去找。作者写明了禁止商用，留着自己备考用就好。

repos.name: DasterProkio/awesome-ai-companion
repos.description: Open-source AI companions, desktop pets, long-term memory & proactive chat. 人机恋开源项目大全。让你的家机能够脱离官端自主存在，拥有记忆和主动性。

tweet.text:
💞 给想养个 AI 伴侣的朋友翻到一份宝藏清单：Awesome AI Companion，长期记忆、主动找你聊天、语音、桌宠的开源项目全收齐了。

Awesome AI Companion 在 GitHub 已经 1.2K star，中英双语，维护者说收录的项目都读过代码，新条目还会自动扫恶意代码和有漏洞的依赖。

自己搭一个 AI 伴侣，难的不是接个模型，而是让它记得你、会主动发消息、有声音有形象。这些零件散在各处，一个个搜、一个个试，很费时间。

这份清单按零件分好了类：客户端、虚拟手机、后台心跳和主动消息、记忆和情绪状态、语音和形象、语音识别……每个项目还标了状态，能直接用、要改一改、只是底层组件、还没做完，一眼就分得出来。AstrBot、GPT-SoVITS、Open-LLM-VTuber 这些熟面孔都在里面，停更的项目也会标出来。

想让 AI 从“问一句答一句”变成会惦记你的伙伴，从 Awesome AI Companion 开始拼就行。

repos.name: darktable-org/darktable
repos.description: darktable is an open source photography workflow application and raw developer

tweet.text:
GitHub is a goldmine for photographers.

I found 10 insane repos that help you edit RAW files, remove backgrounds, upscale, restore faces and organize your whole library. Some with AI. All free.

Bookmark this for later:

1. darktable

A free raw developer and photo workflow app. A virtual lighttable and darkroom for your photos, with optional AI masks, denoise and upscale.

https://t.co/Le21mKekWL

2. RawTherapee

Powerful raw photo processing for a huge range of cameras, on any computer.

https://t.co/a3emUUhGlk

3. Upscayl

A free AI image upscaler for Windows, Mac and Linux. 52K+ stars.

https://t.co/X9rS3PpCfF

4. rembg

Remove the background from any image. Use it as a command, a Python library, a server or in Docker.

https://t.co/98DnQVjsDa

5. IOPaint

Erase unwanted objects, people, defects and watermarks with AI, or replace them with something new.

https://t.co/YYLtXXTWS9

6. GFPGAN

Tencent's AI face restoration. It fixes blurry, low-quality faces, even in very rough photos.

https://t.co/eCBYphiK91

7. Immich

Your own Google Photos-style library on your own server. Phone backup, facial recognition, a world map and search by objects and faces.

https://t.co/oZDqvD92kM

8. PhotoPrism

An AI-powered, privacy-first photo app. It labels your pictures by content and location and recognizes faces.

https://t.co/5IOgfQr0zu

9. Czkawka

Find duplicate and similar photos, even at different sizes or with watermarks, and free up space.

https://t.co/PsVbbzLz0S

10. ExifTool

Read, edit or strip the metadata in your photos, including GPS location, for almost every camera brand.

https://t.co/MYlhECtSpV

What did I miss?

repos.name: Zagitta/gpu-unlock
repos.description: Your GeForce runs AI at half speed. This fixes it for 20/30/40 series cards. Up to 2× FP16 / BF16 / TF32 tensor throughput

tweet.text:
拿游戏显卡在本地出图、微调模型，总嫌速度不够快，第一反应往往是存钱换一张更贵的卡。

其实 RTX 20、30、40 系的游戏卡，在 AI 最常用的几种计算精度下，负责 AI 计算的张量核心只跑一半速度，同样的芯片做成专业卡就是全速。

gpu-unlock 这个开源项目就是把这道限速去掉，开机时赶在英伟达官方驱动接管显卡之前解锁，已斩获 19000+ Star。

GitHub：https://t.co/tZNQ83K1Rx

一张 RTX 3060 的矩阵算力从 27 涨到 51 TFLOPS，接近翻倍。换到实际任务上，ComfyUI 出图能快 30% 到 55%，LoRA 微调快 25% 到 50%。

不刷固件也不换驱动，解锁前后算出来的结果逐位一致，只是更快了。以后更新显卡驱动也不用重新弄一遍。

我觉得最划算的是一分钱不花，手上这张卡就能多出一截 AI 算力，本地经常跑 ComfyUI 的可以先拿它试试。

tweet.text:
GitHub 上有个爬虫项目最近热度很高，专门给 GPT 用。

适合想把某个站点的资料变成自己专属助手的场景，不用手动一页页复制。

而且淘宝和咸鱼的便宜货，很多用不了几天就无了

慢到李家河
缓存命中简直是灾难

如果你觉得能玩，再选择Ultra 也不迟

但是折腾半天都搞不定下载视频
没有找到下载按钮，没有找到下载链接，视频那么多想录屏那可是麻烦的很，而且画质还可能会掉。
趁着周末我研究了一番，直接做成了一个 Skill，开源分享给需要的朋友。亲测下来体验感还是非常不错的。

怎么用
1、把这个 Skill 丢给任意 Agent，Claude Code、Codex、Pi、WorkBuddy、豆包都可以直接用
2、装完直接口喷找视频：直接告诉他获取“XX”视频号最近15条视频
3、它就能把该视频号下最近15条视频下载下来
4、但是视频号的视频下载下来是加密的，Skill 会接着帮你解密，解密完点开就能看
后面想怎么学习、怎么剪、怎么加工，随你玩。
5、这个Skill 不仅仅只查某个视频号的，也能进行根据关键词进行搜索、功能非常丰富，详情也可以直接看这个Skill 或者Glasserai 这个平台

我背后接的平台
这里对接的是 @Glasserai，一个非常好用的数据平台：
1、内部已经对接了 80 家数据商
2、2280 多个接口数据
3、抖音、小红书、B站、微博、X、微信公众号，大部分平台都在里面
基本你想要的数据都能拉下来，再自己加工或者分析，想怎么玩怎么玩

性价比
我自己实测了一下：下载一个视频号视频只要 0.01 刀。
100 个视频 1 刀，不到 7 块钱，简直相当划算了。

⚠️ 提醒
1、目前注册就送 1 刀额度，有兴趣的可以先尽情体验：https://t.co/QeU4kO9cUq
2、Skill 开源地址：https://t.co/XBYf9PjWVR
经常要扒视频号素材的朋友，可以直接装上试试。

repos.name: Sigillion-AI/sigillion
repos.description: Lossless, local, provable memory for AI agents: every Claude Code session kept on your own computer, word for word, compressed and sealed, after compaction and after the 30-day transcript deletion. Claude Code first, every model next, then legal and finance. The waitlist, the releases, the website. Steddy Nova SRL.

tweet.text:
Claude Code’s memory is getting a serious upgrade.

7 GitHub repos with 150K+ stars combined are making AI coding agents remember what they did, show where their knowledge came from, and track what has changed.

and 5 of these projects only appeared in October.

here’s what each one does:

1. Claude-Mem : remember every session

captures your coding sessions, compresses the activity, and brings relevant context into future sessions.

117K+ stars.

https://t.co/VbIZ6rM1kV

2. Sigillion : keep an unaltered record

stores every session word for word on your machine, with sealed records you can verify to check whether anything changed.

https://t.co/syvDx7vol6

3. Mnemolo : build a source-backed project wiki

turns your projects into wiki pages where every sentence points back to the source lines.

https://t.co/At8WD996dS

4. Aletheia : make memory prove itself

attaches code evidence to every memory and checks it again whenever the agent recalls it. outdated memories get hidden.

https://t.co/CfPRDx8Vjp

5. Thenwise : search your coding history

search past Claude Code chats, commits, pull requests, and notes by date.

https://t.co/8wRfuhY0hP

6. Memsaga : track every change

turns changes to CLAUDE.md, memory, and skills into Git commits named after the session.

https://t.co/m13aV5lmCd

7. Graphiti : remember how facts evolve

builds temporal knowledge graphs that track how information and relationships change over time.

32.8K+ stars.

https://t.co/bEVVM8BBXU

here’s how the 7 fit together:

→ 1 and 2: what happened and what the agent knows.

→ 3 and 4: where that knowledge came from and whether it’s still valid.

→ 5, 6 and 7: what changed, when it changed, and why.

one important note: Sigillion is free for personal use. contact its makers before using it at work.

the bigger idea is simple: AI agents shouldn’t just remember things. they should be able to show their evidence.

full guide in the article below 🔖 https://t.co/iHlRQrIST2

repos.name: nobiyou/wx_channel
repos.description: 微信视频号下载工具

tweet.text:
🔥 卧槽，微信视频号的视频终于能一句话下载了
而且下载100个视频只需要0.07美元，不到五毛钱

兄弟们，有没有跟我一样的：刷到一个不错的微信视频号，想研究一下他的所有视频
但是折腾半天都搞不定下载视频
没有找到下载按钮，没有找到下载链接，视频那么多想录屏那可是麻烦的很，而且画质还可能会掉。
趁着周末我研究了一番，直接做成了一个 Skill，开源分享给需要的朋友。亲测下来体验感还是非常不错的。

怎么用
1、把这个 Skill 丢给任意 Agent，Claude Code、Codex、Pi、WorkBuddy、豆包都可以直接用
2、装完直接口喷找视频：直接告诉他获取“XX”视频号最近15条视频
3、它就能把该视频号下最近15条视频下载下来
4、但是视频号的视频下载下来是加密的，Skill 会接着帮你解密，解密完点开就能看
后面想怎么学习、怎么剪、怎么加工，随你玩。
5、这个Skill 不仅仅只查某个视频号的，也能进行根据关键词进行搜索、功能非常丰富，详情也可以直接看这个Skill 或者Glasserai 这个平台

我背后接的平台
这里对接的是 @Glasserai，一个非常好用的数据平台：
1、内部已经对接了 80 家数据商
2、2280 多个接口数据
3、抖音、小红书、B站、微博、X、微信公众号，大部分平台都在里面
基本你想要的数据都能拉下来，再自己加工或者分析，想怎么玩怎么玩

性价比
我自己实测了一下：下载一个视频号视频只要 0.01 刀。
100 个视频 1 刀，不到 7 块钱，简直相当划算了。

⚠️ 提醒
1、目前注册就送 1 刀额度，有兴趣的可以先尽情体验：https://t.co/QeU4kO9cUq
2、Skill 开源地址：https://t.co/XBYf9PjWVR
经常要扒视频号素材的朋友，可以直接装上试试。

repos.description: HarnessMM (arXiv 2610.32813) for pi: guarded decision reuse that runs a chain of dependent terminal steps inside one call instead of one model round trip per step

tweet.text:
Pi 扩展生态又燃爆了 🔥

jlon 的论文级省调用引擎、Chasen-Liao 的 Grok Bot 外包工人、efolchmontiel 的像素小绅士、win4r 的合同制交付流水线、LAIJiangFeng 的桌面多 Agent 工作台……全网玩家把 Pi 玩成了下一代「推理省钱器 + 云端打工人 + 终端电子宠物 + 质检流水线 + 并行开发车间」:

1️⃣ jlon/pi-harnessmm（https://t.co/8H4zBCX9ak）

把论文 HarnessMM 移植成 Pi 扩展：模型先写好一张带条件的「可执行决策图」，之后每一步只要上一条命令的结果满足条件（比如返回码为 0、输出里有 PASS），就直接执行，不再回头问模型；条件不满足或出错才把控制权交回；pi install 一行安装；23 星。
“想清楚一次，后面几步不用再烧推理”！

2️⃣ Chasen-Liao/grokbot-and-pi（https://t.co/QPOCLLGUR5）

GAP：让 Grok Bot 把重编码、批量改文件、长文档处理交给同一台机器上的 Pi 当子 Agent，Grok Bot 的额度只花在规划和验收上；带任务管理器 pi-task、断线恢复、空闲超时保护、防灾删除守卫和人工审批，有中文文档；21 星。
“Grok Bot 当经理，Pi 当工人”！

3️⃣ efolchmontiel/gentle-emote（https://t.co/2cOx6noCPC）

提示符左边坐着一个像素风小绅士，实时演出 Agent 在干什么：思考、读文件、写代码、调工具、提问、成功、失败、压缩上下文、派子 Agent……20 多种场景；只监听本地会话事件，不调模型、不占上下文、不联网；支持 Pi 和 Gentle Shell；19 星。

用阅读来改写人生：

专给工程师和科技迷们的一份严选必读书单（GitHub 项目）

这是一个冲着工程师和科技爱好者而来的高质量书单项目，目的就是想借着一本本系统性的阅读，给自己搭起一套能长久生利儿的认知与能力底子。

repos.name: bryllim/workout-guide
repos.description: 302 open exercise illustrations and a framework-neutral npm package by Bryl Lim

tweet.text:
🏋️ 做健身 App 的素材神器 Workout Guide 来了，302 个健身动作插图全部开源，每个动作三帧，连起来就是动画。

Workout Guide 在 GitHub 已经 1.4K star，两百多个 fork。作者 Bryl Lim 在开源的 Everkinetic 姿势插图基础上补了动作和动画帧，又统一整理了资源和元数据。

自己做健身小程序或 App，最头疼的往往不是代码，是图：请人画太贵，网上找的风格不统一，还有版权问题。

现在装上 Workout Guide 的 npm 包，按动作名取图，或者按器械筛，比如只要徒手动作，一个函数调用就拿到。906 张透明背景的 SVG 不挑框架，还有一个能搜索的在线图库可以先挑着看。

授权也清楚：代码 MIT，插图 CC BY-SA 4.0，商用记得署名并按同协议共享。

健身 App 的插图预算，这下能省下来了。

GitHub：https://t.co/WZXAfSiNU2

repos.name: majorminorlabs/hermes-voice
repos.description: Talk to a Hermes Agent profile through Home Assistant Assist

tweet.text:
Hermes 插件生态又燃爆了 🔥

majorminorlabs 的 Echo 音箱改造、nickvasilescu 的 AI 创作工作室、bruceleroyjr 的手表对讲机、tonbistudio 的投放看板、ateymoori 的口袋客户端……全网玩家把 Hermes 玩成了下一代「智能音箱大脑 + 影音工作室 + 腕上指挥官 + 营销仪表盘 + 随身 App」:

1️⃣ majorminorlabs/hermes-voice（https://t.co/eUfXyoip82）

通过 Home Assistant 的 Assist，用一台刷了 echo-dot-assist 的旧亚马逊 Echo 跟你的 Hermes 对话；Echo Show 的屏幕还会同步显示它听到了什么、正在写的回答、正在用的工具，闲时显示后台任务；作者提醒买二手机前先核对型号和固件；706 星。
“旧 Alexa 换脑，客厅住进了 Hermes”！

2️⃣ nickvasilescu/parallax（https://t.co/ej16bKxY9s）

开源的 AI 图片、视频、音频工作室：画图、视频、配音、音乐各有工作台，还有社区、素材库、积分、开发者 API，以及能替你规划和制作的 Agent 聊天，可以跑在你自己的 Hermes 上；npm run dev 就能启动，没填模型 key 也能用示例文件全程体验；137 星。
“一个人，一整间 AI 影音工作室”！

3️⃣ bruceleroyjr/hermes-watch（https://t.co/jNiYDS7lNP）

在 Amazfit 手表上跟 Hermes 对话：点 TALK 说话，电脑用 Whisper 转写，答案先以文字出现在手腕上再读出来；Hermes 让 Claude Code 改文件时，手表弹出批准、拒绝、回复卡片，批准后可以关掉 App，结果发到 Telegram 再震你一下；26 星。
“抬手一点，就批准了一次代码修改”！

4️⃣ tonbistudio/hermes-marketing-dashboard（https://t.co/HxRPIMD3N9）

给 Hermes 桌面版加一个只读的营销页：广告花费对照总预算、投放节奏、剩余天数、从点击到转化的漏斗，按日投放、按版位/年龄/性别拆分、待你审批的方案和预算设置一目了然；它只读文件画图，从不改任何东西；17 星。
“Agent 负责投放，你只管看盘拍板”！

5️⃣ ateymoori/pomelu（https://t.co/mzq27CjBIb）

Hermes 的开源手机客户端，iPhone、iPad、安卓手机、折叠屏和平板都能用：连上你自托管的 Hermes 网关，把每个 Bot 装进口袋；不用注册账号、不追踪，聊天只在手机和你自己的 Agent 之间走；需要 Hermes Agent 0.21.5 及以上；12 星。
“自己的 Agent，随身带着走”！

repos.name: steipete/summarize
repos.description: Point at any URL/YouTube/Podcast or file. Get the gist. CLI and Chrome Extension.

tweet.text:
两个小时的播客、四十分钟的 YouTube 视频，存下来的时候想着有空再看，结果一放就是好几个月。

summarize 这个开源工具，只需丢给它一个网页、视频、播客或者 PDF，它先把正文和字幕扒下来，再交给大模型写成摘要。

YouTube 和播客会先用现成的字幕和文字稿，没有才自己转写。视频还能按画面切出一张张幻灯片截图，带上时间点，翻起来很快。

GitHub：https://t.co/VJMELALxdW

不想敲命令的话，装个 Chrome 侧边栏插件就行，当前页面一键总结，看完还能接着跟页面内容聊。界面支持 14 种语言，简体中文也在里面。

模型这块很随意，自己的 API、本地 Ollama、OpenRouter 的免费模型都能接。已经登录好的 Codex、Claude 这类命令行工具也能直接拿来用，这点我觉得挺省心，不用另外再配一套。

稍后再看列表里堆了一堆长视频的，可以先拿它过一遍摘要，再决定哪些值得花时间看完。

repos.name: RikiyaT/lm_understand-logs
repos.description: Complete logs of the experiments in the blog post 'LLMs can understand and write neural network weights'

tweet.text:
🧐 颠覆认知，lm_understand-logs 公开了一组实验的全部过程：让大模型直接读懂、甚至从零写出神经网络的权重。

lm_understand-logs 上了 Trendshift 日榜，GitHub 已经 1.2K star，它是博文《Sparks of Weight Space Programming》背后八项实验的完整日志。

八个实验个个离谱：只看权重判断一个网络是拿哪个游戏训出来的、修好一个坏掉的网络、从零写一个 150 万权重的围棋网络、揪出一个爱拍马屁的语言模型、给模型提升数学能力。用的是 OpenAI 的 gpt-6-astra，通过 Codex CLI 调用。

很多 AI 研究只给结论，你没法知道模型到底是怎么做到的。这份日志把 1125 轮对话全摊开：发给模型什么、模型回了什么、跑了哪段代码、每个数值怎么评估，都在里面。Codex 自带的搜索、子代理这些工具全关了，每一轮都审计过是无工具轮次，想复核结论可以一轮一轮对着看。

AI 开始直接改 AI 的权重了，这份日志值得研究的人存一份。

GitHub：https://t.co/zJRNghXV48

repos.name: Eynnzerr/TelemetryCleaner
repos.description: 基于 Shizuku 免 Root 清除国产安卓 SystemHelper、RegService 等系统预装隐私数据收集模块

tweet.text:
🛡️ 细思极恐，国行安卓手机里预装的运营商组件可能一直在上报数据，TelemetryCleaner 能免 Root 把它们找出来卸掉。

TelemetryCleaner 上了 Trendshift 日榜，11 号建仓，几天里已经发到 v1.3。项目引用了 WiSec 2023 的流量测量：部分国行样机上能观察到运营商组件上报数据，小米和 ColorOS 样本里的中国移动组件上报了已安装软件列表。

以前想清掉这些系统预装组件，要么解锁 Root，要么自己敲 adb 命令，不少 ROM 还会在命令层直接拦住卸载。

TelemetryCleaner 借 Shizuku 拿到 shell 权限，Android 11 以上开个无线调试就能用：列出预装的运营商组件和它们的权限，按空间卸载并清掉数据，后悔了还能用系统保留的 APK 恢复。联通、OPPO、小米、华为的多个组件作者标了实测。

也要提醒一句：作者声明项目是学习用途，vivo 部分机型暂时只能冻结，还有人反馈卸掉 vivo 的 Device Management 后通话录音失效。动系统组件之前先想清楚，后果自己担。

手机里是谁在悄悄上报，自己心里得有数。

GitHub：https://t.co/8K78m4DpyI

repos.name: hridaya423/phonedriver
repos.description: MCP server and CLI that lets AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) see and control Android phones and iPhones. Reads the screen as text. Asks before it pays.

tweet.text:
想让 Claude Code 帮忙测一遍自己做的 App 应用，但无法帮忙操作手机点按钮、填表单、看界面，还得我们自己上手。

phonedriver 就是给 Agent 配了一台手机，Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 这些都能直接操作安卓手机和 iPhone，模拟器和真机都行。

作者的演示挺直观，让 Claude Code 去点一份大号披萨，它自己找门店、加购物车、填结账信息，点到付款那一步停下来问人，最后没下单。

GitHub：https://t.co/6s9SoEsfMl

它把每一屏读成一张带编号的文字清单，模型按编号点，点完只回报界面上变了什么，不用每一步都截图。

作者拿 9 个手机任务做了对比，同样的活，mobile-mcp 用掉的 token 是它的 6.9 倍。

碰到付款先停下来问人，这点我觉得很关键，不然真不敢让它碰自己的手机。

做 App 的，让它把新用户第一次打开 App 的流程走一遍找 Bug，挺合适。

tweet.text:
在 GitHub 上硬是拿下了 3900 Star 的证件照利器，名字叫作 LiYing（丽影），这玩意儿确实值得好好安利一波。

人脸和人体，它自己就能分得清清楚楚，角度歪了会自动帮你调正，抠图和换底色这种事全不用你瞎操心，还能照着各种规格把证件照裁切好，就连最后的排版，都顺手替你安排得妥妥当当。

a graph mind map where notes, links, code and AI agents live together

whiteboards and Notion style notes in one local-first second brain

these are the repos that make it one
