repos.name: dsh-market/dsh-market
repos.description: The plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness — browse, search, one-click install · DSH 可视化插件市场

tweet.text:
DeepSeek Harness 客户端开启启动画面 🔥

上次安装了插件市场发现里面已经有 9.4K 个插件了

插件类型丰富，包括

娱乐、主题外观、安全与权限、语音与音频
浏览器与网页、视觉与多模态、身份与通信
会话与消息、记忆、工具与能力 等等等

视频中目前就安装了几个

1、插件市场与管理：dshmarket
2、启动动画：dsh-startup-screen
3、壁纸设置：dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine
3、用量与计费：小鲸鱼 dsh-whale-widget

有需要的直接到插件市场里面找一下对应的插件就好了
实在找不到，自己开发一个，给我玩玩 🚨 梁子最近杀疯了。
如果你装了梁子最近开源的 Super-agent

下面这几个小插件，我建议你也来看看
很多时候能帮你不少忙，解决不少问题。

我把社区里的插件和 README 翻了一遍，只留下解决实际问题的。

默认用 web profile，命令可以直接复制。

1、dsh-market
在设置页里浏览、搜索和安装插件，不用满 GitHub 找。
dsh plugin --profile web add dshmarket
https://t.co/Sx3kHvS5eF

2、dsh-context
看上下文窗口到底被什么占了，每次请求和每条消息的 Token 都能查。
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-context
https://t.co/mSxPOEhhhI

3、dsh-cost-meter
看单会话和每日费用、预算占比、官方余额，也支持峰谷计价。
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter
https://t.co/Yc9wv1gn5N

4、dsh-auto-memory
跨会话记忆，纯文件存储，不用额外服务和 embedding。
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-auto-memory
https://t.co/Xe8drnL4y2

5、DSH-better-sidebar
把侧边栏变成工作台，文件预览和编辑、终端、Git、子 Agent 都能在里面看。
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar
https://t.co/h3w08Gz04g

6、dsh-taskboard
人建卡片，Agent 认领执行，人再验收。cron 跑在 host 端，不用一直开着浏览器。
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-taskboard
https://t.co/teiOL1ziuF

7、dsh-permission-rules
用一个 YAML 写 allow / deny / ask，还能按域名、IP、端口管网络。
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-permission-rules
https://t.co/Z5BIEs4ETW

8、dsh-rewind
Agent 跑偏了直接回退。每条用户消息旁有个按钮，点一下就能把上下文退回到那里，也可以选择连文件一起回滚。
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-rewind-plugin
https://t.co/EvfwkGO0Yf

9、dsh-auto-continue
网络、超时或 host 崩溃导致中断后，自动发 Continue 接着跑。
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HsiangNianian/dsh-auto-continue
https://t.co/U9mVaSxyGf

10、dsh-bili-scroll
每天替你搜 B 站视频，读完字幕再挑内容，写成 Markdown 日报。
需要 dsh ≥ 0.1.7-rc.1，以及 Python 3.10+ 或 uv，还要扫码登录。
dsh plugin --profile web add github:c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll
https://t.co/BJzWi8mly3

插件不是越多越好，先把账单、上下文和权限这三样看住，再谈别的。

最后再附上梁子的超级同事：https://t.co/0rBAkpT1yw

下面这几个小插件，我建议你也来看看
很多时候能帮你不少忙，解决不少问题。

我把社区里的插件和 README 翻了一遍，只留下解决实际问题的。

默认用 web profile，命令可以直接复制。

1、dsh-market
在设置页里浏览、搜索和安装插件，不用满 GitHub 找。
dsh plugin --profile web add dshmarket
https://t.co/Sx3kHvS5eF

2、dsh-context
看上下文窗口到底被什么占了，每次请求和每条消息的 Token 都能查。
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-context
https://t.co/mSxPOEhhhI

3、dsh-cost-meter
看单会话和每日费用、预算占比、官方余额，也支持峰谷计价。
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter
https://t.co/Yc9wv1gn5N

4、dsh-auto-memory
跨会话记忆，纯文件存储，不用额外服务和 embedding。
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-auto-memory
https://t.co/Xe8drnL4y2

5、DSH-better-sidebar
把侧边栏变成工作台，文件预览和编辑、终端、Git、子 Agent 都能在里面看。
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar
https://t.co/h3w08Gz04g

6、dsh-taskboard
人建卡片，Agent 认领执行，人再验收。cron 跑在 host 端，不用一直开着浏览器。
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-taskboard
https://t.co/teiOL1ziuF

7、dsh-permission-rules
用一个 YAML 写 allow / deny / ask，还能按域名、IP、端口管网络。
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-permission-rules
https://t.co/Z5BIEs4ETW

8、dsh-rewind
Agent 跑偏了直接回退。每条用户消息旁有个按钮，点一下就能把上下文退回到那里，也可以选择连文件一起回滚。
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-rewind-plugin
https://t.co/EvfwkGO0Yf

9、dsh-auto-continue
网络、超时或 host 崩溃导致中断后，自动发 Continue 接着跑。
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HsiangNianian/dsh-auto-continue
https://t.co/U9mVaSxyGf

10、dsh-bili-scroll
每天替你搜 B 站视频，读完字幕再挑内容，写成 Markdown 日报。
需要 dsh ≥ 0.1.7-rc.1，以及 Python 3.10+ 或 uv，还要扫码登录。
dsh plugin --profile web add github:c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll
https://t.co/BJzWi8mly3

插件不是越多越好，先把账单、上下文和权限这三样看住，再谈别的。

最后再附上梁子的超级同事：https://t.co/0rBAkpT1yw

tweet.text:
closed-source has nowhere left to hide...

this is f*cking dangerous

15 GitHub repos that turn any app, binary or service inside out, in the order i actually use them.

identify it : 

1. Detect-It-Easy → format, compiler and packer in one click
https://t.co/bLVnGU9OOd

2. capa → lists what a program can do: network, crypto, services
https://t.co/jOPItvETZc

3. ImHex → hex editor for files nobody documented
https://t.co/vPzlDttuQq

4. LIEF → parse and edit PE, ELF and Mach-O from code
https://t.co/lR5zCLNQzg

read the logic ↓

5. Ghidra → the NSA's free decompiler
https://t.co/ZJzsxrUUNq

6. GhidraMCP → hands Ghidra to your AI agent
https://t.co/qsJCNDF1Cv

7. angr → symbolic execution for the hard cases
https://t.co/JpNKggGE1I

watch it run ↓

8. Frida → hooks into a live app and watches its calls
https://t.co/Ynuvbl4eRn

9. objection → Frida toolkit for mobile, ready out of the box
https://t.co/mBb0xsSDpg

open the app itself ↓

10. jadx → Android APK back to readable Java
https://t.co/3pLch5DnXu

11. Apktool → resources, manifest and smali, then rebuild
https://t.co/qDsyZmDQ1g

12. ILSpy → .NET back to readable C#
https://t.co/CLaMgMDq2j

13. asar → unpacks the JS inside any Electron app
https://t.co/5awEgvwm93

follow the traffic ↓

14. mitmproxy → sits in the middle and reads every request
https://t.co/9O3GKQOji1

15. Wireshark → every packet, every protocol
https://t.co/iP55ilbNHv

no app is a black box anymore.

GitHub is hiding a MONSTER collection of Instagram automation tools.

I found 10 repos that can help you create viral Reels, spy on competitors, and automate content like a full-time agency.

This feels like cheating:

1. Instagram Agent Skill

Find Reels that beat a creator’s usual numbers. Break down their hooks, then turn those patterns into scripts and shot plans you can film.

https://t.co/Cw6R7GpR5n

2. Social Media Skills

Give it a reference Reel or transcript. It breaks down the hook and structure, then helps you write an original script in your own voice.

https://t.co/B5UQOnMQVt

3. Instaloader

Save Instagram posts, videos, captions, and metadata so you can study what competitors post and which formats they keep coming back to.

https://t.co/ctQ6GCsEJq

4. Instagrapi

Build custom Python workflows for profile lookups, media downloads, and Reel uploads. It uses Instagram’s unofficial API.

https://t.co/dtO7oWcCtb

5. AI YouTube Shorts Generator

Turn a long video into Reel-ready clips. It ranks highlights, transcribes speech with Whisper, and crops to vertical with face tracking in local mode.

https://t.co/kpYkdsZcd9

6. Herk Edit Kit

Give Claude Code or Codex a playbook for editing Reels. Cut dead air, edit from transcripts, and add captions and motion graphics.

https://t.co/MfmKIQoZ7u

7. ShortGPT

Make faceless videos from a script, AI voiceover, and background footage. A useful starting point if you don’t want to film every clip yourself.

https://t.co/vroXot8xja

8. AutoSubs

Generate subtitles on your own machine and bring them straight into DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, or After Effects.

https://t.co/wwfJ17C5vI

9. Editly

Build a video template once, then swap clips, titles, and music to render new versions. Handy for a recurring Reel series.

https://t.co/Rx48ccKx7b

10. Pipedream

Set up a timed workflow that publishes finished Reels through Meta’s official API. You’ll need a connected Instagram Business or Creator account.

https://t.co/mBnZEPjWve

What did I miss?

repos.name: anywhere-labs/Agents-Anywhere
repos.description: 跨设备的开源Agent工作台

tweet.text:
果然大家的痛点都是一样的，都想躺着把活干了~

前两天发的大肥鱼（DSH）那 7 个野生插件，没想到收藏点赞最多的是那个"手机远程盯 Agent"，

很多人的痛点都是：平时要在Claude Code、Codex或者DSH之间切换，但人经常在外面又不想带电脑，就像知道能用手机一起处理的方案？

你别说真给我挖到一个宝藏开源项目，仓库地址和 4 个最实用的用法直接整理在下面，建议先收藏：

平时人离开工位想盯AI做任务，基本就三类，但都有点麻烦：
- 开传统远程桌面：在手机小屏上两根手指放大缩小搓终端，点个按钮眼都快看瞎了；
- 挂飞书/TG 机器人：只能纯聊天，看不到项目文件树，改了哪行代码心里没底；
- 装单一 Agent 野生手机端：只能管某一个工具，手头同时开着 Claude Code、Codex 和 DSH 还得来回切 App。

今天看到有人直接开源了一个统一工作台项目 Agents Anywhere（就是之前做 DSH Desktop 的团队出的）。翻完它刚更新的 2.1 仓库和文档，我觉得最值得配起来的有这 4 个点：
1. 一个入口同时管所有电脑上的 Claude Code + Codex + DSH
不管你是 Mac 上跑着 Codex、公司开发机挂着 Claude Code，还是家里电脑养着大肥鱼，只要在电脑上装个桌面端（无图形界面的 Linux 服务器也有 Connector CLI），手机上就能按「设备 → 项目 → 会话」随便切，不用一个工具装一套轮子。

2. 直接接管电脑上已打开的 Codex 原窗口审批（2.1 最实用更新）
以前很多远程工具只能“新建一条会话”，接不上电脑里正在跑的活。
比如你出门前让 Mac 上的 Codex 修个 Bug，刚下楼它准备跑测试，弹出个命令审批卡住了。2.1 版本支持直接跟随电脑上已打开的 Codex 桌面端或 VS Code 会话——手机打开就是原来那条任务，看清命令点个「允许」，审批直接交回原窗口接着跑，上下文完全不断。

3. Swift / Kotlin 原生移动端 + 自带文件树与远程终端
它不是在手机里套个网页或者让你搓远程桌面，iOS 和安卓端都是用 Swift 和 Kotlin 原生写的，Web、Mac、Win、iPad 全端通吃。在手机上除了给 Agent 发指令，还能直接翻工作区文件树、开远程终端看日志。

4. MIT 协议开源 + 支持 Docker 自托管
目前官方线上服务直接免费用（据发布帖披露内测已有 4.8 万+ 用户）。如果你平时写的是公司内部项目，担心消息、代码片段和附件经过第三方服务端，仓库里直接给了 Docker 方案，可以把服务部署到自己的机器上，数据完全留在自己手里。

最后提醒两个实操避坑细节：
一是 Agent 本身依然跑在你自己的工作电脑上，出门前记得把电脑休眠关了、让 Connector 保持在线；二是目前「原窗口无缝接管审批」在 2.1 里主要打通了 Codex 桌面端和 IDE 会话，不同 Agent 的接管深度会有差异。

手里同时开着好几个 Agent 的兄弟，回电脑花几分钟就能接上：

官网与全平台下载：https://t.co/BEgTUO7K9m
GitHub 开源仓库（MIT）：https://t.co/7KmVjDtgpD Agents Anywhere 今天正式发布。

一个工作台，管理所有设备上的 Agent，支持 Claude Code、Codex、DSH 等多种 Agent。

Web、Win、Mac、iPhone、iPad、安卓全平台适配，
在任何一端都能给任何一台电脑上的 Agent 发任务。

极致的 UI 体验：对标 Codex ；移动端使用 Swift 和 Kotlin 原生开发。

开源免费。目前线上服务免费使用，内测已有 4.8 万+ 用户。

支持自部署，数据安全可控。

Prompt : Create a 2D anime short for the web. It must look completely like real Japanese anime, as if it were taken directly from a finished theatrical anime film. This is traditional-looking, hand-drawn 2D anime, not a 3D animation, a moving illustration, or a stylized web graphic.

Deliver a single, self-contained HTML file that plays offline, with a synthesized soundtrack. Use any tools, libraries, references, guides, literally anything etc.

Use theatrical Japanese fantasy anime as the art style reference: painted nature, luminous water, skies that carry the emotion. It retells the old legend of the carp that climbs the Dragon Gate falls. The film is 88 seconds long, in 39 shots. Its characters are HI, the smallest koi in a temple pond, a grey HERON, a ginger CAT, an old stone dragon spout, and the white DRAGON that Hi becomes. No people appear in the film. Use any tools or techniques you want, including 3D, as long as the final result looks 100% like hand-drawn 2D anime.

SCENE
Frame one is already striking: a white dragon with red markings bursts up a chimney of storm clouds at the camera, jaw wide, lightning, two impact frames, hard cut to silence. Dawn at an autumn temple pond: a red maple leaf lands, rings spread, and a scarlet crown spot rises until Hi's big dark eye breaks the surface. Wide: maples, a red arched bridge, a stone lantern, the temple roof, mist. Underwater, big koi nudge little Hi aside. Hi gazes at the carved stone dragon pouring its stream into the pond against the sunrise; its eye turns determined. It leaps the tiny inlet cascade and leaves.
Low along a stream through dense bamboo, then from above: a red-white dot winding through green. A golden canal town; a cat swipes, Hi dodges in a smear, the cat's eyes go round. The river opens toward far mountains with one thin waterfall thread. In a sunset gorge Hi fights the rapids; a heron's yellow eye locks on. The beak spears in with a cone of bubbles; on the second strike Hi leaps over it against the sun. Dusk turns violet; rain rings seen from below.
Night storm: a colossal 300 m waterfall, lightning, ghostly koi failing. Hi leaps, climbs a third of the way and is beaten back. It sinks, eyes half closed. A warm memory of the stone dragon. Its eye opens, the crown glows; it races up from the deep, bursts out and climbs the falling water, dodges a tumbling trunk, fins ragged. Near the top, near silence; the crown ignites; the final push over the lip, and a bolt strikes it. In the lightning glow it stretches, fins become a mane, barbels whiskers, antlers sprout, a gold wave runs over the scales. The dragon roars, rockets through the clouds into a golden dawn, then flies home down the valley: the heron flees, the cat looks up in awe, the bamboo bows. It circles the temple above the stone dragon. Last: the leaf on the still pond, the dragon's reflection gliding beneath, one ripple, a hold, a fade to white-gold.

ANIME QUALITY STANDARD
Every frame must look drawn by professional anime animators and painted by master background artists.
HI: a small kohaku butterfly koi. White FAF7F2, shade B9BCD6, two big organic scarlet patches E8442E and a round scarlet crown spot, long translucent fins with drawn rays, two small barbels, big expressive anime eyes that read at phone size.
THE DRAGON: 300 m, white with the same scarlet patches and crown, drawn scale arcs, a flowing translucent mane, long whiskers, pale-gold antlers, gold claws, Hi's eye made fierce, moving in S-curves.
HERON: blue-grey 8C97AD, white face, black crest, yellow beak and eye F1C232. CAT: ginger tabby E8954A with a white chest, cute and expressive.
Line art: Confident hand-inked lines with pressure and taper, on every shape and plate boundary.
Coloring: Clean cel areas, cool lavender shadows, crisp highlights. Never murky or black: the storm night is deep indigo 1E2453 with cyan-white water.
Backgrounds: Hand-painted gouache: maples and a temple at dawn, bamboo, a golden canal town, sunset cliffs, a storm waterfall, a dawn sea of clouds.
Water: Clear and luminous: depth bands, caustics, drawn ripple rings, reflections, a bright surface seen from below.
Effects: Bold drawn FX on threes: rain, spray, splash crowns, bubbles, lightning, sparkles, speed lines, inverted ink impact frames. Never particle mush.
Animation: Characters on twos, strong key poses, real holds, smears on fast moves. The huge dragon moves slowly. Nothing clips, slides or floats.
Sound: Original score and effects timed to the picture: a 4-note koi motif on koto and music box that grows into the dragon's theme on brass and choir, birdsong, bamboo knocks, a cat's "mrrp", a heron's call, rain, thunder, the roar of the falls, a heartbeat in the near silence, taiko for the climb, a temple bell at home.
Direction: A tiny hero against huge worlds, macro close-ups on the eye, colour running dawn, day, sunset, storm, dawn.

IT MUST NOT LOOK LIKE
- 3D: No plastic materials, CGI shading, visible polygons or game-engine lighting.
- Blocky shapes: No plain boxes or toy proportions. Everything carries scales, fin rays, feathers or fur.
- SVG or vector art: No perfect curves, uniform outlines or basic gradients.
- Web animation: No sliding layers, bobbing, software easing or puppet joints.
- Pasted-on elements: No 2D sprites floating in a 3D scene.
- AI art: No warped shapes, melted details, flicker or changing designs.
- Non-anime art: No Western cartoon designs or realistic rendering.
- Amateur work: No stiff poses, empty backgrounds, muddy colors or placeholders.

You are free to change any part of the prompt, if it would result in better results.

It should feel small and brave, then enormous and joyful.

Before finishing, inspect random frames as still images. If any frame does not look completely like real 2D anime, keep improving it.

Do not stop until every frame could pass as a still from a theatrical anime film.

https://t.co/zcTyi9e63P

repos.name: imisic/claude-obsidian-vault

05 docling → turns PDF, Word, PowerPoint and Excel into clean text your wiki can read https://t.co/j6E3LDTZIj

06 linkwarden → saves a screenshot and a PDF of every bookmark, with optional AI tags https://t.co/4STQnnYDYl

07 open-notebook → a self-hosted NotebookLM that answers with citations and runs on local models https://t.co/efQSV1laoZ

08 SurfSense → a knowledge base for agents with cited answers over 50+ file formats https://t.co/gMA3qYWgMq

09 AFFiNE → docs, whiteboard and database in one local-first workspace you can self-host https://t.co/iX9Wj1HvGl

Pick one tonight and point it at your inbox. A week from now you have a second brain that answers from your own sources, and everyone building from scratch is still setting up folders.

tweet.text:
GitHub is a freaking GOLDMINE for scraping the internet.

I found 10 insanely powerful repos that can scrape websites, extract millions of data points, and automate your entire research workflow.

And the best part? They're FREE.

Bookmark these:

1. Crawlee for Python

Build powerful crawlers with automatic retries, parallel processing, and browser automation for JavaScript-heavy websites.

https://t.co/6exOpIx1nR

2. Botasaurus

Automate repetitive scraping tasks with browser automation, parallel execution, and caching that saves you from collecting the same data twice.

https://t.co/LeTONNyGdX

3. Jina Reader

Turn messy webpages into clean, AI-friendly text. Perfect for feeding articles, documentation, and research into your AI workflows.

https://t.co/dnoYrImqwB

4. Trafilatura

Extract article text, titles, authors, and publication dates. Export clean research datasets as JSON, Markdown, CSV, and more.

https://t.co/ms8f1vAYQE

5. Spider

Crawl websites concurrently with a Rust-powered engine. Supports JavaScript rendering and runs locally without a cloud account.

https://t.co/2lE6QAfmuQ

6. Crawlab

Manage your crawlers from one dashboard. Schedule jobs, inspect logs, and distribute scraping tasks across multiple machines.

https://t.co/bI56CLB4P4

7. Ferret

Write reusable queries to extract and transform data from websites, APIs, and documents.

https://t.co/Gyu3kSHQOn

8. MechanicalSoup

Automate forms, follow links, and handle cookies with Python. A lightweight option for websites that don’t require JavaScript.

https://t.co/p6lOAYuhqq

9. Selectolax

Extract the exact fields you need from downloaded HTML using a fast parser and CSS selectors. Useful for processing large collections of pages.

https://t.co/QIgnYrVzXP

10. scrapy-playwright

Upgrade your Scrapy projects with browser automation. Render JavaScript, interact with pages, and collect data that ordinary requests miss.

https://t.co/iZPPzBMDlg

The code is free. Hosting, storage, and optional proxies can still cost extra.

repos.name: cyberkaida/reverse-engineering-assistant
repos.description: MCP server for reverse engineering tasks in Ghidra 👩‍💻

tweet.text:
This is a f*cking killer combo.

REA plus these 12 free repos do something unbelievable: one agent takes the software apart, and the rest see what it hides, run it in a sandbox and replay every step

REA is the brain, and everything below is the workshop

[01] the agent

rea: MCP server and CLI that lets coding agents investigate native binaries, Electron apps, .NET assemblies and websites https://t.co/wr9WrAyIMF
 reverse-engineering-assistant: connects an LLM to Ghidra through specialized reverse engineering tools https://t.co/YTPAR9lFNW
 binary_ninja_mcp: lets agents decompile, rename and patch a binary open in Binary Ninja https://t.co/QqriYVIk4D

[02] what is inside

capa: tells you what an executable can do, mapped to ATT&CK https://t.co/chWS7vPeQ4
 flare-floss: recovers obfuscated and stack strings that plain strings misses https://t.co/5Var0snhZD
 yara: write a rule once, match every sample that looks like it https://t.co/ITPNw4cDd2

[03] read the code

cutter: graphical reverse engineering platform with the Ghidra decompiler built in https://t.co/vT5vrMnqFn
 retdec: LLVM-based decompiler for ELF, PE and Mach-O https://t.co/pa5g8iarHj

[04] run it safely

unicorn: lightweight CPU emulator for ARM, MIPS, x86, RISC-V and more https://t.co/ebciO7QSwK
 qiling: emulates whole binaries across Windows, Linux, Android and UEFI, with hooks at every level https://t.co/br7gshGawU

[05] watch it run

rr: records a program once and lets you replay and reverse-execute it in gdb https://t.co/I1sLHbPeWe
 r2frida: runs Frida inside radare2 to hook and patch live processes https://t.co/Nn1s6UDu6q
 gef: turns gdb into a full reverse engineering debugger with 50+ commands https://t.co/K1YmlJ6s1N

Reading software you have no source for used to be a skill that took years, and now it starts with pointing an agent at a file.

用法：二进制 -> REA -> SPEC.md -> 重建 -> 对照标准 -> 重试

tweet.text:
This is f*cking brilliant.

13 free repos turn a folder of notes into a second brain an agent can actually use: it captures what you read, searches everything you saved and never starts from zero

[01] capture

obsidian-clipper: official Obsidian web clipper, saves any page as Markdown https://t.co/aBlQ02f3zG

markitdown: turns PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel and audio into Markdown https://t.co/zrR2oFNAMI

yt-dlp: pulls subtitles from videos without downloading them https://t.co/0L6rFqlZ1L

paperless-ngx: OCR and full-text search for every scan and PDF https://t.co/PfhkzzlX6e

[02] structure

obsidian-dataview: turns your vault into a database you can query https://t.co/lgvG9YNkar

obsidian-git: version history and automatic backup for every note https://t.co/X2U3i0Ecl1

[03] search

qmd: on-device search for your notes, combines keywords, vectors and re-ranking, has an MCP server https://t.co/cuL1B2pGwC

meilisearch: search as you type with typo tolerance and hybrid semantic mode https://t.co/GweDypXFH6

[04] agent memory

letta: stateful agents that learn over time https://t.co/C2q1bzlw1E

langmem: facts, behavior and past interactions for long-term agent memory https://t.co/qYgX1ZuMnG

MemOS: a memory layer for agents, stored as a graph you can inspect and edit https://t.co/vJzUU22NQt

[05] own it

quartz: publishes your Markdown notes as a website https://t.co/2XgWLOsdAs

syncthing: syncs your vault between devices, peer to peer and encrypted https://t.co/MSLYChoxV9

A pile of notes becomes a second brain only when an agent can search it and remember it.

Every repo above is free, and most of it runs on your own machine.

tweet.text:
GitHub is an absolute GOLDMINE for building mobile apps.

I found 10 insane repos that help you build STUNNING iOS and Android apps using Claude Code and Codex.

No need to design everything from scratch.

Bookmark these:

1. Expo Skills

Official Expo skills for Claude Code and Codex. Give your agent guidance for building mobile screens, navigation, animations, and app deployment workflows.

https://t.co/jq78v226lX

2. React Native Reusables

The shadcn/ui approach for mobile apps. Start with ready-made components, customize their styling, and make the interface your own.

https://t.co/JfLcoCULFa

3. Obytes Starter

An Expo starter with TypeScript, routing, styling, forms, data fetching, and testing already organized. Give your agent a foundation to build on.

https://t.co/0jXNksqDbT

4. gluestack-ui

Copy-and-customize mobile components with flexible themes and accessibility support. Build consistent screens without recreating every interface element.

https://t.co/eLoAbsQtyy

5. Tamagui

A styling system and adaptable UI kit for mobile and web. Share interface code while keeping control over your app’s design.

https://t.co/Twi9P8cveQ

6. React Native Skia

Create custom graphics and visual effects with GPU-powered 2D rendering. Useful when your app needs more than standard buttons and cards.

https://t.co/759hrwOuLe

7. React Native Bottom Sheet

Add draggable panels with smooth snapping, scrolling, and keyboard handling. Perfect for filters, booking flows, and checkout interfaces.

https://t.co/gAHtPKtErH

8. Reanimated Carousel

Build swipeable galleries, onboarding screens, and animated card layouts. Includes 20 example scenes with code you can adapt.

https://t.co/P9GZ6dzLiM

9. React Native Gifted Charts

Add animated charts, gradients, and live data updates. Build polished dashboards for fitness, finance, habit tracking, and analytics apps.

https://t.co/YDvV5rHR7I

10. VisionCamera

Add photo and video capture, QR scanning, smooth zoom, and frame-processing integrations. Build camera features without starting from zero.

https://t.co/j00cFLHAyK

What did I miss?

repos.name: fhshaik/typesafe-mario
repos.description: A TypeSafe/Jev agent that plays Super Mario Bros. from structured emulator state.

tweet.text:
this is wild...

 jev + grok bot is the most powerful ai setup right now

if you already have access to the Jev API but aren’t sure how to start experimenting with it, just copy this checklist:  

1. agent-desktop  
Desktop automation. Read the system's accessibility tree, judge which button, menu, or input field to click next. 
https://t.co/ZtSEjUTnrd     

2. typesafe-mario  
Have Jev play Super Mario. No screenshots—just read the structured state in the emulator's RAM, then decide to run, jump, or dodge. https://t.co/GHttIjXnSX     

3. jev-drone   
Use Jev to control a drone. The underlying flight control still handles stability and safety; Jev just does higher-level judgments like climbing, braking, and navigating obstacles. https://t.co/z0lYh9ySyY     

4. OneVOneJev  
1v1 FPS in the browser. Every decision tick, judge movement, view angle, aiming, firing, and jumping. https://t.co/aJiU0abl2g     

5. jev-trader   
High-frequency market making on Monad testnet. Jev judges the next buy or sell based on spreads and trade direction, with model latency around 81ms. https://t.co/DaDRIrlhfm     

6. Prism   
Doesn't directly have Jev place orders. It judges states like toxic flow, market pressure, mean reversion, etc., then hands off to the original strategy. https://t.co/aim9lGS8EG 
    
7. neo4jev   
Stuff Jev into a knowledge graph. At each node, judge the most worthwhile edge to take next, then follow it all the way. 
https://t.co/9h0KXKeu8H  
   
8. jev-curate   
Use Jev to screen training data. For JSONL / Parquet, first judge quality, relevance, and risk, then decide which ones go into the next training round. https://t.co/yYV6aEesje     

9. Canny   
Prevents Coding Agents from stubbornly claiming they're done. Look at tool outputs, code diffs, and test results, then judge if the completion claim is reliable. https://t.co/H4jFT8isQc     

10. killmyidea 
Input a startup idea, and Jev scores it from multiple angles, finally giving you KILL, FIX, or SHIP. https://t.co/XWo7JPOIW6   

Copy these complete blueprints - then read full Jev + Grok Bot setup below ↓ ↓ https://t.co/JDUqNIHixU

jadx: turns Android APKs back into Java https://t.co/4x568Hp8N8 Frida: hooks into a program while it runs https://t.co/M1kE5jv4Fs

[03] binary

GitHub is an absolute GOLDMINE for content creators.

I found 10 insane repos that can help you create viral videos, posts, thumbnails, and more using AI.

Most creators have no idea these exist.

Bookmark this:

1. New Term Radar

Find emerging AI tools, models, and repos through signals from X, Hugging Face, GitHub, and website sitemaps. Turn new discoveries into content ideas.

https://t.co/L750bCMXD0

Charlie Hills’ skills for hooks, content planning, research, and writing. Generate six hook angles per topic and draft posts using your own voice profile.

https://t.co/B5UQOnMQVt

https://t.co/Cw6R7GpR5n

Write scripts, review titles and thumbnails together, analyze retention exports, and find potential Shorts inside your longer videos.

https://t.co/T7xBSVHQvc

5. Krita AI Diffusion

Generate and edit visuals directly inside Krita. Remove objects, expand images, fill selected areas, and upscale graphics for thumbnails and posts.

https://t.co/KS4n1XI9J7

6. FLUX.2

Generate images from prompts and edit them using reference images. The klein 4B model has Apache-2.0 weights, making it a useful starting point for commercial projects.

https://t.co/WiqsJCwkns

7. LTX-2

Generate videos with synchronized audio from text or images. Create supporting footage, transform existing clips, or regenerate a selected section of a video.

https://t.co/YY5CauxtxZ

8. AI YouTube Shorts Generator

Turn long videos into vertical clips using transcription, AI highlight selection, and automatic cropping. Useful for repurposing interviews, podcasts, and tutorials.

https://t.co/kpYkdsZcd9

9. LinkedIn Skills

Serge Bulaev’s skills for Claude Code and Codex. Draft posts and comments, analyze feed content, and build a consistent publishing schedule.

https://t.co/5Suhk4CAYa

10. Dagu

Connect scripts, AI calls, and coding agents into scheduled workflows. Build a repeatable pipeline for research, drafting, rendering, and organizing your content.

https://t.co/EkZpA7l88M

Some tools need API keys or capable hardware. Check model licenses before commercial use.

tweet.text:
